jobs.title: Assistant Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Organization- Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe Resort, Spa and Casino

Summary

At Hyatt, we believe our guests choose Hyatt because of our caring and attentive colleagues who are focused on providing efficient service and meaningful experiences.

The Assistant Director of Engineering supports the Director of Engineering in overseeing the resort’s engineering operations, building systems, facilities, equipment, grounds, and preventative maintenance programs. This role helps ensure the safety, appearance, reliability, and long-term integrity of Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe Resort, Spa and Casino.

The Assistant Director provides visible, hands-on leadership to the Engineering team and partners closely with hotel leadership, operational departments, vendors, contractors, and regulatory agencies. This position balances daily operational needs with preventative maintenance, project coordination, regulatory compliance, energy efficiency, and colleague development.

Why Work With Us

Competitive salary and benefits package
Paid time off from date of hire
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Complimentary and discounted Hyatt hotel stays
Complimentary colleague meals and parking
$2,000 Annual wellness and tuition reimbursement
Career growth and development opportunities with Hyatt
A unique opportunity to work at a premier Lake Tahoe resort

Be part of a team committed to creating exceptional guest experiences in one of Lake Tahoe’s most beautiful destinations. Hyatt colleagues work in an environment that values performance, development, teamwork, and care.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Assist the Director of Engineering with the daily leadership and operation of the Engineering Department.
Oversee the maintenance and repair of guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house spaces, mechanical systems, equipment, grounds, and resort facilities.
Supervise, coach, schedule, and develop Engineering colleagues while maintaining strong standards of safety, accountability, productivity, and guest service.
Coordinate and monitor preventative maintenance programs to support equipment reliability, asset preservation, and operational continuity.
Respond to guest concerns, work orders, emergencies, and urgent operational needs in a timely and professional manner.
Conduct property inspections and follow up on maintenance, safety, cleanliness, and quality concerns.
Support departmental budgeting, purchasing, inventory control, labor management, and expense monitoring.
Assist with capital projects, renovations, repairs, installations, and other property improvement initiatives.
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, inspectors, and service providers to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to hotel standards.
Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, life-safety standards, environmental requirements, and local, state, and federal regulations.
Support utility management, energy conservation, sustainability, and efficiency initiatives.
Maintain accurate records related to inspections, maintenance, work orders, equipment, permits, vendors, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with Front Office, Housekeeping, Security, Food and Beverage, Spa, and other departments to support hotel operations and the guest experience.
Assume departmental leadership responsibilities in the Director of Engineering’s absence.
Remain available to respond to property emergencies and critical operational needs as required.

Qualifications

Three or more years of progressive experience in hotel engineering, facilities management, building maintenance, or a related field preferred.
Previous supervisory or management experience in a hotel, resort, commercial facility, or similar environment preferred.
Strong working knowledge of building systems, HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, mechanical equipment, life-safety systems, and preventative maintenance.
Experience coordinating repairs, vendors, contractors, inspections, and maintenance projects.
Understanding of workplace safety, building codes, regulatory compliance, and emergency response procedures.
Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple operational needs in a fast-paced resort environment.
Experience with maintenance management systems, work-order platforms, and standard business software preferred.
Applicable trade licenses, technical certifications, or formal education in engineering, facilities management, or a related field preferred.
Valid driver’s license required.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

Ability to stand, walk, bend, climb, and move throughout the property for extended periods.
Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds as needed.
Ability to access mechanical rooms, rooftops, ladders, crawl spaces, and confined spaces when required.
Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varied weather conditions, including winter conditions.
Ability to respond to emergencies and operational needs during evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Hyatt associates work in an environment that demands exceptional performance yet reaps great rewards. Whether it is career opportunities, job enrichment or a supportive work environment, if you are ready for this challenge, then we are ready for you.

jobs.description:
About The Role

The Senior Director of Infrastructure and Cloud Engineering is a senior technology leader responsible for leading Skechers’ global systems and cloud engineering groups. This leader will modernize and scale enterprise infrastructure capabilities, strengthen operational reliability, drive automation and standardization, and partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Product, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations to align infrastructure and cloud capabilities with business priorities.

This role requires broad infrastructure leadership experience, deep cloud engineering expertise, and the ability to build high-performing teams that deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology platforms in a global, matrixed environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead the enterprise infrastructure and cloud engineering strategy inclusive of cloud platforms, systems engineering, collaboration platforms, endpoints and related infrastructure services.
Own the multi-cloud strategy across major hyperscalers, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle, ensuring scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective platform capabilities.
Drive modernization, migration and automation of infrastructure and cloud environments to improve reliability, agility, security, and operational efficiency.
Lead the design, deployment, and optimization of cloud-native, hybrid-cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures, including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, compute, storage, and platform engineering capabilities.
Establish infrastructure and cloud governance, standards, roadmaps, architecture patterns, lifecycle management practices, and operating models across the global enterprise.
Champion operational excellence through SRE practices, SLOs, SLAs, observability, incident management, problem management, capacity planning, performance management, and continuous improvement.
Oversee Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, CI/CD enablement, automation, platform reliability, and engineering practices that improve consistency and reduce operational risk.
Partner with Cybersecurity to ensure infrastructure and cloud platforms align with Zero Trust principles, identity and access controls, security monitoring, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, and compliance requirements.
Drive FinOps practices, infrastructure cost governance, forecasting, optimization, vendor management, licensing oversight, and KPI reporting across infrastructure and cloud services.
Develop talent, strengthen succession planning, and build leadership capacity across infrastructure and cloud engineering disciplines.
Serve as a technology advisor to executive leadership on infrastructure investment, cloud modernization, operational risk, resiliency, cybersecurity alignment, technology lifecycle, and platform strategy.
Represent Infrastructure and Cloud Engineering in enterprise governance forums, steering committees, architecture reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, audit, privacy, and operational requirements, including SOX, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and related enterprise controls.

What You’ll Bring

15+ years of progressive cloud engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure engineering or related technology experience.
Minimum 5 years at the Director level or above within a global, matrixed organization with accountability for enterprise-scale infrastructure and cloud platforms.
Proven track record leading large-scale infrastructure modernization, cloud transformation, platform engineering, reliability, automation, and operational maturity initiatives.
Deep experience with major cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle, with hands-on understanding of multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architecture.
Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure domains, including compute, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, endpoints, and collaboration platforms.
Experience leading infrastructure operations and engineering teams responsible for globally distributed, business-critical platforms and services.
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and align technical priorities with business outcomes.
Executive presence with experience presenting infrastructure strategy, risk, investment, performance, and modernization recommendations to senior leadership and C-suite audiences.
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code, automation, configuration management, and CI/CD practices using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms.
Working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts, including SD-WAN, Zero Trust, CDN, DNS, load balancing, segmentation, and connectivity patterns across hybrid environments.
Working knowledge of cloud and infrastructure security capabilities, including CSPM, CNAPP, SIEM integrations, identity and access management, encryption, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.
Strong financial and vendor management experience, including CapEx, OpEx, budgeting, forecasting, licensing, contracts, and cost optimization.

Skills & Requirements

Experience in retail, consumer goods, distribution, manufacturing, or global supply chain environments.
Experience developing senior technical leaders and building succession plans across infrastructure, cloud, and platform engineering teams.
Active certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional, VMware, ITIL, or related infrastructure and cloud certifications.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field required.
Master’s degree, MBA, or MS preferred.

The pay range for this role is $200,000-$260,000/yr USD.

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

Job Title: Director of Strain Engineering

About Switch Bioworks

Based in San Carlos, CA, Switch Bioworks is redefining bioproduction through programmable microbes. Beginning with agriculture, we are developing nitrogen-fixing microbial consortia that live directly on crop roots. This replaces expensive, carbon-intensive synthetic fertilizers with a living alternative that reshapes the economics and sustainability of farming.

Our edge lies in our namesake “switches” - synthetic control systems that activate target metabolism only when and where it’s needed. By combining microbial ecology with advanced genetic control systems, Switch is building a platform that is transforming how biological products are used and deployed, with an initial focus on farmers and agriculture.

Learn more at www.switchbioworks.com

About The Position

As Director of Strain Engineering, you will define the strategy and lead the execution of Switch’s strain and consortium engineering platform. You will drive strain engineering to high-throughput and faster DBTL cycles, applying modular genetic circuit design, automation, and new construction and screening methods to non-model organisms that lack off-the-shelf genetic tools.

You will manage and develop a high-performing team of exceptional scientists, own an annual budget, own delivery across strain engineering workstreams supporting both an internal pipeline and external R&D partnerships, and serve as the technical lead for strain engineering in partner-facing discussions.

We are looking for a leader who has successfully developed and scaled a team. This role involves hands-on lab work; you will be at the bench regularly, leading by example, running and troubleshooting experiments alongside your team.

This position reports to the Chief Scientific Officer.

Objectives And Responsibilities

Platform: Architect and build out Switch's bacterial strain engineering platform, establishing a modular circuit design and construction platform that integrates a design-build-test-learn infrastructure, together with the registry, LIMS workflows, standardized SOPs, and data systems that connect them. Own the capability roadmap and the build-versus-buy decisions behind it.
Chassis and Genetic Tools: Set chassis strategy for non-model organism bacteria, and direct the tool development required to support it: DNA delivery, editing and integration systems, inducible and constitutive expression parts, and counterselection markers, ensuring genetic tractability is never the constraint on where the pipeline can go.
Pipeline Impact: Define the circuit and metabolic engineering strategy for improving bacterial strain performance against product-defining metrics, and be accountable for engineered strains advancing through growth chamber, greenhouse, and field evaluation.
Partnerships: Partner with CBO and CSO to own technical strategy and delivery across strain engineering workstreams supporting external partnerships, meeting milestones on schedule and serving as the technical authority for your area in partner-facing reviews.
Cross-functional Delivery: Partner with process development on manufacturability, formulation on delivery constraints, and plant science and field teams on phenotype-to-field translation. Shape the experimental designs that cross these boundaries rather than handing off strains.
Intellectual Property: Partner with Senior Counsel and CSO to build and protect the IP underpinning the platform. Identify patentable inventions as they emerge, and design with freedom to operate and the regulatory pathway in view.
Budget: Under guidance from the CFO and CSO, build and manage your team’s annual budget: headcount plan, capital equipment, consumables, external services and software.
Team: Build the strain engineering organization to meet a growing pipeline, including structure, hiring, leveling, and the development of scientific leaders within the team.
Technical Leadership: Set multi-year technical direction for strain engineering, direct experimental strategy at the bench, and contribute to company-wide R&D strategy as part of the senior technical team.

Characteristics of a successful candidate

Proven people leader who has built, scaled, and restructured scientific teams, who thrives on developing young scientists into leaders, and who has successfully developed and managed budgets.
Demonstrated track record of successfully engineering bacterial strains that reached commercial deployment.
Expertise across high-throughput strain and metabolic engineering, including demonstrated experience using computational techniques to drive strategy.
Current with state-of-the art genetic engineering tools and techniques, with hands on experience in: the design, synthesis, and assembly (in vivo and in vitro) of synthetic biology parts and circuits, modular assembly of functional modules and DNA libraries, targeted and combinatorial genome editing (classic and CRISPR-based), high-throughput strain physiological screening (colony picking through quantitative assays), lab automation, and high-throughput data processing.
Experience in the theory and practice of evolutionary engineering across proteins, genes, metabolic pathways, and genomes, including library design, construction, screening, and the statistical analysis and predictive modelling from combinatorial data (ProSAR, etc).
Deep understanding of the application of Xomics (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics), including methodology, experimental design, data analysis, and interpretation, with an emphasis on diverse applications of nextgen sequencing.
Experience engineering diverse non-model bacteria, with demonstrated success in engineering strains when a standard tool kit does not exist..
Works naturally across diverse company functions and can communicate technical depth clearly, effectively, and appropriately to internal and external stakeholders.
Brings a strong blend of process orientation and innovation, able to install the rigor and systems a scaling team needs without dampening the creativity that drives discovery.
Comfortable leading the team's experimental work hands-on in the lab while operating strategically across the organization with an owner mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

Ph.D. (ideal) or M.S. (required) in Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Synthetic Biology, Metabolic Engineering, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline.
10+ years of industry experience in strain engineering or a closely related field, including 5+ years managing scientific teams.
Experience in a startup environment is required. Additional experience at a large, established organization is ideal.
Hands-on experience building or substantially scaling high-throughput strain engineering capability, including laboratory automation and the data infrastructure supporting design-build-test-learn cycles.
Deep hands-on expertise with state-of-the-art bacterial molecular genetics, synthetic biology, DNA library design and construction techniques
Hands on working knowledge of LIMS and ELN systems, including strain and part registries and inventory management; Benchling LIMS experience strongly preferred.
Track record of technical contribution to R&D partnerships or collaborations with external organizations.
Experience with plant-associated, soil, or environmentally released microbes and exposure to regulatory pathways for engineered microorganisms is a strong plus.
Must be authorized to work full-time in the U.S. and able to work on-site daily in San Carlos, CA

How To Apply

Please apply through the application portal. A cover letter is required to submit your application. In your cover letter, please state in a few sentences how your experience is directly relevant to this position and company, providing sufficient specific detail.

Expected salary range

$175,000 - $215,000 Salary and Title commensurate with experience. Switch Bioworks is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

15

Head of Technology Risk, Governance, and Controls

The Team

Digital Technology (DT) is an enterprise-shared technology organization enabling people, functions, and divisions. We drive S&P Global to advance essential intelligence by working as trusted partners delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and innovative products and services that create value and enable superior experiences for our people and customers.

The Impact

The Head of Technology Risk and Governance works directly with the Senior Vice President, Chief Information Officer (CIO) to own the strategy and oversight of first-line risk across the broader technology organization. The role will ensure the integrity of S&P Global systems by managing our internal controls, owning and ensuring completion of MAPs, SOX controls, any audits from a technology perspective, regulatory compliant, and our overall risk posture. This role works in partnership with key stakeholders in Information Security, divisional technology teams, Corporate functions, our Enterprise Data Organization, as well as with Enterprise Risk and Compliance, Internal Audit, and External Auditor.

Line of Defense Positioning:
This is a first-line-of-defense role. The Head owns the identification, assessment, mitigation, and day-to-day management of the technology risks this organization creates. Accountability for designing and operating the controls, owning the risks and their remediation, and embedding risk management into how technology builds and runs.

Responsibilities And Impact

Lead the technology risk and governance strategy by driving risk initiatives in support of the Enterprise Technology and Transformation strategy to protect our brand, enable business-focused capabilities, and lead with innovation.
Ownership and liaison for SOX controls with Finance, Internal Audit and External Auditor including responsibility for the annual testing of related IT SOX controls and deficiency remediation.
Scale and optimize the first-line of defense to proactively identify and mitigate technology risk across the firm.
Work in tandem with the Enterprise Risk and Compliance team to contribute to the enterprise risk appetite and taxonomy, and design and operate the controls that implement them within technology.
Operationalize the enterprise risk framework within technology and establish the technology-specific governance needed to run the first line, in coordination with information security.
Establish and track KPIs and KRIs related to technology risk and compliance across all technology teams; create consistency in measuring and reporting.
Collaborate with senior stakeholders across the enterprise to integrate risk management into strategic planning, product development, and operational rigor.
Lead risk assessments and partner with Internal Audit to ensure compliance and identify areas for improvement.
Drive a culture of risk awareness and continuous improvement, ensuring compliance to industry standards. Create risk awareness programs designed to improve the risk fluency of our technology organization.
Own first-line management of technology risk arising from third parties, external platforms, cloud providers, and critical dependencies—including concentration and continuity exposure—partnering with Procurement / Third-Party Risk Management and the second-line dependency function.
Own identification, remediation planning, tracking to closure, and timely escalation of technology risks, control issues, and audit action plans across the organization.
Design, implement, and operate the technology control environment, including control self-assessment and the production of audit- and oversight-ready evidence.
Embed first-line risk management and controls for AI including model and use-case inventory, secure deployment, monitoring, and control operation.
Strengthen operational resilience and continuity for critical technology services, including availability and recovery expectations.
Map regulatory and compliance obligations affecting technology into the control environment, ensuring traceability between obligations, controls, and evidence.

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $220,000 to $350,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is not eligible for additional compensation such as an annual incentive bonus or sales commission plan.

This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

Include for roles that are bonus plan eligible, including sales commission plans.

What We’re Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications:

Minimum of 15 years of experience in technology risk management and internal controls implementation, including both building and operating a function, including people management experience.
Strong stakeholder relationship acumen to navigate issue resolution and urgency with internal and external stakeholders.
Able to convey complex risk topics, including progress of remediation efforts, statuses of issues, etc. to varied audiences (e.g., executive leadership, technical teams, audit, etc)
Successful track record in working in a global environment, with the ability to create constructive relationships and communicate across various organizational teams.
Exceptional analytical skills and problem-solving abilities, with proven experience in prioritizing and executing tasks in a high-pressure environment.
Deep familiarity with technology risk and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, COBIT, and SOX IT General Controls.
Understanding of emerging technology risk domains including AI/ML, cloud, and data privacy; ability to develop risk approaches for novel and evolving technology landscapes.
Must be in reasonable distance of one of our office locations. Role will be required to be in office at least 2 days per week.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Experience applying risk and control frameworks in a regulated environment.
Hands-on experience with GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or equivalent) to operationalize governance and reporting at scale.
Relevant professional certifications such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or equivalent.
Experience working with core AI capabilities such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or ChatGPT, particularly in solving business problems through custom agents or workflows.
Demonstrated experience operating within a Three Lines model, partnering with an independent second-line risk function and Internal Audit organization, without duplicating accountability.
Experience assessing third-party, vendor, and cloud-dependency technology risk, including operational resilience and concentration implications.
Master of Business Administration or Engineering or related discipline.

Data Center capacity planning and reporting
May assist in the design and build out of new facilities
Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Responsible for asset and inventory management

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Director, Analytics Engineering
to help in shaping the data infrastructure, modeling, and analytics capabilities of Webflow. You will be responsible for designing scalable data solutions, mentoring/hiring team members, and ensuring high-quality data availability for analytics and decision-making. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and insights, enabling data-driven strategies across the company.

You will be joining a results oriented, collaborative team with an established, shared understanding of our business logic, a modern data stack and lots of opportunity to extend the function to build new data analytics frameworks and establish best practices. You’ll work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to transform our data in ways that improve the flexibility and repeatability of analysis. You'll also partner on metric definitions and governance, and help teams understand and improve our user experience through data. You’ll bring your expertise to improve our current processes and promote a shared language across our growing data functions at Webflow, thoughtfully developing Webflow’s data maturity for lasting impact.

jobs.title: AI Platform Chief Architect
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The Chief Architect – AI Platform & Enterprise Architecture is the senior architecture leader accountable for defining, governing, and evolving the enterprise AI technology architecture that enables scalable, secure, and responsible AI adoption across the organization.

This role sets architectural vision, establishes enterprise standards and guardrails, and drives alignment across platform, data, engineering, security, risk, and product teams. The Chief Architect ensures technology decisions advance business strategy, reduce duplication, improve resilience, and accelerate delivery of production-ready AI/ML capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Define and maintain the enterprise architecture vision, principles, reference architectures, and decision frameworks for AI/ML platforms and adjacent technology domains.
Establish architecture standards that promote reuse, interoperability, resiliency, security, and speed-to-market across products, platforms, and shared services.
Drive architecture convergence across teams to reduce fragmentation, duplicate capabilities, technical debt, and long-term operational cost.
Partner with senior technology and business leaders to ensure architecture roadmaps directly support strategic priorities and measurable business outcomes.
Own the end-to-end architectural direction for enterprise AI/ML platform capabilities, including model integration, inference services, retrieval patterns, orchestration, and automation.
Define production-grade patterns for observability, scalability, model/data traceability, policy enforcement, and responsible AI controls.
Ensure platform capabilities can support secure onboarding of AI/ML use cases across DEV, UAT, and PROD environments with clear guardrails and repeatable patterns.
Guide platform investment decisions by balancing innovation, risk, cost, operational complexity, and business value.
Lead enterprise architecture strategy across hybrid and multi-cloud ecosystems, including Azure, AWS, on-premises services, data platforms, integration layers, and shared platform capabilities.
Define architectural patterns for secure data access, service integration, API management, event-driven flows, workload placement, and cost-aware scaling.
Assess technology options and vendor/platform choices, making recommendations that balance enterprise standards, delivery velocity, security posture, and total cost of ownership.
Ensure solution architectures align to enterprise security, compliance, resiliency, performance, and operational support requirements.
Lead the architecture community of practice, establishing forums, review mechanisms, and decision processes that improve consistency without slowing delivery.
Provide senior technical stewardship across domains, resolving complex cross-platform dependencies and ensuring end-to-end solution integrity.
Coach and mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leaders to raise architectural maturity and systems-thinking capability across the organization.
Represent architecture in executive, risk, compliance, product, and engineering governance forums.
Define architecture guardrails for security, privacy, compliance, data protection, model governance, auditability, and responsible AI.
Identify and manage architectural risk across platforms, integrations, dependencies, and production operations.
Ensure risk decisions are clearly documented, communicated, and aligned with enterprise control expectations.
Translate complex architecture choices into clear executive-level recommendations, tradeoffs, risk implications, and investment options.
Influence senior stakeholders across business, product, technology, security, and operations to align on enterprise architecture priorities and roadmap sequencing.
Serve as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on platform strategy, modernization, vendor decisions, emerging technologies, and long-term capability planning.
Drive alignment between architecture strategy, portfolio funding, delivery execution, and measurable business outcomes.
Establish architecture-led operating mechanisms that improve transparency, dependency management, delivery predictability, and production readiness.
Partner with engineering and platform leaders to ensure architectural decisions are reflected in backlogs, roadmaps, delivery plans, and operational support models.
Promote disciplined use of Agile practices, Jira hygiene, architecture decision records, structured status reporting, and issue escalation paths.
Hold teams accountable for solution quality, resiliency, performance, lifecycle ownership, and timely resolution of architectural risks.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
10 or more years of relevant software engineering experience
Six or more years of experience leading multiple software engineering teams

Preferred Skills

Extensive experience leading enterprise architecture, platform architecture, or large-scale technology transformation in complex organizations.
Proven ability to set architectural vision, define standards, govern technical decisions, and influence executive-level strategy.
Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, data platforms, API/service integration, security architecture, and production operations.
Strong understanding of AI/ML platform architecture, model integration patterns, responsible AI considerations, and data-driven systems.
Demonstrated success leading across engineering, product, data, security, risk, compliance, and operations teams without relying solely on direct authority.
Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs, risks, and investment choices clearly.
Experience establishing or maturing an enterprise architecture function, architecture review board, or architecture community of practice.
Experience with regulated, data-sensitive, or highly governed environments.
Familiarity with architecture frameworks, decision records, technology road mapping, portfolio governance, and technical debt management.
Experience shaping enterprise AI, GenAI, agentic AI, RAG, or intelligent automation strategies.
Relevant architecture or cloud certifications such as TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent experience.

Location Expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world — from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies.

The Leo Software Defined Networking (SDN) team designs, implements and operates the network virtualization stack and SDN control plane signaling. Our scope spans over beam planning, routing, and forwarding through our SDN Controller, Agents, and Applications that provides a high throughput telecom service comprised of Low Earth Orbit satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services and terrestrial network infrastructure that connects into public and private networks.

As the manager of this team, you will define the long-term vision for the team and its products as well as hiring and organizing to succeed. jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Risk
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic seeks a Head of Enterprise Risk to lead the programs that keep our people, operations, and mission resilient as we scale globally. Reporting to the Head of Resilience Operations, you will own a portfolio of enterprise-risk disciplines — environmental health & safety, access and life-cycle management, third-party (vendor) risk, and the security program management of new facilities — and directly oversee the specialist leaders who run them.

This is a globally strategic role. You set the policy, standards, and frameworks for how enterprise risk is identified, measured, and reduced across the company, and you build the programs — and the team behind them — ahead of need. It’s a fit for a leader who thinks in systems and time horizons and turns forward-looking risk into durable operational programs.

Responsibilities

Enterprise risk management: Own Anthropic’s enterprise risk framework — identify, assess, and prioritize enterprise risks, and integrate risk governance into business planning and decision-making.
Team leadership: Lead and develop a team of programmatic leaders across EH&S, access management, third-party risk, and new-facility security program management; set direction, standards, and accountable outcomes.
EH&S: Enable the global EH&S program leadership and support strategy, policy, and standards development, ensuring regulatory compliance and a strong safety culture across all operations.
Access management: Support the access and life-cycle management leader and their respective programs — access governance, provisioning standards, and auditing — across Anthropic facilities.
Third-party risk: Stand up and run a third-party (vendor) risk program — due diligence, security and safety requirements in contracts, and ongoing monitoring of critical suppliers.
New-facility programs: Facilitate development of the security program management of new facilities — from risk assessment and design requirements through pre-opening readiness and transition to operations — in partnership with regional teams, GSIS, Real Estate, and Facilities.
Horizon scanning: Within the realm of Safety & Security, anticipate emerging enterprise risks tied to rapid growth, new global offices, and frontier research environments, and advise leadership on readiness.
Cross-functional partnership: Partner across GSIS, IT, People, Legal, and Compliance to embed risk programs into the business.

You may be a good fit if you

Have 12+ years in enterprise risk, safety, resilience, or security program leadership, including managing teams and multi-disciplinary programs.
Have built or owned an enterprise risk management framework and integrated it into business planning.
Have led multi-disciplinary programs (e.g., EH&S, access, third-party risk, or facility programs) at organizational scale.
Are an effective people leader who develops specialists and holds a high program bar.
Communicate risk clearly to executives and translate it into operational programs.
Think in systems and time horizons and build ahead of need.
Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments.

Strong candidates may have

Considered a leader in your field, with experience building risk, safety, or resilience programs at hyperscale technology companies or across large multi-site, multinational organizations.
A strong EH&S background — program development and oversight in complex or high-risk environments.
Third-party / vendor risk management program experience.
Deep familiarity with enterprise risk frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000) and risk governance.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CSP, CIH, CPP, ARM, or ERM credentials).
Experience in high-profile, regulated, or research environments.

Working closely with operational leaders across Claims, Prior Authorization, Utilization Management, Provider Operations, Enrollment, Finance, Care Management, and Member Services, the Executive Director will identify and prioritize transformation opportunities and ensure successful adoption from concept through enterprise deployment.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Architecture

Description

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Director of Platform Architecture owns the technical design of the shared platform that Briefly's member firms — Rimon, Scale, Caravel and OGC — are consolidating onto. Day to day, the role defines the target-state architecture across identity, integration, security and shared services; sets the standards every application must meet before it goes live at a firm; and leads the technical side of each firm migration.
The position sits within the Transformation Management Office, reports to the VP of Transformation, and works most closely with the Director of Platform Data Operations, the Director of Finance Integration, and IT leadership at each firm. The ideal candidate has built shared infrastructure serving multiple brands or operating companies, is equally comfortable in an architecture review and in a room of partners and can hold a technical standard without alienating the firms who have to live with it.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Design the multi-tenant Azure architecture — subscription model, management group hierarchy, tenant isolation boundaries, shared services layer and network topology — sized to serve the current firms and to onboard additional firms without rearchitecting.
Define the Entra ID identity architecture, including tenant topology (single tenant, multi-tenant federation or B2B), single sign-on across all firms and applications, cross-tenant access policies, conditional access, MFA enforcement, and the separation between platform-level and firm-level identity administration.
Design the data partitioning model — row-level security, database isolation, API-layer access controls and audit logging — so that attorney-client privilege boundaries are enforced at every layer of the stack.
Design the matter-level data access control model, translating privilege boundaries into access control lists, data labels, API scopes and audit trails across Aderant, Clio, iManage and the Azure data layer.
Specify the Azure Virtual Desktop architecture for BYOD firms, including pooled versus dedicated session host design, image management, application delivery, and the network path from personal device to managed workspace.
Define the shared services layer — the administrative access pattern that allows a cross-firm support organization to operate across all firms without creating any pathway to cross-firm client data.
Architect the outside counsel guideline compliance posture so that endpoint management, data governance and access logging satisfy the requirements of the firm’s largest corporate clients.
Design the data residency and sovereignty model, covering where data is stored, how it is replicated, and what controls prevent unauthorized cross-border or cross-firm data movement.
Define the audit and monitoring architecture — the logging, alerting and reporting framework that gives firm leadership and the compliance function visibility into who accessed what, when and from where.
Architect the privileged identity management model, granting platform administrators, firm IT administrators and support staff minimum necessary access with just-in-time elevation for sensitive operations.
Define the application registration model governing how Aderant, Clio, iManage, Paylocity, HubSpot and other platform applications integrate with the single sign-on environment across firm boundaries, and the device compliance framework enforced through conditional access.
Produce the migration sequencing plan — which firm migrates in which order, the technical dependencies between migrations, and the parallel-run architecture for each transition.
Design the data migration architecture, covering extraction, transformation and loading patterns for matter data, client records, billing history, trust accounting and document libraries from four separate source systems.
Define the cutover architecture for each firm, including rollback trigger conditions, the hybrid connectivity model that lets users work across legacy and new environments during transition, and the controls that prevent data loss or corruption.
Design the validation framework — the technical tests that must pass before a firm migration is declared complete and legacy systems are decommissioned.
Produce architecture decision records for every significant design choice, documenting the alternatives considered and the rationale for the decision.
Establish architecture governance standards, including the review and approval process for decisions affecting multi-tenancy or data partitioning, and maintain the architecture documentation library and firm-onboarding template.
Serve as the technical reviewer within intake and prioritization, conduct architecture review on vendor selections and major builds, and present architecture decisions, migration progress and platform risk posture to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

Minimum Education & Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum ten years of enterprise architecture experience, including at least three years designing Azure-native multi-tenant solutions.
Demonstrated experience supporting multiple brands, entities or operating companies from a single shared platform.
Deep hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure, including Entra ID, Azure AD B2C, Azure Virtual Desktop, App Service, API Management, Azure SQL with row-level security, and Azure Monitor.
Demonstrated experience designing single sign-on architectures across multiple organizations using Entra ID, including federated identity, conditional access and cross-tenant access policies.
Proven experience designing data partitioning in multi-tenant environments where tenant isolation is a compliance or regulatory requirement rather than a preference.
Experience architecting migrations from on-premises or heterogeneous cloud environments onto a unified Azure platform, including parallel-run design and staged cutover planning.
Preferred: legal industry experience with attorney-client privilege, matter-level access controls and outside counsel guideline compliance; legal technology platforms such as Aderant, Clio and iManage, including their data models and Azure connectivity; Azure Virtual Desktop as a BYOD access control mechanism; cross-tenant administrative access patterns satisfying zero-trust principles; Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent; private-equity-backed or multi-entity professional services environments.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Requirements

Ability to produce architecture decision records, reference architecture diagrams and migration sequencing plans that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Ability to translate complex technical decisions into business terms for firm leadership and legal professionals.
Working knowledge of data architecture concepts, including warehouse and lakehouse patterns, master data and reporting layers.
Design judgment under real constraints rather than reliance on vendor reference architectures.
Ability to hold a technical standard under stakeholder pressure and explain the reasoning constructively.
Sound judgment in balancing platform consistency against legitimate firm-specific requirements.
Ability to influence without direct authority across independent business units with their own leadership and budgets.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage concurrent workstreams across multiple firms.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $180,000 to $220,000 annually. Placement within the range depends on qualifications and relevant experience. The position is also eligible for an annual incentive of 10 to 15 percent of base salary, tied to program delivery milestones and individual performance.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are dedicated to innovating and transforming the way we operate. As a key member of the Warehouse Transformation Team, the Senior Manager, Warehouse Equipment Platform Engineering will lead the development, engineering, and global standardization of warehouse automation equipment platforms. The role will establish reusable design principles, technical specifications, reference architectures, and performance standards for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS), four-way shuttle systems, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), robotic picking, goods-to-person picking, and automated truck loading. Working with our plants, cross-functional partners, external equipment suppliers, and system integrators, this leader will support concept development and detailed design for both greenfield facilities and brownfield modernization projects while balancing enterprise standards, site constraints, safety, scalability, and business value.

We seek an engineering leader who combines deep knowledge of warehouse equipment and material-flow design with strong platform thinking, supplier leadership, and the ability to convert operational needs into safe, reliable, scalable, and maintainable automation solutions.

What You'll Do for Us

Own and govern the global catalog of warehouse equipment platforms, including approved technology options, reference configurations, and application criteria.
Develop and maintain technical standards, design guidelines, reference configurations, equipment specifications, and approved component strategies for AMRs, AS/RS, four-way shuttles, AGVs, robotic picking, goods-to-person systems, and automated truck loading.
Define platform requirements for safety, throughput, capacity, availability, reliability, and maintainability.
Partner with plants and project teams to translate operational demand, product flows, storage profiles, and service requirements into fit-for-purpose equipment concepts.
Support greenfield projects from concept development through detailed equipment design, technical acceptance, commissioning, and operational handover.
Support brownfield assessments and modernization strategies that account for existing infrastructure, operational continuity, phased implementation, installation constraints, and migration risk.
Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, system integrators, and engineering consultants through market assessment, solution development, technical evaluation, design reviews, factory and site acceptance, commissioning, and performance validation.
Support creation of reusable engineering tools, design templates, simulation inputs, test protocols, lessons learned, and governance processes that reduce project risk and accelerate deployment.
Monitor technology and supplier developments, qualify new solutions, and manage platform obsolescence and continuous improvement across the installed base.

Requirements & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, industrial, controls, systems, automation, or a related engineering field, or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years of engineering, design, deployment, or operational experience with warehouse automation and material-handling equipment.
Demonstrated experience with one or more of the following: AMR, AS/RS, four-way shuttle, AGV, robotic picking, goods-to-person, or automated truck-loading solutions.
Experience developing equipment specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, leading design reviews, and supporting commissioning and acceptance testing.
Working knowledge of warehouse software and controls integration, including WMS, WES, WCS, MES, PLCs, industrial networks, and equipment interfaces.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and align teams on strategic objectives and project outcomes.
Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and influence internal and external partners regarding standards, design decisions, risks, and recommended practices.

What We Can Do For You

Purpose Driven: Purpose driven approach that empowers our people to protect the environment and communities we serve while delivering safe & quality products.
Global Connections: Allows you to develop, enhance and maintain global connections that allow us to move faster and learn from others.
Community of Belonging: We’re an organization that believes our ability to continually grow and build the right atmosphere where people feel safe and empowered, lets you bring your best self to work.

jobs.title: VP of Technology - Head Architect, TurboTax
jobs.description:
Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Architecture for Consumer Platform
Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Ensure technical governance of technologies being developed and partner with others to deliver end to end solutions. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $384,500 - $520,500

Our Team

The team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. They embody core leadership principles in their work and culture. The organization is a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

This individual takes ownership beyond their remit and does not wait for a clean, fully-scoped mandate before moving. They lead through strong managers, but do not hide behind them: when something needs fixing, they are just as likely to jump in and fix it themselves as they are to coach someone else through it. They think critically and move fast, comfortable making calls with incomplete information and adjusting as they learn more.

This person will thrive in this role if they get energy from operating across multiple different functions, some they know deeply, some they are learning as they go, and they are honest with themselves and others about which is which. Personally own and drive select high-priority workstreams and initiatives directly, not solely through delegation.

Manage a team of managers and individual contributors across functions, stepping in directly wherever the situation requires it.
Drive AI-native transformation across every function owned, including hands-on build where appropriate.

What You've Done

Led a multi-function technical or operational organization, managing managers across domains.
Owned outcomes, not just outputs. Achieved business impact like growth, efficiency, conversion, retention, not just dashboards or insights. This role will help shape the future of the company.

Built AI-native workflows or tooling that materially changed how a team or company operated, not incremental automation, but real step-function change in how work got done.

You prefer a role with a fully-defined, static scope; this organization and mandate are still being shaped, and will continue to shift based on where strengths land.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer / Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Principal Engineer / Director of Engineering

$250,000 - $275,000+ base + equity | San Francisco Bay Area | Predominantly in-person

SODA has partnered with a neurotechnology company developing software and medical technology used in brain health treatment. The first generation of the technology works and is already being used with patients. Your challenge is to decide what comes next.

This is a senior technical role for someone who wants architectural ownership, not a calendar dominated by people management. You’ll inherit a complex system spanning brain imaging, cloud infrastructure, distributed processing, algorithms and medical devices, then define its next generation.

The Opportunity

The initial application focuses on depression. The longer term technical challenge is building a modular architecture capable of supporting many future applications across neurological and psychiatric conditions.

You’ll work directly with the founders, remain close to the engineering and lead an initial team of around five engineers. The architecture isn’t predetermined. You’ll understand what exists, decide what needs to change and lead the work to build it.

What You'll Do

Build a technical understanding of the system from brain scan to stimulation
Define the architecture for the next generation of the technology
Architect an MVP designed to support multiple future clinical applications
Turn architectural decisions into a clear engineering roadmap
Lead execution while remaining close to difficult technical problems
Guide an initial engineering team of around five people
Partner with founders on major technical and product decisions

What You'll Bring

Essential:

Deep software engineering and architectural problem-solving ability
Experience designing complex cloud, distributed or data-intensive systems
Technical leadership experience while remaining close to engineering
Ability to understand interconnected systems and make sound architectural trade-offs

Desirable:

Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux and Python
Exposure to regulated software, healthcare or medical devices
Experience with imaging, MRI/DICOM, scientific computing or C#

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. The right mindset matters as much as the right CV.

What's In It For You

$275,000+ base salary plus equity
Ownership of an architecture that hasn't yet been defined
Direct technical partnership with the founding team
Complex engineering spanning software, compute, imaging and physical devices
Technology already being used to support patient treatment

Interested?

If you’re a Principal Engineer ready for broader technical ownership, or a Director who still wants to engineer, this role sits deliberately between those paths.

You’ll inherit something that works. The opportunity is to understand it, challenge it and architect what it becomes next.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Safety
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord only works at our scale if people feel safe showing up — and building the systems that make that possible is exactly what our Safety engineering org does.

We classify content, route reports, make and audit enforcement decisions, and build the tools our operations partners use to handle everything automation doesn't. The work is a mix of deep backend infrastructure, AI-driven automation, and tight collaboration with the people who do nuanced review. As Discord grows into new surfaces like commerce and ads, the platform we build matters more.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead Safety Infrastructure Engineering at Discord. The org is roughly 20 engineers across two teams with two EM direct reports. You'll report to the senior Director of Safety and work closely with T&S Operations, Safety ML, Safety Product, Legal, Policy, Security, and Core Tech.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow two engineering teams covering our safety backend: the decision platform, classification systems, content understanding, intake and routing pipelines, and observability
Drive the automation roadmap with Safety ML. Decide where AI belongs in the loop, where humans still win, and hold the line on quality, latency, and cost
Own the queue routing and internal tooling our ops teams and vendor partners rely on, and partner with T&S Operations on golden sets, QA, appeals, and evals that turn operational signal into better systems
Consolidate fragmented systems onto infra and set the bar for engineering quality: on-call, incident response, technical review, and ownership
Hire, coach, and grow senior leaders

Who You Are

5+ years as a software engineer with a strong backend and distributed systems background, and 5+ years as an EM including 2+ years managing managers. Experience running 20+ engineers through multiple EMs
Strong infrastructure instincts. You can hold your own in architecture discussions on event-driven systems, service migrations, and platform design
Fluent in AI and ML systems enough to partner credibly with an ML org and make good calls about where automation belongs in a decision pipeline
Experienced working closely with ops or human-in-the-loop teams. You get the rhythm of QA, calibration, appeals, and ground-truth work, and build tools that respect the people using them
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a history of partnering effectively across engineering, ML, data science, policy, legal, and product teams.
Practical about throughput, vendor management, and unit economics
An empathetic and experienced recruiter and coach. People you've managed want to work with you again

Bonus

A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the communities we serve.
Trust & Safety, fraud, integrity, or abuse engineering at a consumer platform
Building ML platforms, MLOps, or automated decisioning at scale
Managing vendor-based ops (BPO, content review, third-party tools), or building internal tools where ops or review teams are the primary user
Payments, fraud, or commerce infra

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $400,000 to $450,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
FIND YOUR MISSION

Missions are accomplished with people, driving towards a greater purpose. At ClearCo, our mission is to help our 3000+ clients achieve theirs. When talking to our own team of A players, you’ll find that it’s not only the opportunity to drive this mission forward that keeps us thriving. It’s the freedom, flexibility, and support ClearCo provides which contributes to our professional development and the pursuit of our personal missions and passions outside of work. Learn more about our state of the art, cloud-based talent platform and why you should consider joining us here.

SENIOR TECHNICAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER

Finding, engaging and retaining top talent is challenging in today’s work environment. We should know because we’ve been helping small and medium-sized businesses do just that through our unique talent management SaaS platform for almost twenty years. As a leader in talent management software, we’ve also learned a thing or two about what it takes to run an amazing company. So if you’re looking to join an organization that cares about its engineers, believes team collaboration is a better way to problem solve, and provides a supportive environment where you can advance your career, come join our engineering team at ClearCo! We’re a rapidly growing and financially stable company with a bright future and lots of opportunities.
The salary for this role will be between $175,000-$195,000 depending on experience.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, as a Senior Technical Software Engineering Manager at ClearCo, you will join our talented, collaborative, and inclusive engineering team to help grow our team’s capabilities to expand our best-in-class HR platform. Our team has a diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives, which has helped us build the amazing culture that we have today. That culture, along with our core value of “Listen to Many, Execute as One”, has enabled us to not only create an excellent technical platform but also an environment where everyone’s voice can be heard. We’re very proud of the culture we’ve built.
In this role, you will:

Lead the engineering team responsible for our Platform Architecture and Shared Services that span technologies, frameworks, and other components that contribute to the application development ecosystem.
Analyze existing systems and processes to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for improvements.
Contribute to long term vision and the strategy to achieve the vision for the technology organization.
Lead collaboration across technology teams to foster innovation and follow guidelines around re-usability of frameworks and governance of architecture patterns.
Own and drive the engineering roadmap for the Platform team as we modernize our architecture from monolithic to services-oriented to support rapid growth.
Coach, mentor, and provide performance feedback to direct reports to help them further develop their skills and guide them on their career paths.
Design, test, code, and instrument new solutions (work on POCs as needed).
Collaborate with senior management to establish team policies, develop resource plans, and evaluate individual performance.
Partner with Product Management, UX, and Tech Leads to drive product innovation and technical excellence
Foster a collaborative, high-performing engineering culture that emphasizes continuous learning and growth

WHAT WE'D LIKE YOU TO HAVE

SaaS Architecture Expertise & Decision Making
: 10+ years’ of experience involved in building and supporting SaaS products at scale, with the ability to quickly make difficult architectural and technical decisions.
Modernization Leadership
: Software-first leader with 5+ years of people leadership experience who has modernized legacy codebases and platforms from reactive operations to proactive platform engineering.
AI-First Development
: Well-versed in AI-assisted and AI-first development practices, with hands-on experience using AI platforms to accelerate development, testing, code reviews, and security scans. Embraces AI and its potential to transform how we deliver high-quality products to our clients.
Culture of Experimentation
: Fosters an engineering environment that challenges the status quo, values experimentation, and fast follow-ups. Fosters a collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning, mentorship, and innovation.
People and Project Management
: Possesses a track record of delivering complex projects on schedule while maintaining code quality and team well-being. Proven experience working with strong personalities, ensuring the team remains focused and on-track.

OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK

You’re probably wondering what we use for our tech stack, so we’ll list the major ones below.
Back-end: C#/.NET Core, Postgres, MySQL/Entity Framework, ElasticSearch, RabbitMQ, Redis
Front-end: React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Sass
AI tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude, Revo
Infrastructure: AWS using EC2, S3, Aurora...and the list goes on and on

WHAT YOU WILL LOVE ABOUT ClearCo

The people!
Our employees and customers consistently express the best thing about ClearCo is our close-knit, exceptionally talented team. Check out our G2 reviews to see what people are saying about our solutions.
A commitment to inclusion & belonging

Advance a partner and automation-enabled operating model.
