jobs.title: VP, Design - Virtual Expert Platform
jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit is a global platform company that is on a mission to power prosperity around the world for consumers and businesses. Across our leading brands – Turbo Tax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp
– Intuit serves over 100M customers and is one of the few companies in the world to have both a thriving consumer and business ecosystem. Intuit is known for its innovation track record, customer centricity, and its consistent recognition as a top place to work.

Intuit Customer Success (ICS) is evolving from a traditional support function into a core growth and experience engine for Intuit. As part of our AI-powered, services-led platform strategy, ICS orchestrates advanced AI capabilities and human expertise to deliver “done-for-you” experiences that drive revenue growth, deepen customer confidence, and strengthen long-term retention across the Intuit ecosystem. Powered by the world’s largest expert network and the Virtual Expert Platform (VEP)
, we are embedding AI + HI directly into the customer journey to create a durable competitive advantage.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an innovative, AI-native VP of Design
to provide executive leadership across ICS and VEP - the organization shaping how AI and human expertise work together to power a multi-billion-dollar services ecosystem and unlock an incremental $10B growth opportunity for Intuit.

This leader will ensure that our capabilities are delivered as a coherent platform while enabling high-impact, end-to-end service experiences through world-class service design. You will lead an integrated design organization spanning platform product design and service design—along with research, design technology, operations, and design labs - aligning platform capability development, embedded service experiences, and go-to-market strategy into a unified system that drives adoption and growth.

This isn’t just a leadership role; it is an opportunity to architect the future of AI-powered, expert-driven financial services and redefine how millions of customers access trusted expertise by leading the platform design for the intersection of AI + HI.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

This is a high-impact executive role where you will own the end-to-end design strategy for our global expert and customer experiences.

Platform Product Design: Lead the design for the core capabilities used widely across the Intuit ecosystem by both customers and experts.
Service Design Enablement: Orchestrate complex, end-to-end service journeys that connect consumers, small businesses, and accountants with experts in real-time. Drive service design across ICS to ensure AI and HI (Human Intelligence) experiences are cohesive, scalable, and effective across virtual and embedded models.
Vision & Strategy: Champion a bold, long-term vision for customer and experience experiences.
Design at Scale: Lead a massive design organization in building component libraries and design systems that power innovation across all Intuit offerings.
ICS Expert Studio Oversight: Oversee the Expert Studio that supports service adoption, business growth, and deep customer understanding.
Influence & Partner: Act as a strategic partner to key stakeholders across every segment of Intuit, balancing short-term execution with long-term Design-driven innovation.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and ICS leaders to define strategy and deliver end-to-end (E2E) experiences.
Inspire and Coach: Lead and grow a high-performance culture of designers, fostering a culture of innovation, creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Impact & Key Metrics

Platform Adoption: Measure the usability and effectiveness of VEP-powered experiences embedded across Intuit products.
Growth Outcomes: Drive increased customer engagement, confidence, and adoption of expert-led services.
AI + HI Effectiveness: Improve customer resolution rates and expert productivity through optimized AI-powered workflows.
Experience Quality: Deliver measurable improvements in clarity and consistency across all ICS service journeys.

Qualifications

We are looking for a dynamic, passionate leader who can thrive in a fast-paced, complex environment.

Platform Leadership: Deep experience designing and scaling end-to-end platform experiences that connect multiple products into a unified ecosystem, anchored by strong design systems.
Service Design: Lead service design experiences, tying together the entire ecosystem and all the invisible strings that make a customer’s experience work.
Design Craft & Holistic Design Approach: You bring a passion for design excellence, valuing interaction, visual, content, motion, and research - and know how to unify them into cohesive systems.
Customer-Obsession: You anchor strategy in customer needs and outcomes, balancing vision with measurable impact.
Strategic Leadership & Influence: Comfortable influencing across all levels of the organization with both, well-informed perspectives.
AI & Conversational Mastery: Familiarity with web, mobile, and conversational technologies and how they impact the feasibility of AI-driven design solutions.
Strategic Storytelling: Masterful ability to visualize complex concepts and articulate a strategic vision that inspires developers, partners, and customers alike.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

San Diego $338,000 - $457,500

jobs.title: VP Enterprise Technology
jobs.description:
Serena & Lily

VP, Enterprise Technology

Technology Leadership Role – Vice President Level |Full-Time | Remote

Serena & Lily is investing in its enterprise systems as a strategic priority — improving how the business plans, sources, manages product information, and operates across merchandising and finance. The VP, Enterprise Technology owns the systems and teams at the center of that effort: ERP (NetSuite), Merchandising, Planning, Product Information Management (PIM), FP&A, and the integrations connecting them to the digital channel and supply chain. Reporting to the SVP, Technology, this role provides a single accountable leader for the reliability, delivery, and ongoing evolution of this portfolio.
This is a people-first engineering leadership role. The VP builds and develops the team, partners deeply with Merchandising, Planning, and Pricing business leaders to understand process needs, and drives the implementation and ongoing support of the enterprise systems portfolio. Strong engineering judgment combined with genuine understanding of how these business domains work — and what good looks like for the business — is what defines success in this role.

Primary Responsibilities

Enterprise Systems Operations & Delivery

Own the delivery and ongoing support of the enterprise business application portfolio — ERP (NetSuite), Merchandising, Assortment Planning, PIM, and FP&A — partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate process requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.
Lead or participate in the evaluation, selection, and implementation of business systems — PLM, PIM, Assortment Planning, and FP&A tools — managing requirements, vendor assessment, integration design, and go-live execution in support of the company’s enterprise systems strategy.
Leverage and optimize agentic AI engines across the software delivery pipeline, building on what’s already been adopted and accelerating adoption across engineering.
Ensure reliability, data integrity, and security across enterprise systems and integrations; partner with DevOps / Infrastructure and Enterprise Architecture on observability, deployment pipelines, and environment management.
Contribute to the multi-year technology roadmap alongside Enterprise Architecture; participate in the technical evaluation and selection of software platforms, tools, and vendor partners — assessing architectural fit, integration complexity, and long-term supportability.

Engineering Leadership & Team Development

Lead, coach, and grow the Enterprise Systems engineering organization — spanning ERP, Merchandising and Planning systems, and business application integrations — building a capable, engaged team bench.
Develop engineering managers and technical leads; define clear roles, levels, and growth paths.
Cultivate an engineering culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.
Protect run-and-operate capacity for always-on business systems (NetSuite / ERP, Merchandising, Planning, PIM, and integrations) so project and implementation work does not starve operations.
Drive predictable delivery — improving throughput, release predictability, and first-time quality.
Own hiring, performance management, career development, leveling, and succession across the engineering function; set a high bar for technical excellence and accountability.
Own the engineering budget — headcount, tooling, vendor contracts, and capex / opex allocation — in partnership with Finance and the SVP, Technology.

Quality & Engineering Health

Partner with Quality Engineering to embed quality into engineering teams — agentic automated testing, clear definitions of done, and shared quality tooling — rather than relying on a downstream QA gate.
Establish and monitor engineering health metrics (delivery flow, defect rates, reliability, and technical debt).

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as the primary technology partner for Merchandising, Planning, and Finance / FP&A leaders — translating business process requirements into technical solutions, aligning on priorities, and driving the operability improvements that support the company’s strategic goals.
Collaborate with TechOps & Security, Data, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Serve as a senior escalation point for major production incidents affecting digital or enterprise systems.
Manage ongoing relationships with key technology vendors and partners — including contract renewals, roadmap alignment, and escalation — to protect platform continuity and leverage.

Measures of Success

Technical Depth & Craft: measurable growth in technical depth and craft across the organization — reflected in the complexity of systems teams can own and the consistency of modern engineering practices in everyday use.
Talent & Team Health: a deep, well-developed engineering bench with strong retention, engagement, and a healthy leadership pipeline.
Operational Reliability and Observability: high availability and performance across storefront, ERP, and infrastructure, with measurable progress in logging, alerting, and incident response through standardized observability tooling.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
15+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years leading engineering teams and managing managers at scale.
Proven track record building and developing high-performing engineering teams supporting business-critical applications, with demonstrated skill developing managers, growing talent, and creating accountability at scale.
Familiarity with modern application architecture (API-first, cloud-native, headless integrations) and how these patterns apply to connecting enterprise business systems with commerce and digital channels.
Experience participating in software and vendor selection — defining evaluation criteria, running structured assessments, and making build-vs-buy recommendations; familiarity with eCommerce compliance requirements including PCI-DSS and CCPA.
Strong command of modern cloud architecture (AWS preferred), CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and observability.
Deep experience with enterprise / ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred) and business applications in a retail or DTC context — including Merchandising, Assortment Planning, PIM, or FP&A platforms.
Experience leading or contributing to the implementation of business systems such as PLM, PIM, Assortment Planning, or FP&A platforms — including requirements gathering, vendor selection, integration design, and rollout.
Retail, consumer products, or DTC eCommerce experience strongly preferred.

Skills & Attributes

A leader who centralizes for commonality and leverage, not control — builds shared capability while keeping teams fast and autonomous.
Excellent people leader who develops talent, builds trust, and sets a high bar with empathy.
Strong systems thinker who balances run-the-business reliability with build-the-future delivery.
Clear communicator who translates fluently between engineering and business stakeholders.
Passionate about engineering craft, quality, and continuous improvement.

Compensation

$230-250k per year is the anticipated starting base pay for this role. This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range for this role. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as experience, education, and skills.
This role is eligible for performance-based bonus compensation and equity
Employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance should they choose to participate in Serena & Lily's benefits. Employees can enroll in our company's 401k plan. During the first year of employment, full-time employees accrue twenty-one days of PTO and seven paid holidays throughout the year.

Serena & Lily is a design-driven home furnishings company founded on the principle that beautiful, expertly crafted products should be accessible to all. We create furniture, bedding, lighting, and décor that elevates everyday life. With a commitment to quality, sustainability, and exceptional customer experience, we have grown into a beloved lifestyle brand trusted by customers across North America.

This role works with the division director to provide technical leadership, project oversight, and client engagement, while coordinating closely with a centralized Design Organization that provides engineering resources, staff management, and professional development.

Senior Engineering Managers ensure safe, high-quality project execution, help drive the division’s business growth, and maintain strong client relationships while leading project-based teams composed of matrixed engineering personnel.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution: Lead the execution of engineering projects to meet scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives. Define and manage project scope, deliverables, and execution strategy in coordination with Project/Program Managers. Direct multidisciplinary teams of matrixed engineering resources assigned to projects. Ensure integration and coordination across all engineering disciplines
Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and oversight across assigned projects. Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. Serve as the responsible engineering authority for project technical decisions. Drive resolution of complex technical challenges
Client Engagement & Business Development: Act as a primary client interface for engineering execution and technical matters. Build and maintain strong client relationships and trust. Support proposal development, scope definition, and technical positioning. Identify opportunities for repeat business and growth
Matrix Team Leadership: Lead and coordinate project-assigned engineering teams within a matrixed structure. Collaborate with Design Organization leadership on staffing, resource planning, and technical capability alignment. Provide project-specific direction, feedback, and performance input on assigned personnel. Foster a collaborative, high-performing project team environment

Engineering project execution

Client focus and relationship management
Project execution and accountability
Collaboration across matrixed teams

Communication and influence

jobs.description:

We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Associate Director, IT Commercial Sales Data and Analytics

Gilead Sciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that has pursued and achieved breakthroughs in medicine for more than three decades, with the goal of creating a healthier world for all people. The company is committed to pursuing scientific invention to prevent and treat life-threatening diseases, including HIV, Viral hepatitis and Cancer. Gilead has operations in more than 35 countries worldwide, with headquarters in Foster City, California.

You will be part of a team that is helping millions of people live healthier, more fulfilling lives. We are a close community where every individual matters and everyone has a chance to enhance their skills through ongoing development. Inclusion is one of our core values, which means we are creating and fostering a work environment where our differences are valued, and everyone feels respected and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. By joining Gilead, you will further our mission to discover, develop and deliver innovative therapeutics for people with life-threatening diseases.

The role is based in the Gilead Business Services center in Raleigh’s Research Triangle region, home to some of the company’s critical shared service teams in North America, including Information Technology, Global Financial Solutions, HR Operations and Procurement Services Desk. These functions provide the necessary support to ensure Gilead’s business runs effectively and efficiently. The center will also be a catalyst for standardization of processes, digital transformation and technology optimization.

Summary

The Associate Director, IT Commercial and Sales Analytics role within the Enterprise Data and Analytics organization, is a leadership role accountable for Commercial Stakeholder engagements, timely and consistent delivery of operational data management, reporting, dashboards and applications to Gilead US Commercial, Sales Analytics & Operations, Data Strategy & Governance and other Field facing and HQ teams and stakeholders. Successful candidates will possess a combination of Commercial process knowledge, cloud data technology management and multiple IT vendors management experience.

Initiatives led during a typical year, include Data & Analytics Operational delivery effectiveness improvements, Cloud transformation initiatives, Commercial Product Launch analytics support and other data strategy projects, to enhance US Commercial Sales and Analytics organization’s data and analytics effectiveness. The role also works with Commercial IT leadership in data and analytics roadmap development and horizontal IT data management and analytics tools portfolio streamlining. This position will direct additional IT and Vendor resources as required and creates influence network across diverse functional groups, including Gilead Commercial and IT functions.

Leadership & Program management

This role needs to drive key data & analytics initiatives and transformation programs, support product launches and should manage cross functional program milestones
Deep Financial expertise of managing budgets of complex programs
Drive demand and roadmap planning working with business to generate business cases and generate ROI frameworks with Commercial business stakeholders including US Sales Analytics, Data Strategy & Governance, Incentive Compensation, Commercial forecasting and other organizations
Deep cross functional collaboration within IT (Commercial IT, Platforms, iOS applications, Enterprise Architecture, etc.) is needed to be successful in this role

Manage Devops and delivery teams for data and analytics to the above Commercial teams
Lead several POCs at Gilead to enhance the future state of technology stack at Gilead, advance operational efficiency including advanced analytics initiatives

Manages Projects and understand business implications on using right architecture components addressing cross technology issues

Manage and navigate complex global vendor ecosystem at Gilead including vendors CTS, HCL, ZS, Accenture, etc

Understand and improvise Gilead DevOps processes and systems including Gilead-DnA Platform’s Commercial data & analytics account standards, methods & tools management

Cultivate strong business relationships and effectively communicate with US Sales Analytics Leaders (20+ Cross functional stake holders in Commercial business)

Bachelor's Degree and ten+ years of work experience OR Master's Degree and eight+ years of work experience

10+ years supporting Commercial Pharma Sales Analytics and Operations processes
8+ years of experience with data management and analytics tools and technologies; AWS Cloud DevOps experience is preferred
5+ years managing technology and analytics vendor support teams
PMP, Scrum Master, CSPO, ITIL, ICP-ACC Six Sigma SME or other equivalent certifications

AWS Cloud and Databricks architecture and services
Integration technologies Like Informatica, Dell Boomi etc
Salesforce, Veeva, Teradata and other Pharma applications
Proficiency with query languages, such as SQL and or Python
Visualization and reporting tools like Tableau, MicroStrategy

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Plant Control
jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

Why This Role Matters

A Fusion power plant only produces useful results if something can control it, observe it, and make sense of what it did. The means firmware on the controllers that fire the pulses, supervisory automation that coordinates the machine as a system, the network and infrastructure backbone, and data pipelines that capture events spanning nanoseconds to years. The machine and facility are first of their kind, which means the software is too.

You will lead and scale the team that builds it. This means more than just hiring the right people. It means establishing software engineering as a core functional discipline by creating processes that enable the team to do their best work and building the structure around how software and hardware teams interact at Helion.

What You Will Be Doing

Lead and grow the Plant Control Software team, a multidisciplinary team across firmware, application software, networking, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
Own delivery of the plant control software stack across its embedded, supervisory, networking, and data layers.
Partner closely with electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fuel cycle, systems engineering, operations, and science. Our software ships against hardware on a shared schedule and the coordination across those boundaries is a core responsibility.
Establish the engineering principles that will be the foundation for this team as it grows including how it plans, reviews, tests, deploys, responds to faults, and hands off to operations.

Required Skills

10+ years of experience building complex control systems for hardware 3+ years of experience in a leadership role building and managing a multidisciplinary software team (software engineers, firmware/embedded engineers, with a diversity of level from early career to senior).
Depth in real-time, embedded, or control software for physical systems, sufficient to hold technical direction with a senior team.
A track record of delivering software against hardware on a shared schedule in an environment where the hardware is the product.
Experience hiring, and growing engineers over time.
The ability to work fluently across disciplinary boundaries with electrical engineers, mechanical engineers, systems engineers, operators, and scientists.
A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

Our total compensation package includes benefits, including but not limited to:

Medical, Dental, and Vision plans for employees and their families
31 Days of PTO (21 vacation days and 10 sick days)
10 Paid holidays, plus company-wide winter break
Up to 5% employer 401(k) match
Short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance
Paid parental leave and support (up to 16 weeks)
Annual wellness stipend

Helion is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Compensation Range: $250K - $290K

jobs.title: VP of Technology - Head Architect, TurboTax
jobs.description:
Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Architecture for Consumer Platform
Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Ensure technical governance of technologies being developed and partner with others to deliver end to end solutions. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $384,500 - $520,500

jobs.title: Sr Manager, IT Data Engineering
jobs.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Job Description Summary:

The Delivery Lead for Kite represents a unique opportunity within the IT Data & AI Center of Excellence (CoE) to drive the adoption of Data, Analytics, and AI capabilities that accelerate Kite's mission of delivering life-changing therapies to patients.

You will serve as the primary technical leader aligned to the G&A business function, including Finance, Procurement, IT Services, and other enterprise operations, driving business outcomes through hands-on execution and multidisciplinary expertise. In this role, you will build and deliver production-grade solutions, work directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into clear technical approaches, and operate with speed and agility in complex, fast-paced environments. This role requiring strong technical depth, credibility with senior stakeholders, industry expertise, and an entrepreneurial mindset to navigate ambiguity, solve complex challenges, and deliver sustained business impact over time.

Responsibilities

Architecture & Strategy

Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions across a cloud environment, including AWS and Databricks.
Define and enforce data engineering standards, best practices, and architectural patterns.
Collaborate with a highly motivated team to evaluate and integrate emerging technologies that enhance the capabilities of the data platform.

Data Engineering

Design, develop, and maintain ELT pipelines using AWS services, Apache Airflow, and Databricks.
Drive platform evolution by identifying opportunities for AI-powered automation and implementing solutions that improve data workflows and operational efficiency.
Manage the development and maintenance of data models and schema designs to support efficient data storage, processing, and retrieval.
Lead schema evolution and data integration processes across source systems and target platforms.
Serve as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and business partners by addressing technical inquiries and providing strategic guidance.

Governance & Quality

Implement and maintain robust data governance, security, and compliance frameworks.
Ensure data quality, security, and integrity through effective validation, cleansing, testing, monitoring, and issue-resolution processes.
Establish data quality metrics, service-level agreements (SLAs), and monitoring mechanisms to ensure the reliability and trustworthiness of enterprise data assets.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements related to data privacy, security, and retention.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

3–6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and deploying data pipeline solutions at scale. At least 2+ years of experience building complex data science, AI/ML, or large-scale analytics solutions.

Programming

Proficiency in Python and SQL; familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript or a systems programming language such as Go or Rust. Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering best practices.

CI/CD & Infrastructure

Experience with CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions), containerization technologies (Docker), infrastructure-as-code principles, and cloud-native architecture patterns.

Cloud Platforms

Hands-on experience building and operating data and AI platforms on AWS, including services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Bedrock, and Databricks Unity Catalog. Experience designing secure, scalable, and production-grade cloud architectures is preferred.

Data & BI Technologies

Proficiency with Databricks (Spark), data orchestration platforms (Airflow), Tableau, Genie Spaces, and related business intelligence and analytics technologies.

AI/Agent Tools

jobs.title: VP of Technology - Head Architect, TurboTax
jobs.description:
Overview

We are the largest provider of tax preparation software and services with TurboTax serving ~35M households and over 140M members trust Credit Karma with their financial profile. We're searching for an experienced, innovative VP of Technology (Engineering) leader - as a Head Architect - who has deep SaaS experience delivering new products and experiences to the market that will be loved by millions of users. In this role, the leader will lead the Consumer Platform that enables Intuit to power the prosperity of consumers by serving their needs at various points in their financial journey, from tax to credit to saving on expenses to access to money and growing wealth. Consumer Platform, oriented around the pillars of Tax, Personal Finance, and Money, will focus on helping consumers lift the burden of tax prep with AI and assisted tax prep and lay the foundation to create a year-round relationship centered on money benefits, financial products, and financial guidance.

Consumer Platform is powered by world-class Tax (TurboTax and ProTax) and Credit Karma capabilities. This leader will propel a high-performing team to its next phase of growth. This individual will rely on their business acumen, strategic thinking, hands-on technical/coding experience, AI proficiency and experience, and data skills to drive customer and business outcomes at scale. They will be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, balancing precision with speed. They will leverage their expertise to guide and inspire the team, attract, and develop top talent, and be both a business leader and technology leader.

What You'll Do Here

We are looking for a Head Architect - Vice President, Technology, to lead architecture for the Consumer Platform. We are looking for a leader that has a passion for solving e2e problems for developers and customers. This role will report to the SVP of Engineering
As a hands-on technical leader, you will own and drive the overall architecture for Consumer Platform by translating business strategy into a durable technology strategy, with a deeper focus and ownership of Tax Platform capabilities. You will do so in close partnership with business leadership, Tax and Credit Karma PD teams, functional teams and broader Intuit TechEcosystem
Be the talent stewards of Distinguished Engineers and Principal Engineers in the organization by defining their focus areas in partnership with PD leadership and coaching them

Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Architecture for Consumer Platform
Define and drive the technology strategy for Consumer Platform by partnering with Business Leadership and broader Intuit TechEcosystem to accelerate the business growth aspirations. Ensure technical governance of technologies being developed and partner with others to deliver end to end solutions. Evaluate solution designs to confirm technical feasibility, alignment with business objectives, and incorporation of critical non-functional requirements. Use, integrate, identify gaps and propose solutions across all technology assets in the company to ensure we have a cohesive platform. Emphasize development of AI Native solutions which leverage AI to the fullest extent to deliver customer benefit

Boundaryless Collaboration
Able to operate in a complex org structure and collaborating with multiple stakeholders globally. Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize roadmaps, requirements, balancing business needs with financial and technology constraints. Establish alignment of vision, strategy & delivery working with cross-functional teams (PM, PD, XD, Care..) and stakeholders, including senior leaders across geographies.

Operational & Engineering Excellence
Establish and improve engineering and operational excellence efforts across the Consumer Platform that drive a productive environment for developers and high availability for our customers. Result-oriented and deliver huge outcomes. Sets clear objectives and goals for the team and enables the team to deliver and use operating mechanisms to continually assess progress and improve. Establishes the data driven processes needed to achieve operational & engineering excellence. Foster Engineering culture within the team and across organizations.

Build a high-performance culture
Grow and coach engineering talent, acts as a talent magnet to attract, nurture and retain senior talent including Engineering Directors, managers, engineers, and architects. Develops and drives strategy to hire, develop and mobilize talent for the organization.

Speed as a Habit
Can operate in a fast-moving environment, make quick data driven customer backed decisions and execute fiercely to deliver outcomes.

Customer Obsession
Is a staunch advocate for the developers and customers. Stays close to customer problems and solves for them with urgency.

Qualifications

15+ years of product and platform development experience with BS/MS in computer science or equivalent
3+ years in a leadership, managing and coaching globally distributed teams and influencing third party technology strategy
Demonstrated outstanding craft delivering SaaS at scale
Demonstrated experience and expertise is developing full stack applications across multiple areas from architecture, services, applications, data, analytics, AI and marketing technologies
Demonstrated ability to deliver customer outcomes with AI and data powered experiences
Track record of developing high performing organizations and working in a highly collaborative environment across multiple organizations
Demonstrated to operate with high level objectives and deliver with velocity
Demonstrated ability to deliver bold, innovative outcomes
Demonstrated ability to drive big transformations - organizational, technology, business outcomes. Able to operate strategically and tactically in the details
Exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to identify patterns and opportunities across a complex ecosystem of products and services
Have a firm understanding of systems engineering and high-availability design.
Experience in operating at different levels of altitude across the entire software development lifecycle
Skilled in creating strong partnerships, influencing stakeholders, and driving business outcomes across data, product, marketing, and sales
Demonstrates ability to research & learn new technologies and business processes independently and apply them as needed.
Passion for facilitative leadership, collaboration and lead teams across boundaries.
Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate at all levels - from front line engineers to senior leaders and executive leadership

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Mountain View $384,500 - $520,500

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

CorpTech Platform is the internal engineering force multiplier behind Anduril's corporate systems.

It drives CorpTech engineering forward through strategic investment in data platforms, software platforms, QA and release excellence, ERP engineering, and AI infrastructure.

We build the foundations that power both CorpOS, enabling Finance and Growth to operate with speed and precision, and ArsenalOS, the digital backbone of Anduril's hardware enterprise. By unifying systems, accelerating development velocity, and embedding intelligence into every layer, CorpTech Platform transforms how the company operates end to end.

We are also driving Anduril toward becoming an autonomous enterprise. Through initiatives like the Autonomous Software Factory, we are rethinking how software is built, tested, deployed, and evolved by integrating AI directly into the engineering lifecycle. CorpTech Platform is how Anduril scales its business systems with the same rigor, speed, and adaptability as its mission critical products.

About The Job

The Director of Site Reliability Engineering owns the reliability system for the software that runs Anduril's business and manufacturing operations. This role leads the SRE organization and partners with software engineering leaders to make availability, resilience, performance, and production readiness shared engineering outcomes. The mandate extends beyond responding well when systems fail: it is to reduce the frequency and impact of failure through sound architecture, durable infrastructure, clear service ownership, and disciplined operating mechanisms.

You will set the portfolio-wide reliability strategy, build the team and leadership structure required to execute it, and give senior leaders a clear view of operational risk and investment choices. The strongest candidate will combine deep technical judgment with organizational leadership and will know when to establish a common standard, when to build a shared capability, and when to enable an engineering team to own the solution directly.

What You'll Do

Build and lead the Site Reliability Engineering organization, including hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and development of managers and senior technical leaders.
Own the reliability strategy for CorpTech Platform's production portfolio, translating operational risk and business criticality into a sequenced roadmap of engineering and infrastructure investments.
Establish shared accountability between SRE and software engineering through clear service ownership, SLOs, production-readiness standards, on-call expectations, and escalation mechanisms.
Set direction for observability, deployment safety, incident management, capacity planning, resilience, and disaster recovery across business-critical systems and shared infrastructure.
Partner with engineering, product, security, and business operations leaders to make informed trade-offs between delivery speed, reliability, cost, and long-term platform health.
Lead the organizational response to critical incidents, ensure communication and decision-making remain effective under pressure, and hold teams accountable for durable post-incident improvements.
Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil by turning cross-system failure patterns into platform capabilities, automation, architectural changes, and clearer ownership boundaries.
Define meaningful reliability measures and operating reviews that expose systemic risk, guide investment decisions, and demonstrate progress without incentivizing superficial compliance.
Create a healthy on-call system with the staffing, tooling, training, and management support required to sustain reliable services without normalizing burnout or heroics.
Establish reliability practices for AI-enabled systems, including appropriate observability, evaluation, degradation, and fallback mechanisms for non-deterministic production behavior.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, production engineering, infrastructure engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline, including significant experience leading engineering teams and managers.
Demonstrated success leading an SRE, infrastructure, or production engineering organization accountable for a diverse portfolio of business-critical systems at meaningful scale.
Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, performance management, organizational design, and development of managers and senior individual contributors.
Deep technical fluency across distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, networking, storage, observability, deployment systems, and the failure modes of each layer.
Experience establishing SLOs, production-readiness standards, incident management systems, on-call practices, and operational maturity mechanisms across multiple engineering teams.
Track record of improving reliability through systemic engineering investments and shared accountability with software engineering rather than relying on reactive support or manual controls.
Demonstrated ability to assess operational and business risk, prioritize investments across competing needs, and lead effectively through complex production incidents.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior engineers, executive leadership, and cross-functional partners.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading reliability for enterprise, manufacturing, or other operationally critical systems with complex dependencies and varied service maturity.
Experience building or scaling an SRE organization in a hyper growth environment while improving both service health and engineering velocity.
Experience operating in a federated engineering model in which reliability standards and shared capabilities must influence teams outside the direct reporting line.
Familiarity with AI-enabled production systems, including observability, evaluation, safeguards, and graceful degradation for non-deterministic behavior.
Experience with enterprise systems and business process domains such as ERP, MES, WMS, CRM, finance systems, or manufacturing systems.
Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Division Director, Safeguards and Security Technology Division (SSTD)
jobs.description:
Requisition Id 16926

Overview:

The National Security Sciences Directorate (NSSD) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) seeks applicants for the position of Division Director for the Safeguards and Security Technology Division (SSTD). Reporting to the NSSD Associate Laboratory Director (ALD), the Division Director is responsible for leading and managing the Division's science and technology (S&T) capabilities, ensuring excellence in current mission execution while establishing and implementing a strategic vision for increased impact for national security.

SSTD is comprised of multidisciplinary scientists, engineers, and mission-focused professionals who advance the scientific and technical foundations of nuclear safeguards and security. The Division develops innovative technologies and operational solutions that enable U.S. government agencies to strengthen the security and safeguards of nuclear and radiological materials in the U.S. and around the world, ultimately enhancing U.S. national security.

SSTD also develops and applies advanced software and digital capabilities to support nonproliferation and nuclear security missions, including information management systems, data collection and analysis platforms, nuclear material tracking systems, and modeling and simulation tools that inform operational decision-making and policy.

The Division collaborates extensively across ORNL and the broader DOE complex to advance technologies and approaches supporting nuclear safeguards, security, treaty verification spanning the nuclear fuel cycle and radiological operations. SSTD maintains internationally recognized expertise in safeguards and security technologies, implementation methodologies, and integrated safeguards concepts applicable across the full spectrum of nuclear fuel cycle activities.

Major Duties/Responsibilities:

Provide leadership that focuses and integrates Division capabilities toward world-class S&T goals consistent with the programmatic missions of NSSD and the Laboratory
Collaborate with management peers to assist the ALD in defining and implementing strategic programmatic R&D missions for NSSD and the Laboratory
Represent ORNL before advisory committees
Emphasize the scientific productivity, impact, and reputation of SSTD and engagement of staff in professional organizations
Ensure the Division executes projects and delivers outcomes consistent with commitments on budget and schedule
Execute line management responsibilities including supervision of Division leadership, budget and business planning, salary planning, staff recruitment and development, employee relations, and performance management
Build Division capabilities by attracting a quality, diverse pool of top candidates, and hire staff members who are committed to world-class R&D and aspire to be the best in their field
Foster a diverse and inclusive work environment where every employee feels safe, heard, and appreciated
Serve as the Division work authority, striving to implement a culture within the workplace that is attentive to the identification of hazards and responsive to providing controls and processes to address the hazards

Basic Qualifications:

Qualified candidates will have a Ph.D. in engineering, the physical sciences, or related technical fields
At least 12 years of experience focused on nuclear nonproliferation within an R&D environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Strong leadership and business management skills with a proven track record of communication through technical publications, development and execution of an R&D vision and strategy

Preferred Qualifications:

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills that can interact effectively with a broad spectrum of people and issues in a fast-paced environment that spans R&D
Ability to function well in a fast-paced research environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to ever changing needs
Focused delivery on the operational missions of nonproliferation sponsors

Special Requirements:

Visa sponsorship: Visa sponsorship is not available for this position
Security, Credentialing, and Eligibility Requirements: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance from the Department of Energy. As such, this position is a Workplace Substance Abuse (WSAP) testing designated position. WSAP positions require passing a pre-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program. In addition, due the SCI, you may also be subject to random polygraph testing.

About ORNL:

jobs.title: Director Infrastructure & Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

The Director, Technology Operations is responsible for leading critical production operations functions that ensure the availability, stability, resiliency, and operational excellence of the bank's technology ecosystem. This role oversees three core operational domains: 24x7 Enterprise Batch Operations, L1 Infrastructure & Application Monitoring and Incident Response, and L2 Infrastructure Support Services.

This leader will play a key role in advancing operational maturity, resiliency, observability, incident management, automation, and service reliability. The position will help drive the consolidation and modernization of multiple command center and technology operations functions into a unified Technology Operations organization capable of providing consistent 24x7 support across infrastructure, applications, and enterprise batch processing.

This role requires a leader with deep technical and operational experience, strong organizational leadership capabilities, and a demonstrated track record of driving operational transformation in complex, highly regulated environments.

This is a highly visible, executive-facing leadership position with regular interaction across senior technology leadership, business executives, risk management, audit, and regulatory stakeholders. The successful candidate must possess exceptional written and verbal communication skills, executive presence, and strategic thinking capabilities. The individual must be capable of translating complex operational and technical issues into concise business impacts, risks, and actions while maintaining confidence and alignment among senior stakeholders during both routine operations and high-severity incidents.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Batch Operations

Lead the bank's Batch Processing Support organization responsible for the continuous monitoring and support of enterprise batch processing across distributed, mainframe, and IBM i (AS/400) environments.

This role is accountable for the operational execution, monitoring, incident response, and support functions that ensure successful enterprise batch processing.

Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for 24x7 monitoring and operational support of critical batch processing workloads.
Ensure successful execution of daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end processing cycles.
Drive timely detection, triage, escalation, communication, and resolution of batch processing disruptions.
Maintain operational readiness procedures, support playbooks, escalation models, and recovery processes supporting business-critical processing.
Partner closely with Application Owners, Application Support teams, and Control-M Engineering to improve processing observability, reliability and operational effectiveness.
Coordinate enterprise response and recovery activities for critical batch failures, delays, dependency issues, and processing exceptions.
Establish and maintain operational metrics covering processing reliability, SLA attainment, incident response, and issue resolution performance.

L1 Infrastructure & Application Monitoring Operations

Lead first-line operational support functions responsible for enterprise monitoring, event management, production awareness, and incident response.

Responsibilities

Oversee enterprise monitoring and command center functions supporting infrastructure, applications, and critical business services.
Ensure timely identification, triage, engagement, escalation, and communication of technology events and service disruptions.
Lead operational teams responsible for event management, alert response, incident engagement, and stakeholder communications.
Drive improvements in monitoring effectiveness, alert quality, event correlation, operational workflows, and response procedures.
Partner with infrastructure, application, and engineering teams to improve observability and end-to-end service visibility.
Establish governance and operational metrics focused on reducing MTTD, improving service awareness, and strengthening operational responsiveness.
Support implementation of automation and tooling improvements that increase operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Coordinate seamlessly with India-based operational partners to provide consistent 24x7 support coverage and effective follow-the-sun operations.

L2 Infrastructure Support Services

Lead U.S.-based Level 2 Infrastructure Support teams responsible for restoration, troubleshooting, escalation support, and operational ownership across critical technology domains, including Network Services, Server Infrastructure, Middleware Platforms, Database Services, Storage Platforms, and Backup & Recovery Services.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership, oversight, and operational governance for global L2 infrastructure support functions.
Ensure timely diagnosis and restoration of services during infrastructure-related incidents.
Partner with engineering organizations to improve platform supportability, operational readiness, resiliency, and service stability.
Drive standardization of support processes, knowledge management, operational procedures, and escalation practices.
Improve support effectiveness through automation, process optimization, tooling enhancements, and operational maturity initiatives.
Coordinate seamlessly with India-based operational partners to provide consistent 24x7 support coverage and effective follow-the-sun operations.

Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience in Complex leadership and management responsibilities in an Infrastructure and Operations Enterprise environment OR High School Diploma or GED and 12 years of experience in Complex leadership and management responsibilities in an Infrastructure and Operations Enterprise environment
Proven experience leading large-scale 24x7 operational support organizations.
Deep understanding of enterprise batch processing environments utilizing Control-M or equivalent technologies.
Experience supporting distributed, mainframe, and IBM i (AS/400) technology environments.
Strong knowledge of infrastructure operations, production support, monitoring, observability, incident management, and service restoration processes.
Demonstrated success leading operational transformation, organizational maturity, or command center modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of ITIL disciplines, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Event Management.
Experience working within highly regulated environments, preferably financial services.

jobs.title: Head of Emerging Technology Scouting & Incubation
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us! Start your next chapter and join EMD Electronics.

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Everything we do in EMD Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We are dedicated to being the trusted supplier of high-tech materials, services and specialty chemicals for the electronics, automotive and cosmetics industries. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Location:

The Head of Emerging Technology Scouting & Incubation is an on-site position located at one of the EMD Electronics US sites, remote may be considered. Domestic and international travel is required to meet business needs.

Your Role

As Head of Emerging Technology Scouting & Incubation (ETSI), you will expand Electronics‘ innovation space by understanding emerging technology needs, identifying high-potential opportunity areas, and incubating them into validated business cases ready for Business Unit transition. You will lead frontier technology scouting across materials and beyond-materials domains, manage internal and external proof-of-concepts (POCs), and own technical due diligence for strategic M&A targets. Your leadership will drive impactful external partnerships/research collaborations (JDAs), incubators that translate into new product introductions (NPI), and a strong early-stage pipeline. You will architect technology roadmaps, drive the Frontier Technology Board, and partner with internal stakeholders to translate emerging technology insights into new revenue streams and competitive advantage. You will use a clear process with defined priorities, milestones, and responsibilities to move ideas from technology scouting and POCs to validated business cases and successful handover to the relevant Business Units.

Key Responsibilities

Identify emerging opportunity areas in industry technology roadmaps: map technology inflection points, materials opportunities, and risks across Electronics markets; monitor external signals (startups, academia, suppliers, consortia, patent trends) to spot high-potential emerging technologies poised for impact.
Validate opportunity areas through best-fit external / internal proof-of-concepts (e.g. JDAs, incubators): define success criteria, metrics, and go/no-go decision thresholds; oversee early-stage incubators/POCs leveraging internal resources, external collaborations, and incubators.
Identify frontier tech M&A targets & own technical due diligence (thought partner to M-Ventures and M&A team): assess targets operating in BU-adjacent spaces or outside existing BU businesses; deliver structured technical assessments and integration readiness plans to inform investment decisions.
Tech steering for Electronics BU Business Development teams (e.g., Future Optical Technologies, Advanced Packaging): align scouting outputs with BU strategic goals, technology roadmaps, and innovation horizons; provide technology foresight to guide BU investment decisions.
Drive Business Development for emerging technology that goes beyond Business Unit horizons/scope: identify cross-domain opportunities, new market adjacencies, and potential revenue streams outside current BU portfolios; partner with M-Ventures and business stakeholders to explore build/partner/buy options.
Drive operations and impact of the Frontier Technology Board, shaping and driving its objectives, agenda, engagement model and participants.
Foster ecosystem building by liaising with internal groups (R&D and M-Ventures) and external partners to advance emerging technology pathfinding.
Assess R&D capabilities, identify gaps, and define actions to realize EL’s long-term technology vision while championing science-driven decision making, rapid experimentation, and responsible innovation.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications:

Master degree in Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar discipline with 8+ years of experience in technology scouting, R&D leadership, and/or corporate development with a track record of leading successful incubations, POCs, or M&A technical due diligence

Or

PhD in Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar discipline with 6+ years of experience in technology scouting, R&D leadership, and/or corporate development with a track record of leading successful incubations, POCs, or M&A technical due diligence
Deep understanding of electronics, optoelectronics, packaging, advanced materials, semiconductor processes, or related frontier technologies.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate insights into tangible business value and clear ROI.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence at the executive level, and manage complex programs with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years of experience in technology scouting, R&D leadership, in the electronics industry.
Track record of conducting rigorous technical assessments of emerging technologies, evaluating IP quality, competitive differentiation, and feasibility for acquisition or partnership.
Experience designing and managing early-stage technology incubation programs, including setting success criteria, managing rapid learning cycles, and making disciplined go/no-go decisions.
Proven experience leading technical due diligence for corporate acquisitions or partnerships, assessing technology risk, integration complexity, and value creation potential.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams spanning technical, business development, and strategic functions to advance frontier technology initiatives.
Comfort using market data, technical metrics, and portfolio analytics to prioritize opportunity areas and make investments in emerging technology exploration.
Strong understanding of how emerging technologies translate to business value, market opportunity, and revenue potential; ability to build business cases for frontier exploration investments.

What we offer:
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
