ABOUT BEST BRANDS

Best Brands is a consumer goods importer and wholesaler supplying major U.S. retail accounts including Dollar Tree, Walmart, Amazon, Publix, and TJX. We operate a fast-moving supply chain with a lean, high-ownership team — the people who join us run their domains, not just their tasks.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Best Brands is seeking a Director of IT who operates at the intersection of systems and operations. You’ll directly oversee a growing IT department with ability to develop a functional team.
This role is a Sr. Doer role that will own the full technology stack powering our import supply chain — from hardware and network infrastructure to ERP configuration and EDI connectivity, as well as 3PL integrations, BI reporting, and workflow automation.
You don't wait to be told – you identify the gap, build the fix, and document it. You can hold a technical conversation with a developer and a business conversation with a VP in the same afternoon, and you treat EDI rejections and data anomalies like puzzles rather than problems. You've lived the importer calendar — CRDs, ship windows, DC compliance, and the cost of a missed ASN — and you build systems that outlast your involvement.
You will also be the internal authority on ERP owning data integrity, process flags, user configuration, and diagnostic troubleshooting — while also leading the build-out of our BI and forecasting infrastructure. The right candidate is self-directed, thrives in a fast-moving importer environment, and can translate technical complexity into operational clarity for cross-functional stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

IT Infrastructure

·      Own and maintain company-wide IT infrastructure — servers, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments — ensuring uptime, scalability, and security across all sites and the 3PL/warehouse footprint.
·      Manage LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity to support ERP, EDI, and warehouse operations, including reliable links to 3PL partners.
·      Establish and enforce network security, access controls, backup/disaster recovery, and business continuity policies to protect data and minimize downtime.
·      Oversee vendor and ISP relationships, hardware/software procurement, and infrastructure budgeting, while planning capacity for growth across retail accounts.

ERP Management (Cold Lion)

·      Serve as the internal subject matter expert and system owner for ERP.
·      Manage system configuration, workflow controls, and automation triggers, user permissions, and system settings.
·      Lead diagnostics and root-cause analysis on data issues, workflow failures, and integration errors.
·      Partner with IT to scope and execute system upgrades, patches, and new module rollouts.
·      Build and maintain documentation for all ERP processes and configurations.
EDI & Integrations

·      Own end-to-end EDI operations — including 850, 856 ASN, 810, and 940/945 transaction sets.
·      Troubleshoot and resolve EDI rejections, mapping errors, and trading partner compliance issues.
·      Manage API integrations between Cold Lion, 3PLs, retail portals, and BI tools.
·      Drive automation initiatives that eliminate manual touchpoints in daily workflows.

3PL Partner Management

·      Serve as the primary systems liaison to multi-site 3PLs.
·      Own WMS connectivity, inbound/outbound data flows, and inventory reconciliation between ERP and 3PL.
·      Support onboarding and migration activities — including current Geodis-to-Westmark transition.
·      Drive escalations and system-level issue resolution directly with 3PL IT and operations teams.
Reporting, BI & Forecasting

·      Lead the design and build of BI infrastructure using ERP as the primary data source and steering development partners.
·      Own rolling operating forecast (ROF) tooling and data pipelines from ERP to reporting layer.
·      Build and maintain dashboards and reports for supply chain KPIs, inventory, fulfillment, and vendor performance.
·      Evaluate and implement AI-assisted tools to improve forecast accuracy and operational decision-making.
Daily Operations & Workflow

·      Support daily importer workflows: PO management, ASN generation, inbound tracking, and inventory receipts.
·      Act as a cross-functional resource for operations, procurement, and logistics teams on system-related issues.
·      Build and enforce SOPs for ERP data entry, EDI submission, and 3PL communication protocols.

WHAT TO BRING

Required

·      8-12 years of experience in IT infrastructure, ERP administration, supply chain systems, EDI, and IT operations in an import/wholesale environment.
·      IT systems and infrastructure experts with ability to maintain on-premises and cloud-based environments.
·      Microsoft O365 systems’ architecture and application management are a must.
·      ERP management experience in an import supply chain context is needed – Cold Lion or comparable ERP experience is helpful.
·      Hands-on EDI experience — transaction-level fluency with 850, 856, 860, 810, 940, 945 and trading partner onboarding.
·      Direct experience working with 3PL partners on WMS integration, inventory sync, and data reconciliation.
·      Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading logs, tracing data flows, and owning resolutions end-to-end.
·      Experience building and managing ERP standard reporting and BI reporting tools connected to ERP data sources.
·      Demonstrated ability to work directly with IT, external vendors, managed services, and non-technical stakeholders — without a layer of management in between.
Preferred

·      Cold Lion ERP experience (or comparable WMS/ERP in an import supply chain context).
·      Familiarity with 3PL, WMS, TMS operating environments.
·      Experience with EDI/API development or management (REST/JSON).
·      Exposure to AI/ML/LLM tooling applied to forecasting, demand planning, or workflow automation.
·      Key retail account experience — Dollar Tree, Walmart, Amazon, Publix, TJX, etc. a plus.

Job Description

Location:

New York, NY

Director of Engineering, Publishing Platform

Condé Nast is a global media company producing the world's most iconic lifestyle, journalism, and fashion brands. We aim to inspire, inform and entertain our audiences through our portfolio of well known brands such as Vogue, Wired, Vanity Fair, Architectural Digest, GQ and many other leading brands.

We are on a journey with the major transformation of teams and systems: organizing for speed, ownership and customer focus with smaller, independent teams, and being AI native in how we work. Engineering is responsible for building, deploying and scaling the experiences that serve our audiences globally across brands, and the consumer-facing surface of that is evolving to meet our audience’s needs.

About The Role

The Publishing Platform engineering team builds and operates the systems our editors and brand teams rely on every day: our content management system, rights management, editorial planning, and the content APIs that serve our brand experiences globally across more than 70 sites. It is a genuinely multi-tenant platform and its customers are internal: editors, producers, brand product teams, and the engineering teams that build on top of it.

This is a technical role focused on delivery, guiding the team on architecture, technologies and people management. You set technical direction in close partnership with our principal engineers and you are accountable for making sure the team builds to that direction and ships to it. You lead a globally distributed team from New York, working cross functionally with product, design and editorial partners who sit closest to our brands, and you own the health of those partnerships as much as the code.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery

Manage and grow a global group of engineering teams across CMS, rights, planning, and content API systems, led by engineering managers and tech leads reporting to you.
Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers and managers; raise the technical and delivery bar across the group.
Ensure operational excellence or systems that sit on the critical path of every brand, every day. Ownership of uptime, performance, and reliability.

Technical Direction

Own the publishing platform roadmap in partnership with platform product management, balancing brand demand, editorial needs, structural investment, and technical debt.
Partner with principal engineering on key architectural decisions ahead: content model and format strategy, API contracts, and the consolidation of our authoring toolchain.
Treat the platform as a product: define and improve the contribution surface that lets brand teams ship on the platform quickly and safely, with governance built into the rails rather than enforced by review.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Build strong, trusted working relationships with editorial, product, and brand engineering partners by translating their goals into platform plans and platform realities into terms they can act on.
Set clear expectations and communicate on delivery with a focus on ensuring the team fulfills commitments.
Partner across the wider organization (consumer experience, data, revenue, and enterprise technology) wherever the content pipeline touches their systems.

AI-Native Delivery

Drive the evolution of authoring and editorial workflows for an AI-assisted world — from AI-supported content creation to agentic workflows in production tooling.
Make AI-native ways of working real inside your team as a default, not an experiment.
Raise the standard of AI-assisted engineering across the team, sharing effective practice and assessing its limits candidly, so speed comes without sacrificing quality or trust.

Requirements

Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams building and running platforms as products, with real accountability for delivery and quality.
Experience owning content management, publishing, or comparable internal-platform systems.
A track record of leading distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Sufficient hands-on depth to review designs and code, engage credibly with senior ICs, and contribute directly when it matters.
Strong architectural judgment in content systems: content modeling, structured content vs. markup tradeoffs, API design (GraphQL/REST), and the seams between authoring, storage, and delivery.
Demonstrated ability to build strong, trusted relationships with product, design and other cross-functional partners.
Experience driving AI-native ways of working within a team, not just tolerating them.
Sound judgment on the trade-off between platform health and delivery speed.
Strong written and verbal communication, and the maturity to lead through influence as much as authority.

Nice to Have

Experience in media, publishing, or another editorial-tooling-intensive domain.
Familiarity with rights management, editorial planning, or media asset workflows.
Experience leading platform consolidation or re-architecture while the platform remains in continuous production use.

Our Tech Stack

Languages & Frameworks: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, REST, MongoDB, AWS Lambda, Kafka, S3
Delivery & Infra: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
Source Control: Git, GitHub

How We Work

Infrastructure as code everywhere.
Quality Assurance is the team’s responsibility.
Pairing and other techniques to facilitate knowledge sharing and upskilling.
Works with peers and stakeholders across time zones and locations, with international colleagues across the US, Europe, and India.
Teams own their apps, including on-call.
AI-native by default and customer-obsessed in intent, with a bias toward placing real work in front of readers and allowing data to guide the next decision.

jobs.description:
About Moby

Moby is changing the way people invest. We use AI to transform the world's financial data and research into clear, actionable insights that anyone can understand. What started as a consumer research product is now three businesses in one: a subscription app used by tens of thousands of paid subscribers, a media platform reaching 30M+ people every month, and a fast-growing B2B API business powering research and AI experiences inside major brokerages and financial platforms. We're profitable-minded, growing 3x year over year, and just getting started.

The Role

We're not hiring a VP of Engineering to sit in meetings. We're hiring our mad scientist
— the person who prototypes the thing everyone said was a quarter away, ships it in a week, and then builds the systems that make it production-grade.
This is a true player-coach
role: you'll spend the majority of your time (~70%) building — architecting systems, writing code, designing AI pipelines — and the rest leading. You'll own our engineering organization end to end: our offshore engineering team today, and the in-house team you'll help us recruit and build around you.
Moby moves fast. Founders here prototype working products in days and put them in front of partners the same week. Your job isn't to slow that down — it's to make speed sustainable: adding the testing, CI/CD, AI evaluation, and QA discipline that lets us ship fearlessly at scale.

What You'll Do

Build.
Stay hands-on in the codebase most of your week — from our consumer platform to our Partner API to our AI research and content pipelines.
Drive AI innovation.
Own the architecture behind our LLM-powered research engine: retrieval, evaluation, cost accounting, and caching. Push what's possible before competitors know it's possible.
Lead the team.
Manage and prioritize our offshore engineering team day to day, and design + recruit the in-house engineering team we build next.
Set the bar.
Establish engineering standards — code review, testing, CI/CD, release process, AI evals — that raise quality without killing velocity.
Shape the culture.
Make Moby engineering a place where great builders want to work: high autonomy, high trust, high output.
Partner with founders.
Work directly with the co-founders on product strategy, technical due diligence for partnerships, and build-vs-buy decisions.

Who You Are

A senior engineer/leader who has shipped at scale — ideally with time at a top-tier tech company (Apple, Meta, Google, Amazon) or a major fintech — and now wants ownership, speed, and impact over bureaucracy.
Deeply fluent in modern AI development: LLM applications, RAG, evals, and the economics of running AI in production.
A builder first. You'd rather prototype the answer than write a memo about it — but you know when a prototype needs to become a system.
An experienced people leader who can run distributed teams and knows how to hire exceptional engineers.
Comfortable across the stack (we work in Go, Node.js, NextJS, Flutter, GCP/Postgres — you don't need all of them, but you need range).
Excited by markets and investing. You don't need a finance background, but you should find the problem space fascinating.

Why This Role

Real ownership.
You'll be the most senior technical person at the company, reporting directly to a co-founder.
A playground, not a maintenance job.
New products get greenlit and shipped in weeks, not quarters — AI chat, partner APIs, research tooling, trading integrations.
Leverage.
A small team reaching tens of millions of people, with AI doing the heavy lifting.
Equity that matters.
Meaningful ownership in a fast-growing, revenue-generating company.

Logistics

NYC metro strongly preferred (hybrid); open to full remote within US time zones for an exceptional candidate.
Compensation: $200,000 base salary + equity.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on interconnection experience within ISO/RTO such as ERCOT, a strong understanding of evolving grid policies and study methodologies, and the ability to represent a developer’s commercial and strategic interests across the full project lifecycle—from early-stage siting through construction and operations.

Consultancy Background:
Strong preference for candidates with experience at a top-tier engineering consultancy (e.g., performing third-party power flow studies for developers).

Deep understanding of Open Access Transmission Tariffs (OATT), Generator Interconnection Procedures (GIP), and utility-specific technical standards.

10 years +/- of direct experience in US transmission and interconnection.
Developer Background:
Proven track record working specifically for a renewable energy developer, managing utility-scale solar, wind, or storage assets.
Technical Expertise:
Deep understanding of ISO/RTO tariffs, business practice manuals, and the FERC Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT).

Ability to translate complex regulatory/policy changes into actionable business strategies.

Experience managing technical teams and external consultants. Responsiveness and Responsibilities on development team’s inquiries.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are the ecosystem orchestrator driving commercial DeFi on XRPL. Instead of chasing speculative DeFi users, we leverage direct alignment with core enterprise distribution channels to bring safe, reliable financial tools to retail $XRP holders, a massive, underserved market. Founded by early Ripple, Samsung Next and venture studio operators, our team brings over decades of fintech and incubation experience to the XRPL.
The Role

This is a founding, senior technical leadership role for a protocol architect or former technical founder who wants to build an entire DeFi ecosystem the right way. Instead of building a single app in a crowded market and fighting for distribution, you are getting the backing, resources, and authority to design the complete technical stack for XRPL's EVM sidechain. Working alongside our Co-Founders and Head of DeFi, you will choose the core infrastructure, set ecosystem security standards, and turn high-value financial models into safe, unhackable software.
What You'll Do

Stitch Together the Core Stack: Pick and integrate the essential infrastructure, bridges, oracles, DEXs, money markets, and wallets, and decide core mechanics like sidechain gas policy (XRP vs. RLUSD).
Set Ecosystem Security Standards: Establish strict, clear security rules across all partners and vendors, including oracle fallbacks, audit standards, and emergency pause buttons to keep user capital safe.
Vet Code & External Teams: Audit the smart contract code, architecture, and engineering habits of partner protocols and dev shops before we integrate them or deploy capital.
Turn Finance into Bulletproof Code: Sit down with our Head of DeFi, take their commercial deals and yield models, and translate them into hard smart contract logic, LTV limits, and liquidation rules.
Drive Core Technical Partnerships: Serve as the main technical link to our infra partners for XRPL and the XRPL EVM Sidechain, making sure everyone stays aligned and ships on time.

What You'll Bring

Founder or Lead Architect Experience: You've designed or co-founded an EVM protocol before. You know what it takes to launch a lending platform, vault system, or money market from scratch, and you want to do it at scale with real backing.
EVM & DeFi Mechanics Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Solidity/Vyper, lending pools, ERC-4626 vaults, and cross-chain bridges. You know how these pieces interact under live market stress.
Healthy Security Paranoia: You intuitively see how systems break, oracle delays, reentrancy, liquidation bottlenecks, and know how to protect capital before an exploit happens.
Orchestration Skills: Ability to direct external dev shops, evaluate vendor code, cut through technical noise, and keep multi-party engineering projects moving smoothly.
US Location & Timezone Alignment: US-based with ability to work with substantial overlap on US Pacific Time (PST).

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology
jobs.description:
Join Goodwin’s Global Operations Team, and make a real impact on a global scale.
At Goodwin, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. As part of the Global Operations Team – all business professionals at the firm – you’ll collaborate with colleagues from varied backgrounds and experiences, fostering an environment where cross-functional learning, networking, and collaboration are at the core of what we do.

Here, we’re not just supporting a law firm; we’re partnering with attorneys and clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions
in high-stakes litigation and dispute resolution, world-class regulatory compliance and advisory services, and complex transactions. Our commitment to integrity, ingenuity, agility, and ambition drives us, and we’re proud to have been recognised as the “Best Business Team” by The American Lawyer.

This is your opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic, global environment, surrounded by forward-thinking peers.

The Managing Director, Technology is a senior technology leader responsible for day-to-day leadership of the firm’s core technology functions. This role provides both strategic leadership and operational governance to ensure the firm’s technology environment is stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.

As a key member of the Digital & Technology leadership team, the Managing Director partners closely with the Chief Digital & Technology Officer to execute the firm’s technology strategy, modernize foundational platforms, and deliver high-quality, reliable technology services to attorneys and members of the Global Operations team (“GO” team). Over time, the role will also assume additional functions such as organizational change management and project management, as those capabilities gets formally established.

What You Will Do

Provide strategic and operational leadership for core technology domains.
Establish and maintain technology standards, policies, and operating models that promote reliability, security, scalability, and a consistent user experience across the firm.
Ensure the firm’s technology platforms and services effectively support legal, business, and administrative operations.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, contributing to strategic planning, prioritization, and executive decision-making.
Translate enterprise technology strategy into actionable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
Lead technology change management for major technology initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, adoption planning, and post-implementation reinforcement to drive successful, sustained outcomes.
Partner with firm leadership, business stakeholders, and peer technology leaders to align technology investments with firm objectives.
Provide administrative oversight, leadership, and performance management for managing directors, directors, managers, and teams within scope.
Foster a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative culture across technology teams.
Support talent development, succession planning, and organizational design to ensure long-term capability and resilience.
Oversee the delivery and performance of technology services, ensuring service levels, reliability, and user expectations are consistently met.
Identify and manage operational risks related to infrastructure, network stability, endpoint environments, and security in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Lead vendor strategy and oversight within scope, including contract management, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
Assume administrative and strategic oversight of organizational change management and project management functions as these roles and capabilities are established.
Ensure effective coordination between technology delivery, change enablement, and project execution to support complex initiatives and firm-wide transformation efforts.

Who You Are

Experience managing a team of 100+ IT professionals, 10,000+ endpoints.
Experience scaling infrastructure, network services, desktop engineering, and user experience
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Significant progressive experience in technology leadership roles, with responsibility for enterprise-scale technology environments.
Experience within a law firm or professional services organization strongly preferred.
Proven senior-level leadership experience overseeing enterprise technology functions in a matrixed, professional services environment with a global footprint.
Strong understanding of infrastructure, networking, endpoint technologies, and user experience considerations in large, distributed organizations.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to influence, advise, and partner with senior leaders.
Strong people leadership skills, including experience leading leaders and managing through organizational change.
Sound judgment, operational discipline, and a pragmatic approach to balancing innovation with stability and risk management.
Occasional travel

Benefits And More

At Goodwin, you will discover your next career opportunity with a rewarding compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
Retirement & Savings Plan
Emergency back-up child and adult care
Paid vacation, sick time off, and holidays
Professional development and career advancement opportunities
Employee recognition and reward programs
Employee wellness and assistance programs
Employee discounts and perks

This position is eligible for overtime: No

The Target Salary Range For This Position Varies By Location And Is Commensurate With Relevant Experience: $300,000.00 - $400,000.00

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
We develop AI-driven physical threat intelligence software used by large enterprises and U.S. federal and defense agencies. Our product suite gives security, risk, and operations teams the tools to spot and respond to real-world threats faster than traditional intelligence platforms allow. As a dual-use company, we build a single core technology that serves both Fortune 500 security teams and government customers, which means our engineering organization has to operate at a high standard of commercial speed and federal-grade discipline simultaneously. We're a Series A company in a period of rapid growth, and this role will be central to establishing engineering not just as a function, but as a true discipline within the company.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Director of Engineering to serve as the technical foundation of our engineering organization. This position blends individual contribution with leadership: you'll be hands-on enough to drive meaningful architecture decisions, organized enough to manage delivery like a well-run program, and versed enough in current AI tools to help the team build with AI — not just build AI products.

You'll report directly to the CEO and be among the most senior technical leaders guiding how we scales its engineering function. You'll collaborate closely with our VP of Product, who owns the delivery cadence, roadmap prioritization framework, and the broader product/engineering operating model supporting our dual-use strategy.

Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Platform Strategy

Define the long-term data architecture strategy for our threat intelligence pipelines, making sure systems scale smoothly as data volume, data variety, customer base, and federal compliance demands increase.
Guide platform-level decisions — storage, pipelines, data modeling, warehousing, and ML/AI operations — balancing speed and cost against the realities of serving both commercial and federal clients (data segregation, CUI handling, and FedRAMP/CMMC-adjacent requirements).
Collaborate with Product and GRC teams on data governance, lineage, and security-by-design principles as the platform matures.

Program & Delivery Management

Bring disciplined program management practices to engineering delivery — roadmap and technical debt planning, sprint cadence, dependency tracking, velocity tracking, and risk visibility — without burying the team in unnecessary process.
Take ownership of predictability, so leadership and the board can rely on engineering's commitments and timelines.
Lead cross-functional planning with Product and GTM teams to keep engineering output aligned with enterprise and federal sales cycles.

Software Engineering Leadership

Remain technically engaged where it counts — reviewing code, shaping architecture, and solving hard technical problems, not just reporting on status.
Establish and uphold engineering standards across code quality, testing, CI/CD, security, and documentation.
Guide decisions on system architecture, technology stack direction, and technical debt priorities.

Team Leadership & People Management

Manage, coach, and develop a team of engineers, handling hiring, performance management, and career growth.
Cultivate a strong engineering culture during a period of fast growth — grounded in clear ownership, trust, and low ego.
Serve as the bridge between individual engineers and company leadership, translating technical detail into business context and back again.

AI Operations & Applied AI Fluency

Bring genuine, everyday fluency with modern AI development practices — AI coding assistants, agentic tools, and LLM-based systems as a standard part of how the team works, not a side experiment.
Spot where AI can safely speed up engineering work (code generation, testing, internal tools) and where it introduces risks that need safeguards, particularly given our federal customer base.
Help shape how our products use AI internally — including model selection, evaluation, reliability, and cost tradeoffs — working closely with product and applied data science partners.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of progressively responsible experience across software engineering, data architecture, and engineering management, including at least 3 years in a formal people-leadership role (Engineering Manager, Director, or similar).
A track record of owning data architecture decisions at scale — designing infrastructure, not just working within it.
Strong instincts for program and delivery management, comfortable owning timelines, estimating effort, and coordinating across engineering and product leadership.
A genuine builder's background, with enough recent hands-on engineering work to earn technical credibility and make sound architectural and development calls.
A demonstrated ability to hire, manage, and grow engineers, with experience building effective, high-velocity teams.
Daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI tools and a clear point of view on how AI is reshaping engineering org design, hiring, and velocity.
A security-first mindset suited to a dual-use environment, along with willingness to learn the federal compliance landscape (FedRAMP, CMMC, CUI handling) as it relates to engineering.
Startup experience, ideally at the Series A–B stage, where ambiguity is common and teams are still taking shape.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lindy
Our mission is to free humanity from work. We're starting by building an AI employee, not another tool people have to operate.
Lindy is like any other teammate: it joins your Slack, can be @-mentioned for help about anything, uses all your tools, and even builds its own if needed. It already saves countless hours to grateful teams who could no longer imagine working without it.

Our Culture
Lindy's Culture: https://app.notion.com/p/lindyai/Lindy-s-Culture-8f24be7f619a4e4aa7e93ba02d58cf4c

You can expect an environment with little process and high empowerment, paired with high expectations and a strong sense of urgency. We're a small team of smart, intense people dedicated to doing the best work of our lives.

We are an in-office company, working from our downtown San Francisco office 4+ days a week. We sponsor visas and cover relocation costs up to $20,000.

The Role
We're looking for someone to own engineering at Lindy.
We build a genuinely complex product: an agent that acts on real people's email, calendars, meetings, and company data, where being wrong has consequences.
You'll own the operating system and delivery: how work gets planned, reviewed, shipped, and kept running, plus the reliability bar, hiring, and standards. You'll report to the CEO and partner closely with our Senior Engineering Manager, our engineers, and product.
This is a builder's job. You'll still read code, review PRs, occasionally write them, and make architecture calls.

Key Responsibilities
Own engineering execution. Planning cadence, prioritization, and delivery. We must ship!
Build the operating system. On-call that works, CI that's fast, fast code reviews, clean project handoffs, incident response, and a standup and review cadence people actually get value from.
Own reliability. Our agent's reliability is the company's top priority. You own driving it up, and the eval infrastructure and self-improvement loops that get it there.
Build an AI-native engineering organization. Engineering itself is being rewritten. You'll push agentic development, AI code review, and the internal tooling that lets a small team out-ship a large one, and you'll measure whether it's actually working.
Own hiring and onboarding. Raise the bar, run a tight process, and get new engineers productive and clear about their responsibilities.
Dive deep. Review code, weigh in on architecture, and keep enough context to have real opinions.

Who You Are
You've built the machine before. You've led a 10-30 person engineering organization at a startup and personally installed the processes that made it work. You can walk us through what was broken, what you changed, and what happened to cycle time and quality.
Player-coach. You're a strong engineer who chose to lead, and you haven't stopped being an engineer. You don't lead from a distance.
AI-pilled. You're not just excited about AI. You have rebuilt your own and your team's workflow around agents, and you have real opinions about what works and what is theater.
You hold a high bar. You create an intense environment to do great work. You give feedback frequently, quickly, kindly, and specifically.
You have backbone. The team is direct and will tell you when it disagrees. We want someone who brings data and holds the line when they think they're right.
You have taste for reliability. You've owned a production system where failures were visible to customers, and you know the difference between a system that mostly works and one that's rock solid.

Bonus Qualifications
Experience with LLM applications, agent infrastructure, or eval systems.
Background in SRE, production engineering, or developer experience.
Experience with products that are simultaneously consumer-grade in polish and B2B in requirements.
You've hired and grown engineers who went on to do great things.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range $260–$330k + significant equity.
Excellent health coverage.
$20K relocation assistance if currently outside of the Bay Area, and visa sponsorship.
High autonomy and direct collaboration with the founder.

Location
San Francisco office (downtown), 4+ days a week in office.

Partner with Product leadership to define technical strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
Drive engineering excellence by establishing scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Shape and evolve our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

You're perfect for this role if you:

Bring 12+ years of software engineering experience leading teams in high-growth SaaS or product-led technology companies.
Have worked in early-stage or growth-stage startups (fewer than 50 people) and thrive in environments that require ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset.
Are a hands-on technical leader who stays close to the work, comfortable diving into architecture and code-level discussions to guide decisions and solve technical problems.
Are fluent in how AI is changing the software engineering craft — you've personally used AI coding tools and have driven adoption of AI-assisted workflows across a team
Have a strong foundation across modern web technologies, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and scalable architectures, with experience in end-to-end systems (frontend, backend, platform, infrastructure, and DevOps) using tools like TypeScript, React, Node.js, and GCP.
Possess a track record of building and scaling products used by millions of users, with deep expertise in system design, reliability, scalability, and security.
Can translate company strategy into clear technical direction and drive strong execution in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment.
Communicate effectively across all levels from engineers to executives balancing technical depth with clear, outcome-oriented storytelling.
Excel in ambiguity, moving quickly and decisively without sacrificing engineering quality.

This role is based out of Screencastify’s Fulton Market office in Chicago and follows a hybrid schedule with 3 days a week in the office.

Working at Castify

We are results-focused, fast-moving, and here to change how the world communicates and learns through video. We value accountability, speed, and people who take ownership end-to-end. We love a challenge, a good problem, and teammates who bring both creativity and follow-through. Rule #1: Be a good person.

The expected annual base salary for this role is anticipated to start at $200,000 with an annual performance bonus. Final compensation may vary based on experience and qualifications.

At Castify, we foster an inclusive, supportive, fun, and challenging team environment. We value having a team that is made up of a diverse set of ideas and backgrounds. We embrace experimentation and the examination of all kinds of ideas through reasoning and testing. Come join us as we continue to change the world through video.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Managed Services, Infrastructure - Advizex
jobs.description:
This position will join the  Advizex 
team, a Myriad360 company.   
About Advizex

Advizex, a Myriad360 company, brings together over 50 years of innovation and client commitment. As part of Myriad360’s growing portfolio, Advizex continues to operate with the same trusted expertise and customer-first philosophy—now strengthened by broader resources and reach.  
For over 50 years, Advizex has done more than simply keep pace with technology—it has helped organizations stay ahead of it. With deep, real-world experience across healthcare, education, government, manufacturing, and retail, Advizex delivers IT solutions that solve meaningful business challenges across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.  
This role will join the Advizex team and play a key part in continuing that legacy.   
Learn more about Advizex  here !  

Role Overview

We are seeking a  Senior Director of Enterprise Infrastructure
 to lead strategy, architecture, and delivery across enterprise storage, virtualization, hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), disaster recovery (DR), and hybrid compute platforms. This role will drive innovation and operational excellence across both on-premises and consumption-based infrastructure solutions, including  HPE GreenLake and Dell APEX
.  
This leader will serve as a  strategic executive advisor
 to customers and internal stakeholders, responsible for defining infrastructure roadmaps, evolving managed services capabilities, and ensuring scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized environments. The ideal candidate brings a blend of deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and proven experience leading high-performing engineering and architecture teams within a managed services or enterprise environment.  
This position plays a critical role in expanding managed services offerings, improving service delivery maturity, and aligning infrastructure services with modern hybrid cloud and consumption-based models.  Candidate should be able to serve as a trusted advisor, with the ability to simplify complex issues and speak to C-Suite executives.  Excellent customer service skills are a must.  The successful candidate will lead managers and drive initiatives around processes, training, delivery quality, and customer service to support a growing managed services business.  
Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

Define and lead the enterprise infrastructure strategy and  managed  services delivery across storage, virtualization, HCI, compute, and disaster recovery.  

Establish multi-year roadmaps aligned to hybrid cloud adoption, consumption-based infrastructure ( GreenLake , APEX), and digital transformation initiatives.  

Act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders (CIO, CTO) on infrastructure modernization and risk mitigation.  

Architecture & Engineering Oversight

Oversee architecture and standardization of platforms including:   

Enterprise storage (SAN, NAS, software-defined storage)  

Virtualization (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V)  

Hyperconverged infrastructure ( VxRail , Nutanix,  PowerFlex )  

On-prem and hybrid compute environments  

Govern platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and technology refresh strategies.  

Hybrid & Consumption-Based Infrastructure

Lead adoption and optimization of HPE  GreenLake  and Dell APEX platforms for on-demand infrastructure consumption.  

Drive hybrid compute models integrating on-prem infrastructure with Azure, AWS, and GCP.  

Develop financial models focused on cost optimization,  utilization , and  OpEx -based infrastructure consumption.  

Disaster Recovery, Replication & Resiliency

Own DR strategy, including replication architectures, failover design, and testing frameworks.  

Ensure business continuity through standardized RTO/RPO targets and regular validation exercises.  

Integrate DR planning into enterprise-wide risk and compliance strategies.  

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

Partner with Managed Services leadership to enhance delivery quality, scalability, and automation.  

Establish KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics across infrastructure services.  

Drive continuous improvement in incident response, problem management, and capacity planning.  

Client Engagement & Growth

Lead strategic client engagements, including assessments, roadmap development, and executive briefings.  

Support pre-sales efforts with solutioning, proposals, and executive-level presentations.  

Identify  opportunities to expand managed services footprint and drive revenue growth.  

Leadership & Team Development

Build, mentor, and lead high-performing teams of architects and engineers.  

Establish centers of excellence for key technologies (storage, virtualization, HCI, DR).  

Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.  

Required Qualifications

Deep  expertise  in enterprise infrastructure technologies including  VMware, Nutanix,  VxRail , Dell  PowerFlex , and enterprise storage platforms
.   

Proven experience leading  large-scale infrastructure environments
 across hybrid and multi-cloud ecosystems.   

Strong background in  disaster recovery, replication technologies, and business continuity planning
.   

Hands-on experience with  consumption-based infrastructure models (HPE  GreenLake , Dell APEX or similar)
.   

Demonstrated ability to align infrastructure strategy with business and financial  objectives .   

Strong understanding of ITSM frameworks, operational processes, and managed services delivery models.   

Experience in performance tuning, capacity planning, and large-scale infrastructure optimization.   

Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.  

Preferred Experience:

15-20+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, with at least 10+ years in leadership roles, and at least 5+ years in people leadership roles showing increasing levels of seniority.  

Prior experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or consulting organization.   

Prior experience leading and developing managers  

Proven track record of growing a business with documented cases of close collaboration with sales executives  

Expertise in hybrid cloud architectures integrating on-prem and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).   

Experience building or scaling managed services portfolios and delivery frameworks.   

Familiarity with automation and monitoring tools (e.g., LogicMonitor, ServiceNow, scripting frameworks).   

Strong financial acumen related to infrastructure cost models and consumption-based services.  

Prior experience building or turning around high-performance managed services teams  
Prior experience implementing and scaling ITIL and LEAN process frameworks  

As an Advizex  
employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits and perks:   
Company-subsidized medical benefits   

Dental and vision coverage offered   

Unlimited PTO  

Flexible Work Arrangements  

Retirement Savings Plans   

Paid Long Term Disability  

Basic Life Insurance offered

Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is $175,000- $275,000 base salary, plus opportunities for bonus and/or commission. Compensation in other geographies may vary.

Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology
jobs.description:
Join Goodwin’s Global Operations Team, and make a real impact on a global scale.
At Goodwin, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. As part of the Global Operations Team – all business professionals at the firm – you’ll collaborate with colleagues from varied backgrounds and experiences, fostering an environment where cross-functional learning, networking, and collaboration are at the core of what we do.

Here, we’re not just supporting a law firm; we’re partnering with attorneys and clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions
in high-stakes litigation and dispute resolution, world-class regulatory compliance and advisory services, and complex transactions. Our commitment to integrity, ingenuity, agility, and ambition drives us, and we’re proud to have been recognised as the “Best Business Team” by The American Lawyer.

This is your opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic, global environment, surrounded by forward-thinking peers.

The Managing Director, Technology is a senior technology leader responsible for day-to-day leadership of the firm’s core technology functions. This role provides both strategic leadership and operational governance to ensure the firm’s technology environment is stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.

As a key member of the Digital & Technology leadership team, the Managing Director partners closely with the Chief Digital & Technology Officer to execute the firm’s technology strategy, modernize foundational platforms, and deliver high-quality, reliable technology services to attorneys and members of the Global Operations team (“GO” team). Over time, the role will also assume additional functions such as organizational change management and project management, as those capabilities gets formally established.

What You Will Do

Provide strategic and operational leadership for core technology domains.
Establish and maintain technology standards, policies, and operating models that promote reliability, security, scalability, and a consistent user experience across the firm.
Ensure the firm’s technology platforms and services effectively support legal, business, and administrative operations.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, contributing to strategic planning, prioritization, and executive decision-making.
Translate enterprise technology strategy into actionable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
Lead technology change management for major technology initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, adoption planning, and post-implementation reinforcement to drive successful, sustained outcomes.
Partner with firm leadership, business stakeholders, and peer technology leaders to align technology investments with firm objectives.
Provide administrative oversight, leadership, and performance management for managing directors, directors, managers, and teams within scope.
Foster a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative culture across technology teams.
Support talent development, succession planning, and organizational design to ensure long-term capability and resilience.
Oversee the delivery and performance of technology services, ensuring service levels, reliability, and user expectations are consistently met.
Identify and manage operational risks related to infrastructure, network stability, endpoint environments, and security in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Lead vendor strategy and oversight within scope, including contract management, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
Assume administrative and strategic oversight of organizational change management and project management functions as these roles and capabilities are established.
Ensure effective coordination between technology delivery, change enablement, and project execution to support complex initiatives and firm-wide transformation efforts.

Who You Are

Experience managing a team of 100+ IT professionals, 10,000+ endpoints.
Experience scaling infrastructure, network services, desktop engineering, and user experience
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Significant progressive experience in technology leadership roles, with responsibility for enterprise-scale technology environments.
Experience within a law firm or professional services organization strongly preferred.
Proven senior-level leadership experience overseeing enterprise technology functions in a matrixed, professional services environment with a global footprint.
Strong understanding of infrastructure, networking, endpoint technologies, and user experience considerations in large, distributed organizations.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to influence, advise, and partner with senior leaders.
Strong people leadership skills, including experience leading leaders and managing through organizational change.
Sound judgment, operational discipline, and a pragmatic approach to balancing innovation with stability and risk management.
Occasional travel

Benefits And More

At Goodwin, you will discover your next career opportunity with a rewarding compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
Retirement & Savings Plan
Emergency back-up child and adult care
Paid vacation, sick time off, and holidays
Professional development and career advancement opportunities
Employee recognition and reward programs
Employee wellness and assistance programs
Employee discounts and perks

This position is eligible for overtime: No

The Target Salary Range For This Position Varies By Location And Is Commensurate With Relevant Experience: $300,000.00 - $400,000.00

jobs.title: Probation Chief Technology Innovation Officer
jobs.description:
Description

Salary:
$155,484.16 - $198,423.68
Annually

Join our team as a Probation Chief Technology Innovation Officer
and lead a dynamic team driving technology, innovation, and operational excellence for the Probation Department
. In this key leadership role, you will oversee information technology operations, system development, cybersecurity, and strategic initiatives that support critical public safety functions across the Department. This position requires a forward-thinking leader with a proven ability to manage complex IT environments, ensure compliance with County, State, and Department of Justice standards, and implement innovative solutions that enhance efficiency and data-driven decision-making. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to improve public service, strengthening secure systems, and leading impactful change, we invite you to guide innovation in this vital role!

The Probation Department
is accepting applications to fill one full-time Probation Chief Technology Innovation Officer
vacancy. This position can be home-based in Santa Barbara or Santa Maria;
however, travelto both locations is required.

The County classification title is Information Technology & Business Systems Manager III. This position is "At-Will" and exempt from Civil Service protections.

About the Department:
The Probation Department's mission is to protect the community by providing information and recommendations to the courts; providing safe, secure and effective juvenile detention and treatment programs; enforcing court orders and post release community supervision conditions, requiring offender responsibility/accountability, and supporting rehabilitation; and providing victim services that include facilitating reparation and restitution to victims. For more information about the department, please visit: www.sbprobation.org

Benefits Overview

The County of Santa Barbara offers a competitive benefits package that includes the following highlighted benefits:

Vacation: 12 to 25 days per year depending on the length of public sector employment.
Management Leave: An annual bank of 40 hours of management leave is granted at the start of the payroll calendar year.
Holidays: 12 days per year
Sick Leave: 12 days of sick leave per year. Unlimited accumulation, one year of which can be converted to service credit upon retirement.
Health Plan: Choice of medical (with vision care) and dental plan options. The County contributes 100% of the least expensive EPO employee-only premium. The County also offers flexible spending plans and other voluntary options.
Onsite Employee Health Clinics in Santa Barbara and Santa Maria: Provides ongoing and episodic services to eligible employees and eligible dependents over the age of 5.
Retirement: The County offers a Defined Benefit (Pension Plan). The County contributes 0.24% of base salary to a 401(a) Deferred Compensation Plan. The County also offers voluntary participation into a 457 Deferred Compensation Plan.
Life Insurance: $20,000 Term Life Insurance
Public California Service: Applicants from other California public sector employers may qualify for retirement reciprocity and time and service credit toward an advanced vacation accrual rate.
New Hire Incentives: The County may provide reimbursement for reasonable relocation expenses, and at the discretion of the CEO, may provide sign-on incentives and/or time off advance accruals in the interest of attracting the best talent to the organization.

For more information on County benefits, visit: https://www.countyofsb.org/1400/Benefits-Wellness

THE POSITION:
The Probation Chief Technology Innovation Officercurrently leads a unit consisting of 7 subordinate staff broken into two subunits, the first of which provides user support for the 330 employees of the Probation Department and approximately 450 devices. In addition to user support, this unit maintains equipment inventory, device imaging and replacement, website updates and maintenance, and interfaces with IT vendors. They are responsible for security practices and ensuring a secure IT environment. The second subunit includes the EDP staff who are responsible for system development, integration between new and existing systems and the development of specialized reports and databases used to support the Department.

Distinguishing Characteristics

This is the third manager level in the Information Technology & Business Systems Management job family and oversees a division or multiple programs within a department. Incumbents oversee highly complex and strategic technology services and/or business systems functions and have responsibility for significant budget/funding levels. Decision-making includes establishing work unit objectives and goals, exercising considerable discretion in selecting the method to address a problem or issue, and fostering collaboration among and between the work units supervised as well as work units under the direction of others. Positions have significant impact on the specific work units or divisions, which may have department-wide effects.

Supervision Received And Exercised

Reports to the Chief Financial and Administrative Officer. Oversees the work of a team (two or more individuals) or teams of individual contributors through subordinate managers. Exercises direct and indirect supervision over assigned management, professional, technical, and administrative staff.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an innovative leader with extensive experience in managing the full scope of IT services including hardware, software, networks, user support as well as development of databases and systems including integrations with internally developed and purchased solutions. This leader will demonstrate a proven track record of aligning mission critical IT infrastructure and systems with the operational goals of the organization.

Examples of Duties

Below is a descriptive list of the range of duties performed by employees in this classification. These examples are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job, and not all duties listed are necessarily performed by each individual.

Plans, organizes, directs, and oversees departmental information technology operations supporting approximately 400 devices and 350 users.
Administers, supports, and maintains the Probation Case Management System and more than 20 internally developed business applications.
Serves as Departmental Security Officer and ensures compliance with County, State, and Department of Justice security standards and requirements including the protection of client records and criminal offender record information.
Supervises, trains, and evaluates professional and technical staff, including Computer Systems Specialists and Systems and Programming Analysts.
Assigns and prioritizes work, provides technical direction, and performs performance management and personnel administration functions.
Provides advanced technical guidance and resolves complex or escalated technical and operational issues.
Directs the administration and security of Active Directory, Group Policy, and enterprise authentication systems.
Plans, coordinates, and manages equipment lifecycle replacement, operating system upgrades, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Oversees network architecture planning to ensure system security, reliability, and scalability.
Directs the maintenance, troubleshooting, enhancement, and lifecycle management of web-based and Windows-based applications.
Oversees development and delivery of operational, analytical, and management reporting to support departmental functions and decision-making.
Evaluates business and regulatory requirements and directs development of new or enhanced software solutions to improve operational efficiency.
Oversees and supports IIS and SQL Server environments.
Develops and implements annual and long-term IT strategic plans aligned with departmental and County-wide objectives.
Establishes, maintains, and updates IT policies, procedures, and standards to ensure regulatory compliance and adherence to best practices.
Researches emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices and recommends system and process improvements.
Serves as technical consultant and departmental representative on County-wide committees, including the Santa Barbara County Data Sharing Committee.
Provides technical expertise, analysis, and recommendations for multi-departmental and enterprise initiatives, including CalAIM and Reentry Planning projects.
Oversees the development of databases and tools to track and report countywide criminal justice programs and statistics.
Develops, administers, and monitors departmental IT budgets.
Oversees procurement activities, contract administration, and vendor management.
Analyzes financial and operational data and makes recommendations regarding resource allocation and cost-effective service delivery.
Plans, leads, and manages information technology projects from initiation through implementation and completion.
Identifies, analyzes, and resolves operational, programmatic, and system issues and communicates findings and resolutions to executive management.

Employment Standards

Education And Experience

The knowledge, skills, and abilities listed below may be acquired through various types of training, education, and experience. A typical way to acquire the required knowledge and abilities would be:

Equivalent of a bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university in computer science, information technology, or related field; AND
Seven (7) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology, enterprise systems, business systems management or a related field, including at least three (3) years as a direct supervisor or manager.

Additional Requirements:
For specific positions, possession and maintenance of a valid California driver’s license and the ability to meet automobile insurability requirements of the County or the ability to provide suitable transportation needs as a condition of continued employment. May be required to work a varied schedule of hours, which may include evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Knowledge Of

Principles, practices and techniques of technology services and business systems in a public agency setting, including IT operations; IT enterprise security management; GIS operations; database management; application development and support; service desk and end user support management; enterprise resource planning; system management; operating system management; network architecture planning and design; network engineering; network infrastructure and telecommunications management; cloud services management; business analysis; and system migration management.
Principles and practices of technology areas related, but not limited, to IT operations management.
Principles and practices of IT enterprise security management, including e-discovery, cybersecurity, and cloud security management.
Principles and practices of GIS operations.
Principles and practices of database management, including, relational database development and management, and techniques of developing report/data warehouse structures, testing, and issue resolution.
Principles and practices of application development and support.
Principles and practices of service desk and end user support management.
Principles and practices of operations system and information, including enterprise resource planning, system management.
Principles and practices of network architecture planning and design.
Principles and practices of network engineering, network infrastructure, and telecommunications management.
Principles and practices of cloud services management, including usage and implementation of cloud-based architecture.
Principles and practices of public administration and program management, including strategic planning, implementation, and evaluation.

Who we are

FinThrive is advancing the healthcare economy. We rethink revenue management to pave the way for a healthcare system that ensures every transaction and patient experience is addressed holistically. We’re making breakthroughs in technology—developing award-winning revenue management solutions that adapt with healthcare professionals, freeing providers and payers from complexity and inefficiency, so they can focus on doing their best work. Our end-to-end revenue management platform delivers a smarter, smoother revenue experience that increases revenue, reduces costs, expands cash collections, and ensures regulatory compliance across the entire revenue cycle continuum. We’ve delivered over $8.8 billion in net revenue and cash to more than 3,245 customers worldwide. When healthcare finance becomes effortless, the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare expand. For more information on our new vision for healthcare revenue management, visit FinThrive.com

What we offer

Our people make us great. We know that our colleagues are the most integral part of our story.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology
jobs.description:
Join Goodwin’s Global Operations Team, and make a real impact on a global scale.
At Goodwin, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. As part of the Global Operations Team – all business professionals at the firm – you’ll collaborate with colleagues from varied backgrounds and experiences, fostering an environment where cross-functional learning, networking, and collaboration are at the core of what we do.

Here, we’re not just supporting a law firm; we’re partnering with attorneys and clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions
in high-stakes litigation and dispute resolution, world-class regulatory compliance and advisory services, and complex transactions. Our commitment to integrity, ingenuity, agility, and ambition drives us, and we’re proud to have been recognised as the “Best Business Team” by The American Lawyer.

This is your opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic, global environment, surrounded by forward-thinking peers.

The Managing Director, Technology is a senior technology leader responsible for day-to-day leadership of the firm’s core technology functions. This role provides both strategic leadership and operational governance to ensure the firm’s technology environment is stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.

As a key member of the Digital & Technology leadership team, the Managing Director partners closely with the Chief Digital & Technology Officer to execute the firm’s technology strategy, modernize foundational platforms, and deliver high-quality, reliable technology services to attorneys and members of the Global Operations team (“GO” team). Over time, the role will also assume additional functions such as organizational change management and project management, as those capabilities gets formally established.

What You Will Do

Provide strategic and operational leadership for core technology domains.
Establish and maintain technology standards, policies, and operating models that promote reliability, security, scalability, and a consistent user experience across the firm.
Ensure the firm’s technology platforms and services effectively support legal, business, and administrative operations.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Chief Digital & Technology Officer, contributing to strategic planning, prioritization, and executive decision-making.
Translate enterprise technology strategy into actionable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
Lead technology change management for major technology initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, adoption planning, and post-implementation reinforcement to drive successful, sustained outcomes.
Partner with firm leadership, business stakeholders, and peer technology leaders to align technology investments with firm objectives.
Provide administrative oversight, leadership, and performance management for managing directors, directors, managers, and teams within scope.
Foster a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative culture across technology teams.
Support talent development, succession planning, and organizational design to ensure long-term capability and resilience.
Oversee the delivery and performance of technology services, ensuring service levels, reliability, and user expectations are consistently met.
Identify and manage operational risks related to infrastructure, network stability, endpoint environments, and security in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Lead vendor strategy and oversight within scope, including contract management, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
Assume administrative and strategic oversight of organizational change management and project management functions as these roles and capabilities are established.
Ensure effective coordination between technology delivery, change enablement, and project execution to support complex initiatives and firm-wide transformation efforts.

Who You Are

Experience managing a team of 100+ IT professionals, 10,000+ endpoints.
Experience scaling infrastructure, network services, desktop engineering, and user experience
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Significant progressive experience in technology leadership roles, with responsibility for enterprise-scale technology environments.
Experience within a law firm or professional services organization strongly preferred.
Proven senior-level leadership experience overseeing enterprise technology functions in a matrixed, professional services environment with a global footprint.
Strong understanding of infrastructure, networking, endpoint technologies, and user experience considerations in large, distributed organizations.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at both strategic and operational levels.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to influence, advise, and partner with senior leaders.
Strong people leadership skills, including experience leading leaders and managing through organizational change.
Sound judgment, operational discipline, and a pragmatic approach to balancing innovation with stability and risk management.
Occasional travel

Benefits And More

At Goodwin, you will discover your next career opportunity with a rewarding compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
Retirement & Savings Plan
Emergency back-up child and adult care
Paid vacation, sick time off, and holidays
Professional development and career advancement opportunities
Employee recognition and reward programs
Employee wellness and assistance programs
Employee discounts and perks

This position is eligible for overtime: No

The Target Salary Range For This Position Varies By Location And Is Commensurate With Relevant Experience: $300,000.00 - $400,000.00

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.

The Director of Engineering for Solution Architecture is responsible for leading the architectural vision and technical strategy for client-facing solutions. This role owns strategic client relationships at the technical executive level, ensuring that architectural designs align with client objectives while maintaining technical excellence and organizational standards. The director leads through the Solution Architecture Manager and provides guidance to Solutions Architects and the Data Platform Architect, establishing architectural frameworks and standards that enable scalable, secure, and innovative solutions. This role balances delivery oversight (approximately 60%) with strategic architecture development (approximately 40%), with the flexibility to adjust based on organizational needs.

What you'll do:

Strategic Client Relationships

Serve as strategic-level technical point of contact for strategic client accounts
Lead technical consulting and advisory services for key clients, translating business objectives into technical strategies
Participate in account planning, growth strategy development, and identification of new opportunities within client relationships
Handle technical escalations and provide architectural guidance on complex client challenges
Represent the organization in client executive meetings and technical steering committees

Architectural Leadership & Governance

Define and evolve architectural standards, principles, and best practices across the organization
Develop and maintain the technology roadmap and architecture radar to identify emerging opportunities and trends
Establish standardized solution frameworks that ensure scalability, security, and maintainability
Lead architecture governance through design reviews, Architecture Change Management processes, and compliance oversight
Ensure architectural decisions align with business requirements, security policies, and technical standards

Solution Design & Technical Excellence

Oversee the design of complex, scalable architectures for client solutions across application and data platform domains
Guide Solutions Architects and Data Platform Architect in developing high-quality technical designs
Review and approve architectural blueprints for major initiatives and client engagements
Drive innovation through research and evaluation of emerging technologies, platforms, and architectural patterns
Ensure integration between application architecture and data platform architecture for cohesive solutions

Leadership Through Management

Lead, mentor, and develop the Solution Architecture Manager and architecture team members
Conduct performance reviews, career development planning, and coaching for direct reports
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement within the architecture practice
Provide guidance on complex architectural challenges and support professional growth of architects
Maintain flexibility to manage individual contributors directly when needed for specific initiatives or organizational requirements

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Delivery Leadership and Data Engineering directors to ensure seamless execution of architectural designs
Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and Security teams to align technical solutions with business goals
Work with business leaders and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical architectures
Serve as key liaison between technical and non-technical stakeholders for architecture discussions
Provide regular updates to senior leadership on architectural initiatives, standards adoption, and technology trends

Quality & Performance Optimization

Identify and implement architectural optimizations to enhance system performance, scalability, and efficiency
Ensure solution architectures support quality, security, and compliance requirements
Drive continuous improvement of architectural practices and design patterns
Review system architectures regularly to align with evolving business and technical needs

Documentation & Knowledge Management

Ensure comprehensive documentation of architectural artifacts, standards, and design decisions
Maintain organized repositories of reference architectures, ADRs, and technical specifications
Establish documentation standards and promote knowledge sharing across the organization
Maintain agency to adjust strategic versus delivery focus based on organizational priorities and client needs

What you'll need:

12+ years of experience in technology with at least 5+ years in architecture leadership or senior architecture roles
Deep expertise in solution architecture, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure), and modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, API design)
Proven track record of designing and delivering complex, scalable solutions in client-facing environments
Strong understanding of both application architecture and data platform architecture domains
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with ability to engage executives and technical audiences
Demonstrated success in building strategic client relationships and serving as trusted technical advisor
Experience establishing architectural governance, standards, and frameworks across organizations
Leadership capabilities with proven ability to mentor and develop high-performing architecture teams
Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and ability to align technology with business objectives
Architect and cloud certifications (GCP, AWS, Azure) are recommended but not required
Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.

Benefits

We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and Flexible Time Off (FTO)
so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth.

We are an equal opportunity employer

We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like-minded people to join our team.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Strong client satisfaction and successful delivery of architecturally sound solutions
Growth in strategic client relationships and expansion of technical advisory engagements
Widespread adoption of architectural standards and design patterns across the organization
High-quality architectural artifacts and documentation that enable effective solution delivery
Development and growth of architecture team members with strong retention
Successful identification and integration of innovative technologies that provide competitive advantages
