jobs.title: Senior Director of Managed Services, Infrastructure - Advizex
jobs.description:
This position will join the  Advizex 
team, a Myriad360 company.   
About Advizex

Advizex, a Myriad360 company, brings together over 50 years of innovation and client commitment. As part of Myriad360’s growing portfolio, Advizex continues to operate with the same trusted expertise and customer-first philosophy—now strengthened by broader resources and reach.  
For over 50 years, Advizex has done more than simply keep pace with technology—it has helped organizations stay ahead of it. With deep, real-world experience across healthcare, education, government, manufacturing, and retail, Advizex delivers IT solutions that solve meaningful business challenges across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.  
This role will join the Advizex team and play a key part in continuing that legacy.   
Learn more about Advizex  here !  

Role Overview

We are seeking a  Senior Director of Enterprise Infrastructure
 to lead strategy, architecture, and delivery across enterprise storage, virtualization, hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), disaster recovery (DR), and hybrid compute platforms. This role will drive innovation and operational excellence across both on-premises and consumption-based infrastructure solutions, including  HPE GreenLake and Dell APEX
.  
This leader will serve as a  strategic executive advisor
 to customers and internal stakeholders, responsible for defining infrastructure roadmaps, evolving managed services capabilities, and ensuring scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized environments. The ideal candidate brings a blend of deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and proven experience leading high-performing engineering and architecture teams within a managed services or enterprise environment.  
This position plays a critical role in expanding managed services offerings, improving service delivery maturity, and aligning infrastructure services with modern hybrid cloud and consumption-based models.  Candidate should be able to serve as a trusted advisor, with the ability to simplify complex issues and speak to C-Suite executives.  Excellent customer service skills are a must.  The successful candidate will lead managers and drive initiatives around processes, training, delivery quality, and customer service to support a growing managed services business.  
Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

Define and lead the enterprise infrastructure strategy and  managed  services delivery across storage, virtualization, HCI, compute, and disaster recovery.  

Establish multi-year roadmaps aligned to hybrid cloud adoption, consumption-based infrastructure ( GreenLake , APEX), and digital transformation initiatives.  

Act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders (CIO, CTO) on infrastructure modernization and risk mitigation.  

Architecture & Engineering Oversight

Oversee architecture and standardization of platforms including:   

Enterprise storage (SAN, NAS, software-defined storage)  

Virtualization (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V)  

Hyperconverged infrastructure ( VxRail , Nutanix,  PowerFlex )  

On-prem and hybrid compute environments  

Govern platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and technology refresh strategies.  

Hybrid & Consumption-Based Infrastructure

Lead adoption and optimization of HPE  GreenLake  and Dell APEX platforms for on-demand infrastructure consumption.  

Drive hybrid compute models integrating on-prem infrastructure with Azure, AWS, and GCP.  

Develop financial models focused on cost optimization,  utilization , and  OpEx -based infrastructure consumption.  

Disaster Recovery, Replication & Resiliency

Own DR strategy, including replication architectures, failover design, and testing frameworks.  

Ensure business continuity through standardized RTO/RPO targets and regular validation exercises.  

Integrate DR planning into enterprise-wide risk and compliance strategies.  

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

Partner with Managed Services leadership to enhance delivery quality, scalability, and automation.  

Establish KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics across infrastructure services.  

Drive continuous improvement in incident response, problem management, and capacity planning.  

Client Engagement & Growth

Lead strategic client engagements, including assessments, roadmap development, and executive briefings.  

Support pre-sales efforts with solutioning, proposals, and executive-level presentations.  

Identify  opportunities to expand managed services footprint and drive revenue growth.  

Leadership & Team Development

Build, mentor, and lead high-performing teams of architects and engineers.  

Establish centers of excellence for key technologies (storage, virtualization, HCI, DR).  

Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.  

Required Qualifications

Deep  expertise  in enterprise infrastructure technologies including  VMware, Nutanix,  VxRail , Dell  PowerFlex , and enterprise storage platforms
.   

Proven experience leading  large-scale infrastructure environments
 across hybrid and multi-cloud ecosystems.   

Strong background in  disaster recovery, replication technologies, and business continuity planning
.   

Hands-on experience with  consumption-based infrastructure models (HPE  GreenLake , Dell APEX or similar)
.   

Demonstrated ability to align infrastructure strategy with business and financial  objectives .   

Strong understanding of ITSM frameworks, operational processes, and managed services delivery models.   

Experience in performance tuning, capacity planning, and large-scale infrastructure optimization.   

Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.  

Preferred Experience:

15-20+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, with at least 10+ years in leadership roles, and at least 5+ years in people leadership roles showing increasing levels of seniority.  

Prior experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or consulting organization.   

Prior experience leading and developing managers  

Proven track record of growing a business with documented cases of close collaboration with sales executives  

Expertise in hybrid cloud architectures integrating on-prem and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).   

Experience building or scaling managed services portfolios and delivery frameworks.   

Familiarity with automation and monitoring tools (e.g., LogicMonitor, ServiceNow, scripting frameworks).   

Strong financial acumen related to infrastructure cost models and consumption-based services.  

Prior experience building or turning around high-performance managed services teams  
Prior experience implementing and scaling ITIL and LEAN process frameworks

employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits and perks:

Unlimited PTO

Basic Life Insurance offered

jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Senior Director, Insights Platform will support building and scaling the operating platform that powers FMG Leading’s proprietary insights capabilities as part of the broader enterprise platform. This role connects data, assessments, market intelligence, partner technologies, AI-enabled tools, and FMG Leading’s advisory expertise into practical workflows, outputs, and client-facing solutions that help leaders make better decisions and translate insights into measurable business outcomes. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on platform builder and operator role for someone who can move priority capabilities from concept into execution. The Insights Platform will operate as an integrated part of FMG Leading’s broader enterprise platform and will be informed by the firm’s advisory strategy, market priorities, commercial insight, and enterprise operating requirements. This role will bridge strategy and execution while maintaining clear boundaries among commercial input, advisory methodology, enterprise operations, and platform execution. The Senior Director will collaborate closely with EAS leadership, the CSO, consulting and commercial leaders, Enterprise Operations, IT/BIS, and external technology partners to create structure around how FMG Leading captures, governs, integrates, and applies its insights assets.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency, commercial context, business judgment, and advisory orientation. They should be comfortable translating business and advisory needs into data architecture, platform requirements, partner deliverables, governance practices, and scalable operating models. Over time, this role has potential to evolve into broader leadership of FMG Leading's insights platform and related technology-enabled advisory capabilities.

Core Accountabilities & Responsibilities

1. Insights Platform & Operating Model

Build and scale FMG Leading's Insights Platform to support FMG Leading’s advisory model, commercial strategy, and client delivery.
Collaborate with EAS leadership and the CSO to articulate and realize platform vision, guardrails, strategic choices, roadmap, and operating model.
Translate business priorities and advisory needs into platform capabilities, execution plans, and partner requirements.
Determine where capabilities should be built, partnered, integrated, or acquired.
Establish governance, operating mechanisms, and platform capabilities that enable disciplined execution.

2. Data Architecture, Management & Governance

Develop the data foundation that connects proprietary data, assessments, market intelligence, partner technologies, and internal systems.
Shape the data architecture, management approach, and governance standards associated with the Insights Platform, harmonized with the form, function, architecture, and operating requirements of FMG Leading’s broader enterprise platform.
Improve data quality, ownership, security, privacy, accessibility, usability and appropriate access controls across platform-related data assets.
Establish and maintain appropriate platform security, data privacy, access-control, and governance standards, including consideration of PHI/PII requirements where applicable.
Partner with IT/BIS and vendors on integrations, APIs, platform architecture, reporting infrastructure, and data flows.
Ensure insights assets are scalable, trusted, governed, and harmonized with the broader enterprise platform, systems, and operating standards.

3. Technology Partner Ecosystem

Coordinate FMG Leading's network of technology and insights partners so external capabilities become integrated, practical, and usable across the platform.
Align partner capabilities, workstreams, priorities, and dependencies with FMG's operating model and strategic guardrails.
Translate external technologies into practical advisory capabilities, workflows, and client-facing outputs.
Manage partner deliverables, dependencies, and integration points in collaboration with EAS leadership, Enterprise Operations, IT/BIS, and consulting teams.
Personally execute, document, troubleshoot, and drive work forward rather than only managing from a distance.

4. Insights Products & Advisory Enablement

Turn platform capabilities into repeatable offerings that improve client outcomes and enable teams to deliver them confidently.
Develop repeatable insights products, dashboards, tools, and client-facing solutions that support advisory delivery, informed by market dynamics and commercial input and shaped in partnership with EAS leadership.
Create playbooks, training, documentation, and enablement resources for PMs, client leads, and consulting teams.
Gather feedback from users and client-facing teams to continuously improve adoption, usability, and platform value.
Stay current on emerging AI, data, and technology developments to inform FMG Leading’s platform direction, advisory capabilities, and client-facing solutions.

5. Cross-Functional Leadership, Platform AI Enablement & Knowledge Management

Serve as a hands-on builder who connects strategy, operations, technology, and consulting teams while supporting practical AI and knowledge management capabilities where they intersect within the Insights Platform.
Coordinate work across EAS, Consulting, Commercial, Enterprise Operations, Finance, IT/BIS, and external partners.
Simplify complex issues into clear recommendations, decision points, and action plans for leadership alignment.
Identify and support practical AI and automation opportunities that improve productivity, insight generation, knowledge access, and client value within the Insights Platform, informed by and aligned with FMG Leading’s broader enterprise AI strategy.
Partner with Enterprise Operations and LT Value Creation to ensure responsible adoption, governance, and integration of platform-related AI and knowledge management capabilities remain aligned with broader firmwide priorities and enterprise platform direction.
Build alignment, remove obstacles, and help teams adopt platform-enabled ways of working.

Success Profile
: Outcomes & Behaviors

The successful candidate will be a platform-minded operator and builder at the Senior Director level who bridges strategy and execution and carries broad oversight and accountability for operationalizing FMG Leading's Insights Platform. This leader will collaborate closely with advisory, commercial, technology, and operating partners while maintaining decision authority over platform execution, partner coordination, data and technology requirements, and the operating mechanisms necessary to move priorities forward. This person does not need to be the deepest technical coder, nor a traditional analytics/reporting leader, but must have enough technical fluency to translate business and advisory needs into data architecture, platform requirements, partner deliverables, AI-enabled capabilities, and scalable operating models.

Success in this role will be defined by the ability to move the insights platform from a set of related capabilities into a coordinated operating platform that is trusted, usable, and valuable to client-facing teams.

The successful candidate will consistently demonstrate:
Advisory orientation: Understands that FMG's value comes from proprietary data paired with senior-level judgment, not technology alone.
Architect-first thinking: Connects data, technology, people, process, and advisory work before rushing to sell or scale.
Technical fluency: Engages credibly with technology partners, IT/BIS, data resources, and advisory leaders.
Hands-on ownership: Builds, documents, coordinates, troubleshoots, and drives work forward.
Operational orchestration: Creates clarity across stakeholders, partners, platforms, and workstreams.
Change leadership: Educates, enables, and brings teams along as FMG shifts toward platform-enabled ways of working.
Boundary clarity: Understands the respective roles of Commercial, EAS, Enterprise Operations, IT/BIS, and platform execution; establishes clear decision rights and effective working interfaces across them.

Skills and Qualifications

10+ years of experience building or leading technology-enabled platforms, insights platforms, data strategy, analytics, AI enablement, knowledge management, or related functions.
Experience operating at the intersection of advisory/client delivery, business strategy, data, technology, and enterprise operations, with the ability to partner across strategy-setting and execution-focused teams.
Strong understanding of data architecture, data management, governance, integrations, APIs, platform design, and reporting/insights infrastructure.
Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technology roadmaps, partner requirements, workflows, and scalable operating models.
Experience leading external technology partners, vendors, or platform providers through cross-functional workstreams.
Practical experience with AI enablement, automation, knowledge management transformation, or technology-enabled productivity improvements.
Strong executive presence, business judgment, communication skills, and ability to simplify complexity into recommendations and action plans.
Experience building technology-enabled platforms, data capabilities, or enterprise operating systems within complex organizations. Experience supporting consulting, professional services, or other client-service environments is preferred but not required.
Strong alignment with FMG Leading’s values and cultural principles including Humility, Tenacity,
and Value Creation.

The New York City Housing Development Corporation (HDC) is a public benefit corporation and the nation’s largest municipal Housing Finance Agency. HDC’s programs support the construction and preservation of multi-family affordable housing in New York City.

Architecture/Engineering/Affordable Housing

Position Summary:

The Director of Public Housing position reports to the Vice President of Architecture & Engineering in the Asset Management Department. The position provides leadership and operational oversight for the NYCHA Permanent Affordability Commitment Together (PACT) and TRUST housing programs and portfolio. The Director of Public Housing also conducts physical inspections for properties in HDC’s portfolio, NYCHA PACT and TRUST including reviewing Reserve for Replacement requests, managing agents, and insurance loss claims. In addition, conducting design reviews, rehabilitation plan and cost reviews, and construction monitoring of occupied rehabilitation projects.

This role is critical in ensuring the long-term sustainability and safety of HDC’s housing portfolio, NYCHA PACT and TRUST portfolios, and directly impacts residents’ quality of life as well as advancing HDC’s housing mission.

Perform comprehensive Annual Physical, Reserve for Replacement (RFR), LIHTC (Low-Income Housing Tax Credit), and Insurance inspections of projects in HDC’s portfolio.
Perform comprehensive Annual Physical inspections of NYCHA PACT and TRUST portfolio.
Conduct inspections in accordance with NSPIRE (National Standards for the Physical Inspection of Real Estate).
Analyze and assess building conditions, energy efficiency, storm resiliency, and environmental reports.
Process Reserve for Replacement Requests for project’s capital needs.
Evaluate the performance, compliance, and maintenance practices of managing agents.
Prepare written reports describing findings of existing conditions and recommendations for management and ownership.
Review and assess owner responses to existing condition findings and determine the acceptability of proposed remediation.

Monitor construction progress and review requisitions of projects in HDC’s portfolio undergoing rehab.

Participate in evaluating initiatives and policies affecting the physical strength of HDC’s, NYCHA PACT and TRUST portfolios and identify possible risks to the portfolios.
Serve as HDC’s representative during interactions with borrowers, their representatives, business partners, and other agencies.
Lead, mentor and supervise junior staff within the A&E and public housing team.
Introduce and Coach new employees on the methods for performing Annual Physical Inspections, Reserve for Replacement requests, Insurance claims, and LIHTC inspections for NYCHA PACT & TRUST projects and review their completed work.
Collaborate with senior A&E staff and the Chief of Public Housing, assist with meetings, scoping issues and scheduling of tasks.
Oversee third-party consultants.
Frequent travel throughout the five boroughs of New York City by mass transit or corporation provided vehicle (subject to availability).

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in architecture, engineering, or construction management.
10 or more years of relevant experience in architecture, engineering, or construction management.
Knowledge of Federal, State, and New York City affordable housing programs.
Expertise in NYC building codes, multi-family residential construction, as well as HVAC, plumbing, electrical and building conveyance systems.
Strong analytical skills for evaluating building conditions and compliance issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Excellent leadership, communication and stake-holder-management skills.
Ability to prepare detailed reports and present findings to management and stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office productivity tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in a related field.
Experience working with public housing authorities.
Knowledge of housing regulations, and inspection standards.
Experience with design-build construction project delivery is highly desirable.
High level of organizational and time-management skills.
Experience with property inspections, preferably in multifamily housing or similar settings.
Experience with construction management including, but not limited to, meeting participation, roles of trades, requisitioning process, and means and methods.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Company

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.

Overview

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager for the backend team, you will lead a team of talented engineers responsible for building and maintaining systems that power our financial products. This is a hybrid technical leadership role: you'll set technical direction, stay hands-on, and grow the people on your team — not just manage delivery from a distance. You'll play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our foundational infrastructure and product architecture, with a clear path to greater scope as you and the team grow. This is a rare chance to join a fast-growing fintech startup where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on both the company and the financial well-being of our users.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction for the team — deciding what to build and how — in partnership with product managers and cross-functional leaders, aligning engineering efforts with business priorities.
Lead system design review, giving substantive, critical feedback that shapes how the team's architecture evolves.
Stay genuinely hands-on: write code regularly (not just review it), and step in to unblock the team or fill in for engineers when the situation calls for it, without hesitation.
Oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend services, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term goals.
Make thoughtful trade-offs between tech debt and feature delivery, maintaining system health while accelerating product impact.

People Leadership

Run consistent 1:1s, give direct and meaningful feedback, and build clear career development plans for each direct report.
Mentor and coach engineers to help them grow into stronger ICs and future leaders.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and urgency on the team.

Operational Excellence

Promote engineering best practices with a strong focus on reliability, observability, and code quality.
Manage and continuously improve team processes — sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives — to drive effective collaboration and timely delivery.
Own incident response for your team's systems, including on-call participation.

What Success Looks Like

We're looking for someone who treats the role the way our strongest engineering managers do:

Bias toward building, not just overseeing. You'd rather write the code and review the design than just delegate it — hands-on work is a current habit, not a résumé line from a few years ago.
Low ego, high initiative. You notice broken processes and fix or flag them without being asked — you don't wait for permission to make things better.
Constructive with peers. You're comfortable challenging other engineering leads directly when something isn't working, not just within your own team.
All-in. This is a high-ownership, fast-paced environment, and we're looking for someone who wants that kind of intensity, not someone weighing it against a slower-paced alternative.

Requirements

3+ years of experience managing engineering teams of 5 or more
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with current, active coding involvement (roughly 20% of your time, or a clear desire to increase it)
Experience building and operating distributed, high-throughput, and mission-critical systems, ideally in financial services
Proven track record of leading teams to deliver complex projects
Experience mentoring engineers into future leaders and growing talent
Familiarity with incident management and on-call operations
Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments with a bias for action
Solid understanding of security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance

Nice to Have

Familiarity with mobile app ecosystems and lending or cash advance products
Experience managing managers, or a clear track record of preparing for it

Benefits And Perks

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.

We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.

Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment.
Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.
401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting
Meal program available for both lunch and dinner
Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match
Life and accidental insurance
Flexible PTO

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.

Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

jobs.title: Director Engineering, Logistics
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is building the operating system for modern supply chain: a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing over $10B in commerce annually.

The Logistics Group sits at the center of that platform. It owns Billing, TMS, WMS, and LMS, the four systems that determine whether Stord can bill accurately, move freight efficiently, run warehouses well, and keep labor costs in check across a fulfillment network spanning the US, Canada, and the UK, with more international expansion ahead. None of these problems are fully solved. Billing is mid-automation in partnership with Finance. TMS is building a standalone system alongside the Parcel team that will cut carrier spend now and create new revenue later. LMS is building the system that will materially lower cost-to-serve across the network. WMS is scaling the core engine that runs the fulfillment operation today, in real time, for real customers.

This role is for an engineer who became a leader, not a leader who happened to come from engineering. You'll manage five engineering managers and a Principal Engineer, but you'll be expected to understand the systems your teams are building well enough to ask the right questions, spot the wrong architectural call before it ships, and step into a hard technical conversation without needing a translator. You'll also be expected to build real relationships with Finance, Parcel, and other cross-functional partners rather than waiting for those relationships to be handed to you. If you've led engineering organizations through real growth, you still think like an engineer, and you're not afraid to make a hard call on a team that isn't performing, this role was built for you.

Why This Role

You'll lead one of the most consequential parts of Stord's business at a moment when the company is growing fast and the stakes for getting Logistics right have never been higher.
Billing automation isn't a side project here. It's a core initiative with Finance that changes how accurately and quickly Stord gets paid.
The TMS and Parcel standalone build is a rare chance to own a system that both saves the company money today and has a credible path to generating new revenue.
LMS gives you a direct line from engineering work to bottom-line warehouse cost savings across the entire network, not just one site.
WMS puts you in charge of the platform powering live fulfillment operations across North America and the UK, with more international growth on the roadmap.
You'll inherit a strong bench (five managers and a Principal Engineer) and have real authority to shape how that org performs, not just maintain it.

What You'll Do

Org & Talent Leadership

Own performance and accountability across five engineering managers and a Principal Engineer, setting a clear bar for what good looks like on each team.
Coach your managers directly: give them the feedback, support, and stretch opportunities they need to grow into stronger leaders.
Set a high bar and act decisively when someone, manager or IC, isn't meeting it. Enable people as much as you can; don't carry someone who isn't pulling their weight.
Make organizational design calls (team boundaries, reporting lines, role definitions) as the group's scope and headcount evolve.

Billing Automation

Partner directly with Finance leadership to drive the end-to-end automation of Stord's billing process.
Hold the Billing team accountable to a roadmap that materially reduces manual billing work and billing errors.
Surface and resolve the cross-functional blockers that typically stall finance-engineering initiatives.

TMS / Parcel Standalone Build

Own delivery of the standalone TMS system being built alongside the Parcel team.
Push the team toward the cost-saving milestones this system needs to hit, while keeping the longer-term revenue opportunity in view.
Get close enough to the technical approach to catch problems early, not after they've shipped.

LMS Network Efficiency

Drive the LMS roadmap toward measurable, network-wide reductions in warehouse cost-to-serve.
Connect LMS work to real operational outcomes by building a working relationship with warehouse operations leadership.
Prioritize ruthlessly between LMS features that move the cost needle and ones that don't.

WMS Platform Scale

Own the technical health and roadmap of the core WMS powering Stord's live fulfillment network across the US, Canada, and the UK.
Make the platform investment decisions (reliability, performance, technical debt) needed to support continued international growth.
Keep the team's execution predictable enough that the rest of the business can plan around it.

What We're Looking For

Required

Engineering depth, not just management experience. You were a strong, hands-on engineer earlier in your career, and you still understand R&D processes, languages, and technologies well enough to engage in real technical conversations, even though you're not writing production code day to day.
Active problem-solving, not delegation by default. You jump into hard problems yourself. If a team is stuck, you're in the room figuring out why, not waiting for a status update.
Cross-functional relationship building. You build real working relationships with partners like Finance and Parcel rather than relying on org charts. This is not optional in this role; it's a condition of succeeding in it.
Organizational leadership at scale. You've managed managers before, ideally across more than one product domain, and you know how to drive consistency and standards across a multi-team org.
A track record of driving outcomes, not activity. You can point to specific business results (cost savings, revenue, delivery predictability) that your organizations produced under your leadership.

Required Soft Skills

Ownership & Accountability: You own outcomes, not just activities. When your team ships, you take pride. When something breaks, you take responsibility and fix the system.
Strong Communication: You communicate clearly with engineers, PMs, and executives. You translate technical complexity into business language and vice versa.
Delegation & Multiplication: You scale through people, not heroics. You have a history of developing team members and multiplying impact through others.
Navigating Ambiguity: You set direction when requirements are evolving. You build alignment across teams and functions without formal authority.
Balanced Judgment: You balance innovation with pragmatic delivery constraints. You know when to push for quality and when to ship.
Directed AI-Assisted Development: You understand how AI coding tools work as a productivity multiplier and can guide your team's adoption while maintaining quality and independent technical judgment.

Strongly Preferred

Experience leading engineering in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, or another high-throughput operational domain.
Direct experience partnering with Finance on billing, invoicing, or revenue-critical systems.
Experience scaling an engineering org across multiple countries or regulatory environments.
A demonstrated ability to grow Engineers and improve the velocity of teams

Nice to Have

Experience with transportation management, parcel/carrier systems, or warehouse labor management systems specifically.
Familiarity with high-growth, PE- or VC-backed environments where priorities shift quickly.
Prior experience standing up a net-new system (build vs. buy decision) inside an existing platform.

What Success Looks Like

30 days: You've built a real working relationship with each of your five managers and the Principal Engineer, formed an honest view of where each team (Billing, TMS, WMS, LMS) stands, and identified the one or two biggest risks to delivery.
90 days: You've made at least one consequential call, organizational, technical, or people-related, that visibly improves how one of your teams operates. Finance and Parcel partners see you as a reliable counterpart, not a name on an org chart.
6 months: Billing automation, the TMS/Parcel build, LMS efficiency work, and WMS scaling are all moving on credible, predictable timelines. Your managers are stronger leaders than when you arrived, and you've established yourself as a trusted voice in Stord's engineering leadership team.

About Stord

Stord is a cloud-based supply chain platform that enables brands to compete and grow through end-to-end logistics solutions. We process over $10B in commerce annually and operate across Order Management (OMS), Warehouse Management (WMS), Transportation Management (TMS), Consumer Experience, and Demand Planning.

jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

As the Director of Data Engineering, you will lead execution in a fast-paced client service environment while helping shape the strategic direction of this critical capability area.
You will lead a growing team of data professionals responsible for delivering high-quality solutions across the client engagement life cycle. Bringing a strong hands-on technical background, you will define and enforce the engineering standards, processes, and patterns that the team operates by, with particular depth in Databricks/Spark and PostgreSQL, and champion the use of AI and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate data engineering work. You will provide technical leadership and coaching, drive alignment across Delivery teams and clients, and ensure quality, speed, and consistency in execution in a heavily client-focused, process-oriented environment.

You will also partner closely with Delivery leadership, Software Development, and Product Management to advance the Data Engineering roadmap, standardize deliverables, and support evolving data and ETL technology solutions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Align and collaborate with Delivery leaders to ensure appropriate priorities and urgency are maintained for all active engagements. Set appropriate expectations and proactively manage them.
Manage team priorities and alignment with clients and engagements. Ensure all requests are addressed in a timely manner. Scale the team as needed.
Responsible for hiring, onboarding, and managing performance of a large and growing team.
Establish, enforce, and maintain Data Engineering standards, best practices, processes, and implementation patterns across our Databricks/Spark and PostgreSQL platforms, leading the team with strong hands-on technical credibility. Ensure appropriateness and soundness of all solutions.
Drive the adoption of AI and AI-assisted tooling across the data engineering team (including code generation, pipeline development, documentation, and troubleshooting) to materially improve productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity.
Operate with a heavy client focus, maintaining direct visibility into client engagements and ensuring the team consistently delivers against client expectations on quality, timing, and outcomes.
Collaborate with Enterprise, Data, and other architects to extend and expand data platform and its capabilities.
Oversee data governance and quality, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
Establish and enforce data security and privacy protocols to safeguard sensitive information.
Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in the data engineering field, incorporating them into the organization's data strategy.
Mentor and guide a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, continuous learning and professional growth.
All team members are expected to support the organization’s commitment to information security, confidentiality, and system reliability. This includes following established policies and procedures, safeguarding sensitive and client information, reporting potential security concerns, and supporting incident response or business continuity efforts as needed.
Additional responsibilities as needed to support team and business priorities.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education
Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
Preferred: Advanced degree and/or relevant certifications in Data Engineering, Cloud Technologies or related disciplines preferred.

Work Experience
Minimum: At least eight (8) years of progressive experience in Data Engineering or related technical disciplines, including hands-on engineering experience and experience leading technical teams, large-scale initiatives, or client-facing delivery functions.
Preferred: Experience in pricing, profitability, or commercial strategy domains.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

Minimum:
Deep technical knowledge and experience with traditional Data Engineering techniques and technologies, data transformation patterns, and data governance and security concepts.
Strong knowledge and understanding of the modern and emerging data engineering platforms, techniques, and methodologies.
Experience with and understanding of Data Lakehouse Architecture, big data processing, and related technologies.
Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks/Spark, including practical fluency across the platform’s core capabilities for data engineering workloads.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, performance tuning, and operational best practices.
Demonstrated, current use of AI and AI-assisted tooling in day-to-day data engineering workflows, including code generation, pipeline scaffolding, SQL authoring, code review, documentation, and troubleshooting.
Strong process orientation with a proven track record of defining, documenting, and enforcing engineering standards, delivery processes, and quality practices across a technical team.
Heavy client-service orientation with demonstrated success operating in a client-facing technical leadership capacity.
Experience with and understanding of modern Business Intelligence / Analytics platforms like Power BI (preferred), Qlik, Tableau, etc.
Experience in professional services or consulting strongly preferred
Strong business acumen and aptitude.
Understanding of standard software development methodologies, tools, and best practices.
Understanding, exposure, and experience with agile methodologies like Scrum is a plus but not required.
Experience with near- or off-shore resourcing models is preferred.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and effectively deal with competing priorities.
Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical, time management, verbal, and written communication skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to present information in a group or individual setting.

Benefits & Dynamic Rewards :
Enjoy industry-leading benefits and programs designed to enhance wellness and support work-life harmony. Specifically, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage (available from your start date), a 401(k) plan with company contribution, generous paid time off, and a range of professional development opportunities including a tuition reimbursement program. Eligible employees may also participate in annual merit increases and long-term incentive program.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Company

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.

Overview

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager for the backend team, you will lead a team of talented engineers responsible for building and maintaining systems that power our financial products. This is a hybrid technical leadership role: you'll set technical direction, stay hands-on, and grow the people on your team — not just manage delivery from a distance. You'll play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our foundational infrastructure and product architecture, with a clear path to greater scope as you and the team grow. This is a rare chance to join a fast-growing fintech startup where your work will have a direct and meaningful impact on both the company and the financial well-being of our users.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction for the team — deciding what to build and how — in partnership with product managers and cross-functional leaders, aligning engineering efforts with business priorities.
Lead system design review, giving substantive, critical feedback that shapes how the team's architecture evolves.
Stay genuinely hands-on: write code regularly (not just review it), and step in to unblock the team or fill in for engineers when the situation calls for it, without hesitation.
Oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend services, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with long-term goals.
Make thoughtful trade-offs between tech debt and feature delivery, maintaining system health while accelerating product impact.

People Leadership

Run consistent 1:1s, give direct and meaningful feedback, and build clear career development plans for each direct report.
Mentor and coach engineers to help them grow into stronger ICs and future leaders.
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and urgency on the team.

Operational Excellence

Promote engineering best practices with a strong focus on reliability, observability, and code quality.
Manage and continuously improve team processes — sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives — to drive effective collaboration and timely delivery.
Own incident response for your team's systems, including on-call participation.

What Success Looks Like

We're looking for someone who treats the role the way our strongest engineering managers do:

Bias toward building, not just overseeing. You'd rather write the code and review the design than just delegate it — hands-on work is a current habit, not a résumé line from a few years ago.
Low ego, high initiative. You notice broken processes and fix or flag them without being asked — you don't wait for permission to make things better.
Constructive with peers. You're comfortable challenging other engineering leads directly when something isn't working, not just within your own team.
All-in. This is a high-ownership, fast-paced environment, and we're looking for someone who wants that kind of intensity, not someone weighing it against a slower-paced alternative.

Requirements

3+ years of experience managing engineering teams of 5 or more
5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with current, active coding involvement (roughly 20% of your time, or a clear desire to increase it)
Experience building and operating distributed, high-throughput, and mission-critical systems, ideally in financial services
Proven track record of leading teams to deliver complex projects
Experience mentoring engineers into future leaders and growing talent
Familiarity with incident management and on-call operations
Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments with a bias for action
Solid understanding of security, data privacy, and regulatory compliance

Nice to Have

Familiarity with mobile app ecosystems and lending or cash advance products
Experience managing managers, or a clear track record of preparing for it

Benefits And Perks

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.

We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.

Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment.
Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.
401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting
Meal program available for both lunch and dinner
Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match
Life and accidental insurance
Flexible PTO

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.

Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

Raise developer experience across the org through CI platform standardization and self-service tooling that enables teams to manage their own infrastructure as code without a platform engineer in the loop
Drive incident command during critical outages, then convert every one into a systemic fix instead of a follow-up ticket that ages out
Own vendor strategy and infrastructure budget, negotiating enterprise  contracts and leading migrations to new vendors when the cost or capability case is clear

Make decisions and move: you set a technical direction with incomplete information, ship something, and adjust based on what the data tells you
Managed managers or tech leads before, and scaled a team through a period of real growth without letting the performance bar or the culture slip
Deep hands-on expertise across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, and modern observability tooling, with the ability to debug a complex distributed system yourself when it matters

Track record of developing engineers, and you can point to specifically what they went on to do

jobs.title: VP, Senior Director, People, Purpose & Brand (PP&B) Technology
jobs.description:
Description

The VP, Senior Director, PP&B Technology reports to the CIO, Corporate Technology and leads the technology strategy, portfolio, and organization supporting People, Purpose & Brand. This leader will have the opportunity to reshape a complex, global technology ecosystem and build the modern platforms, data capabilities, and AI-enabled experiences that will support Liberty Mutual’s workforce and business priorities through 2030 and beyond.

The role is accountable for both transformation and execution, modernizing and simplifying the PP&B technology landscape while maintaining secure, stable, and resilient operations. The leader will oversee approximately $50 million in annual technology investment and partner closely with PP&B and Technology leaders to translate business priorities into measurable outcomes.

This is a senior technology leadership role requiring credibility across engineering, enterprise platforms, data, architecture, and AI. Equally important is the ability to influence and challenge executives, navigate complexity, make difficult tradeoffs, and lead teams through sustained transformation. The successful candidate will build a high-performing, inclusive organization and create clarity, accountability, and momentum across a broad ecosystem of internal teams and external partners.

The role requires a holistic leadership approach and breadth of perspective, drawing on enterprise and industry trends, to enable a high-performing, adaptable technology function and a data-first culture, led with an inclusive culture that fosters innovation, trust, people development, and integrity.

What This Role Is Accountable For
Qualifications
About Us

Transformation Through Technology Execution
Lead the modernization and simplification of the end-to-end PP&B technology ecosystem—core HR/HCM platforms, employee experience, people/workforce data and analytics, AI, integration, security, and the PP&B vendor landscape
Drive transformation across Talent, Total Rewards, Learning, Employee Experience, DEI, Communications, Brand, and Purpose in a mixed legacy and modern environment
Make durable platform decisions that reduce structural risk, improve resilience, and compound value through 2030 and beyond, balancing near-term delivery with multi-year modernization
Ensure PP&B system, technical, and product architectures stay aligned with business objectives
Strategic Partnership & Constructive Challenge
Act as a trusted technology and transformation partner to PP&B leadership, co-owning outcomes, not just delivery, and shape how leaders think about technology, data, AI, and operating models
Challenge functional leaders constructively and directly, bringing clarity to tradeoffs, sequencing, and change absorption
Build partnerships with PP&B leaders, vendors, and technology peers, and move leaders forward even amid ambiguity or resistance
Outcome-Driven Delivery & Accountability
Own execution and results across the PP&B technology investment portfolio (~$50M annual) and a technology organization of ~125 people
Jointly set financial targets with PP&B partners and ensure programs deliver to plan
Ensure investments translate into measurable outcomes, speed, quality, control, productivity, employee experience, and economics
Drive disciplined prioritization, dependency management, resource allocation, and delivery rigor across Run and Grow, holding teams and partners accountable for outcomes, not activity
Technology Excellence & Ecosystem Leadership
Serve as an active member of the Corporate Technology leadership team, contributing PP&B perspective to Liberty Mutual's enterprise technology agenda
Translate enterprise strategy into PP&B execution, high-performing engineering, AI-enabled SDLC evolution, modern architecture, and resilient operations
Lead adoption of modern engineering practices: product-centric delivery, platform thinking, automation, and AI across the SDLC
Apply and evolve enterprise standards for architecture, security, data, and AI, balancing consistency with the realities of PP&B transformation
Anticipate technology evolution, inform the enterprise roadmap, and ensure PP&B decisions strengthen the broader Liberty Mutual technology ecosystem
Talent, Culture & Change Leadership
Build and lead a high-performing PP&B technology organization that thrives in sustained transformation
Manage staffing strategy (headcount, skills, experience, and internal/external mix), and hire, develop, and coach leaders who operate with accountability and resilience under pressure
Foster a culture of direct communication, learning, inclusion, and execution excellence, and model courage in addressing conflict and making hard calls
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in technical or business discipline or related experience; Master's Degree preferred
More than 5 years in a leadership role required
Senior technologist with a proven record leading large-scale, multi-year transformations in complex, regulated environments; experience modernizing core platforms, data ecosystems, and AI-enabled capabilities, preferably in People/HR technology
Demonstrated ability to influence, challenge, and partner with executives on operating models, sequencing, investment tradeoffs, and change absorption, addressing conflict directly for better outcomes
Hands-on credibility across modern engineering, cloud-native platforms, enterprise SaaS, data platforms, and AI-enabled systems, with experience operationalizing product-centric teams, platform thinking, automation, and responsible embedding of data and AI in the SDLC at scale
Proven change leader who has built resilient, high-performing teams through sustained transformation
Strong vendor and ecosystem leadership, selection, governance, and value realization across major HR/People platforms and delivery partners, with proven experience implementing 3rd-party HCM/enterprise platforms, cloud-native solutions, and modern data ecosystems
Financial and operational acumen, including ownership of technology investment portfolios, multi-year budgeting (labor, software, compute), and blended workforce strategies
Business fluency across the PP&B domains, Talent/HR, Total Rewards, Learning, Employee Experience, Communications, Brand, and Purpose
Financial services, insurance, or other regulated-industry experience strongly preferred

Pay Philosophy:
The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: VP, Total Rewards and P&C Technology
jobs.description:
A leader in technology and innovation, Southwire Company, LLC is one of North America’s largest wire and cable producers. Southwire and its subsidiaries manufacture building wire and cable, utility products, metal-clad cable, portable and electronic cord products, OEM wire products and engineered products. In addition, Southwire supplies assembled products, contractor equipment, electrical components, hand tools and jobsite power and lighting solutions. The company also offers digital solutions including contractor planning and utility grid resiliency as well as field services including cable testing, rejuvenation and replacement to support our customers as a value-add partner. We are proud to offer competitive compensation, employee benefits, tuition reimbursement and unlimited growth opportunities. Our more than seven decades of progressive growth can be attributed to our determination to developing innovative systems and solutions, exercising environmental stewardship and enhancing the well-being of the communities in which we work and live. How will you power what’s possible?

Job Summary

Leads the strategy, design, implementation, and execution of the company's Total Rewards programs and People & Culture (P&C) technology systems. This role ensures compensation, benefits, executive compensation, recognition, wellness, retirement, HRIS, and related P&C platforms are competitive, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. The role is accountable for advancing an integrated employee experience through market-aligned rewards strategies, effective governance, data integrity, process optimization, technology enablement, and strong partnership with executive leadership, the Board, Finance, Legal, IT, and People & Culture leaders.

Key Responsibilities

Develops and implements an integrated Total Rewards and P&C technology strategy that aligns with the company’s business objectives, culture, talent strategy, and long-term growth priorities.

Oversees the design, execution, and governance of compensation, benefits, retirement, wellness, recognition, incentive, and executive compensation programs to ensure market competitiveness, internal equity, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

Leads the strategy, optimization, and administration of P&C technology platforms, including HRIS, talent systems, learning systems, reporting and analytics tools, and other P&C-related technologies.

Provides strategic guidance to the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Board and Board Committee partners, P&C leaders, and business leaders on Total Rewards, executive compensation, workforce analytics, systems strategy, and related governance matters.

Ensures the accuracy, integrity, security, and compliance of compensation, benefits, employee, and P&C systems data across all platforms and processes.

Leads market analysis, benchmarking, pay equity reviews, systems assessments, and workforce analytics to inform Total Rewards strategies, technology investments, and business decisions.

Partners closely with IT, Finance, Legal, P&C, and business leaders to ensure seamless integration, functionality, reporting, compliance, and continuous improvement of Total Rewards programs and P&C systems.

Manages relationships with external vendors, consultants, brokers, compensation advisors, technology providers, and service partners to ensure high-quality delivery, cost effectiveness, and strong service outcomes.

Develops and executes communication, education, and change management strategies to drive adoption, understanding, and engagement with Total Rewards programs and P&C technology solutions.

Leads, develops, and coaches a high-performing team of Total Rewards, technology, systems, and operations professionals, fostering collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:
Build the coolest tech for the world’s leading brands
Solve complex problems - and learn new skills
Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!
Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.
About the Role

We are seeking a Director – Data & AI Engineering to lead the strategy, architecture, engineering, and delivery of modern data and AI platforms for enterprise customers. This is a senior technology leadership role requiring a strong combination of data engineering, cloud, AI/ML, industry domain expertise, customer engagement, and executive presence. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in at least one of the following industries: Banking/Financial Services, Healthcare, or Retail, along with hands-on leadership experience across modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or MS Fabric, and AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Key Responsibilities
Define and drive enterprise Data, AI, and Analytics strategy, architecture, and transformation roadmaps, leading modernization across data platforms, engineering, analytics, ML/AI, and GenAI.
Provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership across Snowflake, Databricks, and/or MS Fabric, leveraging AWS, Azure, and/or GCP to build scalable, secure, governed, and high-performing data platforms and Lakehouse architectures.
Lead enterprise AI and GenAI initiatives from strategy through production, leveraging LLMs, RAG, AI agents, vector databases, ML models, prompt engineering, MLOps, and responsible AI practices to deliver measurable business value.
Bring deep industry expertise in Banking/Financial Services, Healthcare, or Retail, translating industry-specific data, regulatory, operational, and customer challenges into high-value, ROI-driven data and AI solutions.
Serve as a trusted executive and customer advisor, leading C-suite discussions, technology strategy sessions, architecture reviews, workshops, and transformation roadmaps while driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders.

Required Qualifications
15+ years of overall technology/engineering experience, with significant leadership experience in data and AI.
Proven experience leading large-scale Data Engineering, AI/ML, Analytics, or Cloud transformation programs.
Strong experience with at least one modern data platform: Snowflake/Databricks/MS Fabric
Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, MS Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Demonstrated expertise in data architecture, data engineering, cloud platforms, analytics, AI/ML, and/or GenAI.

Significant experience in at least one domain: Banking / Financial Services/ Healthcare / Life Sciences/Retail / Consumer
Strong customer-facing experience with the ability to operate effectively with C-suite and executive stakeholders.

jobs.description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group builds enterprise asset management and operations software for the world's most asset-intensive industries. We ship software that plant managers, schedulers, and technicians rely on every day, integrated deep into the systems our customers already run. We are a commercially driven engineering culture where leaders stay close to the work and to the customer.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Engineering to lead our EH&S (Environment, Health & Safety) product line. This is a player-coach role: you run delivery and you do the work. You will lead a team building web applications that asset-intensive operators depend on for safety and compliance, stay hands-on with the code, join customers on calls with your developers, and keep engineering commercially honest. This is not a manage-from-above seat.

What You'll Do

Lead the EH&S engineering team as a true player-coach, staying hands-on with the code and the delivery.
Own end-to-end delivery for the EH&S product line: quality, schedule, and customer outcomes.
Join customer calls alongside your developers and live the customer experience firsthand.
Bridge engineering to non-technical stakeholders across the business, translating technical work into commercial terms.
Step into the trenches when the situation calls for it: pick up a ticket, review code, unblock the team.
Own integrations with customer-owned systems such as document systems and ERPs.
Keep the team commercially grounded and aware of budget, timeline, and business impact.

What We're Looking For

5+ years in a player-coach engineering leadership role.
2+ years managing a team of 15 or more.
Proven enterprise software delivery experience.
Hands-on experience integrating with customer-owned systems (ERPs, document systems, and similar).
Willing and able to write and review code yourself when the team needs it.
Strong commercial awareness. You build for outcomes, not for its own sake.
A track record of cross-functional work with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience deploying to the cloud and to customers.
Computer Science degree preferred, or equivalent hands-on experience. We value people who got here by doing.

Tech You'll Work With

Frontend:
React.
Backend:
C#.
Database:
PostgreSQL.
Cloud:
deployed to the cloud and orchestrated with Kubernetes, our standard web app stack.

Nice to Have

TypeScript and .NET.
Experience across a broader enterprise web application stack.
Experience with cloud-native, containerized delivery at scale.
Comfort spending roughly a quarter of your time partnering with stakeholders outside of engineering.
Experience as the front person bridging technology to the business.

How We Work

This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead from the front, stay close to the code, and are on customer calls alongside your team. We are looking for a builder-leader who owns delivery outcomes and the customer experience, not a manager who directs from a distance. We solve delivery challenges with ownership and ingenuity first, and we build for real commercial impact. It is a demanding, high-accountability environment, and the people who do their best work here are energized by that.

Benefits Overview

We offer an attractive benefits program to meet the diverse needs of our teammates:
Employee base HSA plan, dental, life and short-term disability coverage 100% paid for by Prometheus Group
HSA & FSA plan options
Retirement Savings with Generous Company Match & Immediate Vesting
Gym membership to O2 Fitness
Casual dress attire
Half-Day Fridays
Generous Paid Time Off
Company Outings, Trips & Activities
Paid Parental Leave
