jobs.title: Head of Platform & Tools - Global Payments & Liquidity Implementation
jobs.description:
At Wells Fargo, we are looking for talented people who will put our customers at the center of everything we do. We are seeking candidates who embrace a workplace where everyone feels valued and inspired. Help us build a better Wells Fargo. It all begins with outstanding talent. It all begins with you.

Wells Fargo's Global Payments & Liquidity (GPL) team is an integrated, forward-looking product organization with end-to-end payments, data, liquidity and associated lending solutions that enable our clients to achieve their business objectives in an evolving digital world.

About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Head of Implementation Platform & Tools to lead the development, management, and oversight of the technology capabilities that support the end-to-end GPL product implementation process. This leader will be accountable for defining and delivering fulfillment strategy, tools roadmap, operating model, and execution discipline required to create a faster, simpler, more transparent, and more client-centric implementation experience.

The role will partner closely with the Sales and Implementation Leaders, GPL Product, Technology engineering teams, AI teams, Digital, Operations, Risk, and line-of-business partners to build a world-class GPL onboarding experience and toolset that meets current business needs while positioning GPL Implementation for the client needs of the future. In service of the GPL Implementation strategy, this leader will ensure technology investments, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow automation, reporting, and control routines are fully aligned to measurable business outcomes, including reduced cycle time, improved client transparency, stronger quality, and accelerated time to revenue.

In This Role, You Will

Own the GPL Implementation platform and tools strategy: Define, prioritize, and execute the multi-year roadmap for systems, workflow tools, digital intake, fulfillment capabilities, reporting, dashboards, and implementation enablement solutions that support the full client implementation lifecycle.
Lead end-to-end technology enablement: Partner with Technology engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions, ensuring clear requirements, strong prioritization, effective delivery routines, and disciplined management of dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs.
Drive AI-enabled transformation: Work closely with AI teams to identify, design, pilot, and scale AI use cases that reduce manual work, improve implementation quality, enhance colleague productivity, strengthen controls, and create a more intuitive experience for clients and internal users.
Modernize implementation workflows: Simplify and automate the end-to-end implementation process, including intake, product configuration, documentation, client communication, testing, readiness, activation, exception management, and post-implementation reporting.
Improve transparency and performance management: Build and maintain operational reporting, KPIs, dashboards, and analytics that provide leadership, product teams, sales partners, and implementation teams with real-time visibility into pipeline, status, bottlenecks, aging, cycle time, quality, productivity, and client outcomes.
Partner across Product, Digital, Service, and Operations: Ensure platform and tool development is tightly aligned to product roadmaps, digital channel strategies, servicing models, operational readiness, business controls, and client experience priorities.
Strengthen governance and controls: Embed risk, compliance, data quality, auditability, and control requirements into tools and workflows from the outset, ensuring implementation processes are consistent, well governed, and scalable across GPL products and client segments.
Manage delivery discipline and investment prioritization: Establish clear routines for roadmap prioritization, delivery tracking, issue escalation, benefits realization, and resource planning, ensuring investments are focused on the highest-impact client and business outcomes.
Create a world-class user experience: Champion intuitive user and client experiences that reduce friction, improve self-service and transparency, and support faster implementation execution across simple, core, complex, and specialty products.
Lead and develop talent: Build, manage, and inspire a high-performing team with the product, platform, analytics, business architecture, process improvement, and transformation skills required to deliver at scale.

Leadership Expectations:

Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of GPL Sales Support and Implementation and Implementation Product Leaders, bringing a strong point of view on how technology, data, AI, and workflow design can transform implementation outcomes.
Operate with an enterprise mindset, balancing GPL Implementation priorities with broader Product, Technology, Digital, Operations, Risk, and line-of-business objectives.
Translate complex business and technical issues into clear decisions, executive-ready recommendations, and practical execution plans.
Create strong partnership routines with engineering and AI teams, ensuring the business has appropriate visibility, influence, and accountability across delivery.
Champion a culture of simplification, client focus, innovation, disciplined execution, and measurable results.

Success Measures:

Reduction in end-to-end implementation cycle time.
Improved transparency of implementation status for clients, sales, product, and leadership stakeholders.
Increased automation and reduced manual processing across key implementation workflows.
Successful delivery and adoption of priority platform, workflow, reporting, and AI-enabled capabilities.
Improved quality, consistency, and control outcomes across implementation processes.
Stronger alignment between implementation tooling, product roadmaps, and technology investment priorities.
Improved user experience and productivity across implementation teams.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, including Management or leadership experience, or equivalent experience demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
4+ years of management or leadership experience

Desired Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in payments, treasury management, implementation, operations, product management, digital transformation, technology enablement, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading platform, tools, workflow, or digital transformation initiatives in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong understanding of end-to-end client lifecycle processes, including onboarding, implementation, servicing, product activation, readiness, and reporting.
Proven ability to partner with Technology engineering teams to shape roadmaps, define requirements, manage delivery, and resolve complex dependencies.
Experience identifying and scaling automation, AI, analytics, or digital workflow capabilities to improve business outcomes.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate complex issues clearly, and drive alignment across business and technology teams.
Track record of building high-performing teams and leading through ambiguity, change, and transformation.
Strong risk, control, and governance mindset, with experience embedding requirements into business processes and technology solutions.

jobs.title: Assistant Director of Engineering: Rosewood Calistoga
jobs.description:
Assistant Director of Engineering: Rosewood Calistoga

OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE

We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. We are wholly committed to rooting ourselves more deeply in every place we are in while setting new benchmarks for positive impact.

As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place.

THE TEAM

As part of the Engineering Division, which focuses on ensuring the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of all hotel assets, this role contributes to the strategic and operational excellence of the property. You will report directly to the Director of Engineering, collaborating closely with senior leadership, cross-functional departments, and external partners to uphold Rosewood's standards of luxury and innovation.

YOUR ROLE

As Assistant Director of Engineering, you will lead the strategic direction and daily operations of the Engineering division, ensuring the optimal performance and longevity of the hotel's physical assets. You will play a key role in driving energy efficiency, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. This role is instrumental in shaping the future of the property through capital planning, sustainability initiatives, and team development.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE THE PLACE

Hands on ability to resolve issues and outstanding assignments as needed and in emergency situations
Oversee all plant, equipment, and structural maintenance to ensure safety and operational efficiency
Implement and manage preventive maintenance programs across guest rooms, public areas, kitchens, and restaurants
Drive energy management initiatives and conservation efforts without compromising guest comfort
Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, fire codes, and internal safety policies
Represent Engineering in management and associate meetings, fostering cross-departmental collaboration
Support pre-opening strategy and execution, overseeing all activities within the Engineering division, in close partnership with peers and the corporate team.
Maintain readiness for Operational Management Reviews (OMR) and ensure timely follow-up on corrective actions
Develop and update departmental policies and manuals to ensure consistency across the group
Act in capacity of Director of Engineering during his/her absence
Build and lead a technically competent and motivated engineering team through recruitment, training, and succession planning
Promote associate engagement through regular communication, recognition programs, and performance feedback
Uphold discipline and support grievance procedures in partnership with Talent & Culture
Model Rosewood's culture, vision, and values in all interactions and leadership practices

COULD THIS BE YOU?

You hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and or qualification in Engineering. 
You have proven experience in leading an engineering function at a senior management level.
You demonstrate strong strategic thinking and project management capabilities. 
You show solid business acumen and have experience managing complex budgets, including capital expenditure.
You possess excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. 
You manage relationships effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.
You are knowledgeable with all relevant hospitality/building laws and regulations, positioning you as a knowledgeable engineering professional within the US and California.
You maintain a guest-centric mindset with a strong commitment to service excellence. 
You apply an analytical, data-driven approach to decision-making

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager – Incident Response
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll lead high-impact incident response work in a complex cloud environment and help shape how Atlassian responds to security events at scale. You’ll lead or coordinate complex security incidents, bringing structure, urgency, and sound judgment under pressure. You’ll partner with Detection, Security Engineering, Product Security, Legal, Crisis Communications, Support, and senior leadership to drive investigation, containment, recovery, and follow-through. You’ll directly manage a team of 5-8 in the US region.

You’ll coach incident responders and senior practitioners, raising the quality of investigations, handoffs, decision-making, and executive communication. You’ll improve the incident response system through playbooks, metrics, exercises, post-incident reviews, and better tooling. A key part of the role will be driving the adoption of investigative AI tools and automation that help analysts triage faster, surface relevant signals, reduce toil, and improve consistency without compromising judgment or security rigor.

You’ll also support regulated and high-trust environments, including work that requires a strong understanding of formal incident handling, reporting expectations, and documented operating procedures.

What You’ll Bring

On day one, we’ll expect you to bring a strong mix of incident leadership, operational maturity, and people leadership. You’ll have experience directly leading complex, multi-stakeholder security incidents in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise environment, along with demonstrated success managing and developing senior security engineers, incident responders, and/or technical leads.

You’ll have strong executive communication skills, including the ability to translate incomplete technical information into clear decisions, risks, and next steps. You’ll have experience improving incident response programs through metrics, retrospectives, process design, readiness exercises, and cross-team influence, as well as hands-on familiarity with investigation workflows, detection and response tooling, log analysis, and operational coordination across globally distributed teams.

You should have experience deploying investigative AI tools and automation in security operations or incident response environments, including using automation to reduce analyst toil, improve triage quality, accelerate investigations, enrich cases, retrieve relevant knowledge, summarize findings, or orchestrate response workflows. You’ll also bring strong systems thinking: the ability to connect incidents to broader improvements in telemetry, detection logic, escalation paths, tooling, and operating models, together with calm, structured decision-making in ambiguous, high-pressure situations.

What Will Set You Apart

Experience serving as an incident commander or major incident manager for high-severity cyber incidents will help you stand out, as will experience supporting regulated environments or formal incident reporting obligations, including government or FedRAMP-adjacent contexts. We’ll value experience building or scaling follow-the-sun incident response models across regions and introducing AI-assisted investigation workflows, case enrichment, knowledge retrieval, summarization, or orchestration capabilities in security operations.

Strong understanding of how to use operational metrics, quality signals, and error patterns to guide program investments is valuable, as is experience speaking externally, representing security programs, or contributing to broader security community practices.

Our team culture

The Incident Response team values calm execution, clear communication, and continuous learning. We are collaborative, direct, and low-ego during incidents, and we expect leaders to care about both outcomes and the health of the people doing the work. We use blameless review, measurable improvement, and thoughtful automation to get better over time. We want leaders who can set a high bar while creating trust, psychological safety, and accountability across regions and functions.

Why this role matters

This is a rare opportunity to lead one of the most important security functions in a global software company. You’ll influence how Atlassian handles major incidents, matures its response capabilities, and invests in the future of security operations. You’ll work on meaningful problems at the intersection of incident command, operations, engineering, and trust, help define how investigative AI and automation can responsibly improve security response at scale, and partner with senior security and business leaders while building durable systems, stronger responders, and better outcomes for customers.

Compensation

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, AI Functions
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to join our leadership team in the AI Functions product portfolio, a hybrid director/principal engineer role at the forefront of AI-powered analytics.

Our mission is to democratize AI by surfacing powerful AI functions directly in SQL for analyzing structured and unstructured data, with minimal configuration. We handle the full AI lifecycle behind the scenes, so data analysts, engineers, and scientists can build data transformation pipelines with AI using the most sophisticated building blocks seamlessly within their existing SQL workflows.

The AI Functions product portfolio represents one of the most strategic and impactful product surfaces within Snowflake, bringing together two of the company's core strengths: its industry-leading ability to process massive volumes of data and its growing capability to make that data AI-ready. By embedding advanced AI and LLM-powered functions directly into SQL, this portfolio transforms Snowflake from a data platform into an intelligent data system where structured and unstructured data can be seamlessly prepared, enriched, and analyzed using AI at scale. This convergence enables customers to operationalize AI within their existing workflows, unlocking faster insights, more powerful applications, and a fundamentally new way to interact with data.

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Create and own architecture and design, influence our product roadmap, and identify new initiatives that push Snowflake's technology forward for our customers
Set the strategic vision for the team and drive accountability for plans and deliverables
Solve real business needs at scale by applying strong software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills
Drive team projects from ideation through implementation in partnership with cross-functional teams
Foster a culture of creativity and innovation while ensuring sound, practical decision-making
Lead organizational structure evolution and improve engineering efficiency
Hire, develop, and mentor senior technical leaders
Manage, grow, and mentor the teams that have a significant impact on the success of the overall Snowflake product

WE WOULD LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE:

Advanced degree in Computer Science
10+ years of software engineering experience with recent hands-on experience
2+ years of engineering director experience, including managing managers
Deep experience with AI infrastructure and LLMs
Experience building large-scale query processing or distributed systems
Strong track record of recruiting and growing technical teams
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across global organizations

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Join us at the forefront of AI innovation where you'll lead transformative initiatives that shape the future of data and artificial intelligence. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge LLM technology while building and mentoring high-performing engineering teams. Our culture promotes innovation, technical excellence, and collaborative problem-solving, offering you the platform to make a significant impact on enterprise AI solutions.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we are scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact?

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company's confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Position Summary

The Director of Engineering is a hands-on working leader
responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, repair, and overall condition of Chaminade Resort & Spa’s physical property. This position requires a strong technical background and an individual who is comfortable working alongside the Engineering team—not simply directing from an office.

The Director of Engineering will lead by example, personally assisting with troubleshooting, repairs, preventative maintenance, inspections, projects, and emergency response. This position is responsible for ensuring that guest rooms, public spaces, back-of-house areas, mechanical systems, grounds, recreational facilities, and resort infrastructure are maintained to the highest standards of safety, functionality, and appearance.

The ideal candidate is a working engineer and strong leader
who can diagnose problems, pick up a tool when needed, teach the team, prioritize work, and hold themselves and others accountable for maintaining a premier resort property.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Hands-On Engineering & Maintenance

Serve as an active, working member of the Engineering team and regularly perform maintenance and repair work throughout the property.
Personally troubleshoot and repair plumbing, electrical, HVAC, mechanical, carpentry, appliance, and general building maintenance issues.
Respond directly to guest room and public area maintenance calls when needed.
Perform preventative maintenance inspections and repairs throughout the resort.
Conduct daily property walks to identify maintenance, safety, cleanliness, and appearance concerns.
Inspect guest rooms, meeting spaces, public areas, back-of-house areas, pools, spa facilities, recreational areas, and grounds.
Assist Engineering team members with complex repairs and technical issues.
Train team members through hands-on demonstration and coaching.
Maintain tools, equipment, mechanical rooms, workshops, and Engineering storage areas in a clean, organized, and professional condition.
Be willing and able to work alongside the team during periods of high workload, staffing shortages, emergencies, or major projects.
Respond to emergency maintenance situations and facility-related guest concerns quickly and professionally.

Building Systems & Equipment

Maintain and troubleshoot HVAC systems, electrical systems, plumbing, pumps, water systems, boilers, appliances, lighting, mechanical equipment, and other property systems.
Oversee and personally participate in preventative maintenance programs.
Monitor building automation and energy management systems.
Maintain pools, spas, water features, and related mechanical and chemical systems in accordance with applicable requirements.
Ensure fire/life safety systems and emergency equipment are properly maintained and inspected.
Maintain accurate records of equipment, repairs, inspections, warranties, and preventative maintenance.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead the Engineering team through a hands-on management approach.
Set the standard for work quality, urgency, professionalism, and guest service.
Work alongside Engineering associates and provide coaching and technical guidance in real time.
Train team members on proper repair techniques, preventative maintenance, safety procedures, and equipment operation.
Schedule and assign daily work based on occupancy, guest needs, property priorities, and staffing levels.
Monitor completion and quality of work orders.
Hold team members accountable for performance, attendance, productivity, safety, and department standards.
Create a culture where the Engineering team takes pride in the appearance and condition of the resort.
Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance management, and development of Engineering associates.

Preventative Maintenance

Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preventative maintenance program.
Establish recurring inspection and maintenance schedules for guest rooms, equipment, mechanical systems, and facilities.
Track completion of preventative maintenance and identify recurring issues.
Analyze equipment failures and determine root causes to reduce repeat repairs.
Proactively identify aging equipment and recommend replacement or improvement.
Ensure guest rooms and facilities are returned to excellent condition following repairs.

Capital Projects & Renovations

Assist with planning, coordinating, and executing capital improvement projects.
Be actively involved in renovation and construction projects from planning through completion.
Perform hands-on work when appropriate and coordinate Engineering labor to support projects.
Manage contractors and vendors while ensuring work meets property standards.
Inspect completed work and identify deficiencies requiring correction.
Minimize disruption to guests and hotel operations during projects.
Maintain documentation related to projects, equipment, warranties, and completed work.

Budget & Financial Management

Develop and manage the Engineering department operating budget.
Monitor labor, supplies, repair costs, utilities, equipment, and outside service expenses.
Identify opportunities to reduce expenses through preventative maintenance and efficient operations.
Evaluate whether repairs should be completed internally or contracted to outside vendors.
Maintain appropriate inventory of parts, tools, supplies, and equipment.
Obtain quotes and manage vendor relationships.
Review invoices and service agreements for accuracy and value.

Safety & Compliance

Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, building codes, and safety requirements.
Maintain required permits, inspections, licenses, and certifications.
Oversee fire/life safety inspections, testing, and maintenance.
Ensure proper pool and spa maintenance and water quality.
Maintain OSHA and workplace safety standards.
Ensure proper storage, handling, and disposal of chemicals and hazardous materials.
Conduct regular safety inspections and immediately address hazards.
Participate in emergency preparedness and response procedures.

Energy & Sustainability

Monitor utility usage and identify opportunities to reduce energy and water consumption.
Maintain HVAC, lighting, plumbing, and other systems for maximum efficiency.
Identify equipment or operational changes that can reduce utility costs.
Support resort sustainability and environmental initiatives.

Guest Service

Recognize that Engineering is a critical part of the overall guest experience.
Respond promptly and professionally to guest maintenance concerns.
Follow up on recurring guest room issues and ensure problems are permanently resolved.
Partner with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Spa, Recreation, and other departments to resolve property-related issues.
Maintain a professional and service-oriented presence throughout the resort.
Take ownership of property issues rather than simply passing them along to others.

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of progressive engineering, maintenance, or facilities experience, preferably within a full-service hotel or resort.
Previous Engineering leadership or supervisory experience required.
Strong hands-on technical knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical systems, carpentry, and general building maintenance.
Demonstrated ability to personally troubleshoot and complete repairs.
Experience leading and developing a maintenance or engineering team.
Experience with preventative maintenance programs.
Strong understanding of hotel operations and the importance of guest service.
Experience with budgets, purchasing, vendors, contractors, and capital projects.
Knowledge of applicable building, safety, environmental, and fire/life safety regulations.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Excellent communication and organizational skills.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and emergency situations.
Computer proficiency and experience with computerized maintenance management systems preferred.
Engineering, facilities, construction, or trade certifications are preferred.
Must be comfortable working with tools and performing hands-on maintenance and repair work on a regular basis.

Physical Requirements

This is a hands-on operational position
requiring regular physical activity.

Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crawl, climb ladders and stairs, and work in confined or elevated spaces.
Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull equipment, tools, and materials.
Ability to safely operate hand tools and power tools.
Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Ability to respond quickly to emergency situations throughout the resort.
Ability to perform physical maintenance and repair tasks as required.

Key Competencies

Hands-On Leadership
Technical Troubleshooting
Mechanical Aptitude
Preventative Maintenance
Team Development
Guest Service
Problem Solving
Safety & Compliance
Project Management

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI Agents
jobs.description:
About The Role

AI Teammates are agents that work like actual team members in Asana — they triage bugs, respond to requests, draft project briefs, conduct research, and handle complex knowledge work across workflows. Unlike chatbots, Teammates are shared team resources that build memory and context across all executions, getting smarter as your team works with them. Currently live with Fortune 500 customers, AI Teammates represent Asana's shift from tracking work to getting work done.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the AI Teammates Platform team — the core engineering team responsible for the execution engine and capability layer that powers AI Teammates. You'll manage a senior team of approximately eight engineers (ICs up to L6) building the systems that determine how AI Teammates reason, execute, and improve over time — from model integration and rollout, to proactive agent behavior, to the developer platform that enables other Asana teams to build on top of AI Teammates.

This is a rare opportunity to be at the forefront of Agentic AI. You'll work directly with model partners, lead the core team behind a new applied AI product introduction, and help define how AI agents collaborate with humans in a work management platform used by millions of teams worldwide.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

About Asana AI

Asana AI is the company's number one priority. We're building the future of human/AI collaboration — going beyond chatbots to integrate AI into everyday workflows for some of the biggest companies on the planet.

Asana's AI Teammates deliver a secure, multi-player, enterprise-grade agentic experience. They're transforming Asana from a place where work is tracked to a place where work gets done. Our AI teams move quickly, with a track record of successful launches, and we're just getting started.

About The Team

AI Teammates Platform owns the execution engine and capability layer that powers Asana's AI agents — the core systems that determine how Teammates reason, execute, and improve over time.

The team's ownership spans model upgrades (evaluating, integrating, and rolling out new LLMs), proactive and autonomous agent behavior, platform and developer experience for Asana's broader engineering organization, and quality and evaluation infrastructure. Peer teams — Agent Orchestration and AI Chat — build on the platform, while the Teammates Experience team owns the user-facing layer.

We're a senior team, fast-moving, and working on some of the hardest applied AI problems in enterprise software.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What You’ll Achieve

Lead and grow the AI Teammates Platform team of ~8 senior engineers, setting technical direction and driving execution on core AI agent capabilities.
Own the technical vision for the execution engine, including model integration, proactive agent behavior, and evaluation infrastructure.
Drive the team’s model upgrade pipeline by evaluating new LLMs and balancing execution quality against latency and cost.
Build and maintain the platform that enables other Asana engineering teams to build AI-powered features on top of AI Teammates.
Partner with Product, Design, and Data Science to define and execute roadmap priorities that support Asana’s top company priority.
Collaborate with peer teams like Agent Orchestration and AI Chat on shared infrastructure, APIs, and cross-team initiatives.
Drive team delivery pace and improve engineering velocity while championing the adoption of AI coding tools.
Attract, retain, and develop exceptional senior engineering talent in a highly competitive market.

About You

7+ years of experience in software engineering, including 4+ years managing technical teams.
Applied AI experience is essential, including at least one year of hands-on experience building products on top of large language models.
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural decisions in a fast-moving, ambiguous AI product space.
Experience building and scaling platform teams that serve multiple product surfaces and internal engineering consumers.
Comfortable with ambiguity and thriving in "zero-to-one" product environments to drive clarity from complexity.
Effective cross-functional collaborator who builds strong partnerships across Engineering, Product, and Data Science.
Track record of driving engineering velocity improvements and adopting developer productivity tooling.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What We’ll Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $264,000 - $300,000
. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
Career coaching & support
Inclusive family building benefits
Long-term savings or retirement plans
In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About Us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

THE ROLE

As Imprint's Senior Engineering Manager for Security, you will report to the Director of Engineering for Trust & Security. You will own the entire security engineering foundation. This includes AI security governance, application security, cloud infrastructure, detection and response, and identity management. You'll build this with AI leverage from day one, scaling a small team's impact with modern tooling.

Imprint is deliberately small and talent-dense. We use AI and tooling to give every person outsized leverage. This is a role where you can stay hands-on for as long as it makes sense. You set the strategic direction and do the work. Whether that balance shifts over time depends on what the business needs and what you want to build.

We power co-branded credit card programs for 10+ enterprise partners, with AI embedded across the business: underwriting, servicing, and how we build software. That AI leverage is core to how Imprint operates, and it creates a security challenge worth solving: how do you build an AI-forward security posture for an organization that moves this fast?

WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

Stay Hands-On: Write detection rules, review PRs, file hardening commits, and threat-model features alongside engineering teams. If you've been pushed into pure management and miss building, this role gives you permission to get back to it while still setting strategic direction.
AI-Native Security: Build security capabilities using AI agents for detection triage, compliance automation, and dependency management. You'll secure AI products and use AI to multiply your own leverage. This is how a small team operates at the standards of a company 10x its size.
Full-Stack Ownership: Own the entire security domain: application security, cloud infrastructure, detection engineering, and AI governance.
Preventative, Not Reactive: Build security that scales with the business rather than firefighting inherited problems. Do it right from the start, before bad patterns harden.
Series D Sweet Spot: We have product-market fit and real traction, but we're still small enough for you to shape everything. Your decisions will drive our security posture for years to come.
High-Trust Domain: Co-branded credit cards in regulated fintech (PCI, SOC 2, ISO). Security isn't a tax here; it's what enables every partner launch and every customer interaction.

What You Will Own

AI security: threat-model Imprint's agent surfaces for prompt injection, tool misuse, and authorization boundaries.
AI for security: build AI-native capabilities that scale a small team's impact: AI-powered detection triage, automated compliance evidence collection, and threat-modeling assistance.
Application security: threat modeling for new features, secure code review, SAST/SCA/DAST in CI, SDL design, dependency management, and secrets management. You read Go and TypeScript well enough to review PRs and catch the bugs that external audits should not have to find.
Cloud and infrastructure security: IAM partitioning across multiple AWS accounts, least-privilege access, JIT elevation, cross-account trust hardening, KMS boundaries, SCP design, Kubernetes pod security, egress filtering, and Terraform security review.
Detection and response: build the SIEM/SOAR pipeline from log sources through triage, write correlation rules, enable AI-powered triage, stand up on-call rotation, and create incident response runbooks.
Identity and access: drive SSO coverage, access reviews, and JIT elevation in partnership with IT.
Compliance partnership: design and implement the controls that satisfy SOC 2, PCI, and ISO evidence requirements. GRC runs the audit cycle. You own the underlying controls and make sure they actually hold up, not just pass sampling.
Partner and customer trust: lead technical responses to third-party questionnaires and partner security reviews alongside GRC.

What We Look For

8+ years in security engineering, with experience building a security function from early stages
Someone who builds and ships controls, not just identifies problems for others to fix
Reads and reviews code in production languages (Go, TypeScript, Python, or similar)
Detection engineering experience: has built a SIEM or SOAR pipeline from log sources through triage at least once
Deep AWS security knowledge: IAM policy design, multi-account strategies, and how cloud privilege escalation works
Has operated inside PCI DSS scope and shipped controls that survived a real audit
Good judgment on scope: knows when to fix something directly versus set an SLA and hand it to the responsible team
Comfortable using AI tools to scale a small security team while working within existing architecture and review processes

NICE TO HAVE

Experience as the first or early security hire at a high-growth fintech or marketplace
Background at companies like Ramp, Mercury, Stripe, Whatnot, or similar fast-scaling environments
Experience securing AI and ML systems, model pipelines, or AI-assisted development workflows
Familiarity with card issuing, payment processing, or financial services infrastructure
Terraform and Helm fluency with hands-on CI/CD security integration experience
Open source contributions, security research, or conference speaking

If you've built something real in security and want to do it again, we want to talk.

Perks & Benefits

Competitive compensation and equity packages
Leading configured work computers of your choice
Flexible paid time off
Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage
Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA
20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents
Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - AI Geospatial Assistant Team
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

Planet’s mission is to image the entire world every day, making global change visible, accessible, and actionable. We are at a critical inflection point: operationalizing promising AI research into delivery-focused enterprise "productization". To drive this, we are building a new product group focused on launching an AI Geospatial Assistant
that transforms how our customers interact with global imagery to solve high-stakes problems in forensics and daily change detection.

Our goal is to make these complex insights accessible through an intuitive interface that requires zero user training. Operating with a zero-to-one startup mindset, this team prioritizes weekly learning velocity and customer-driven graduation criteria to move rapidly from private alpha to general availability.

As our Senior Engineering Manager, you are tasked with leading the team, with your product partner through this transition. You will lead a high-velocity squad of engineers, transitioning geospatial AI capabilities into a robust, market-ready product. Your focus is on operational excellence, defining success thresholds, managing scope, and ensuring that our bleeding-edge tech graduates into a dependable tool that provides a durable competitive advantage for our customers.

This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role. The EM for this team is expected to be personally AI-native, someone who builds with AI tools daily, thinks actively about how AI is changing what engineering teams look like, and is prepared to pioneer a culture where AI is a core collaborator in the development process, not a tool to be managed cautiously.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own

Build a High-Density Talent Engine: You will be responsible for the full talent lifecycle—from sourcing and hiring the initial high-agency founding squad to designing an onboarding experience that gets specialists productive in a complex geospatial domain.
Establish a Culture of Extreme Ownership: Foster an environment where engineers own customer outcomes rather than just technical tasks. You will define what accountability looks like in a high-uncertainty, non-deterministic AI environment.
Team Operations: Design and iterate on the team’s "operating system" (e.g., sprint cadences, RFC processes, and automated testing) to ensure the shift from research to product is supported by rigorous engineering discipline.
Collaborate with AI Researchers: Work closely with our AI Research Team to understand their models, workflows, and emerging capabilities, then guide your team in translating research into production ready systems that deliver real value to users.
Establish Evaluation-Led Development: Ensure the team builds "Evals" (automated benchmarks) before they build features, ensuring that we measure improvement velocity rather than just raw output.
Career Architecture & Mentorship: Actively coach and mentor a diverse group of engineers (from Fullstack to Applied AI), navigating their career paths and maintaining high levels of psychological safety and engagement.
Strategic Roadmapping & De-risking: Partner with Product and Design to translate the ai.planet.com vision into a realistic technical roadmap, identifying "long-pole" technical risks early to keep the team unblocked.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a "board of directors" member alongside Product and Design partners, ensuring engineering efforts are laser-focused on forensics and change-detection use cases.

What You Bring

6+ years of relevant experience
4+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
Track record of hiring and leading founding engineering teams in a startup or high-growth "intrapreneurial" environment.
Personally AI-native: you write production code with AI tools, have strong opinions on how AI is changing the engineering SDLC, and are prepared to build a culture where AI is a core collaborator, not a compliance consideration
Experience and enthusiasm for leading AI engineering teams that have successfully elevated research prototypes into production-grade applications. This enthusiasm should not only inform the product features, but should also foster a culture of developer workflows that take an AI-assisted development approach
Expert in the "human element" of engineering—managing conflict, delivering difficult feedback, and keeping a team motivated through the inevitable pivots of an early-stage product.
Ability to identify "process bugs" (why a team is slowing down) and implement the cultural or structural changes needed to restore velocity.
Technical Breadth: While you may not be the deepest specialist on the team, you have the breadth to synthesize input from AI researchers and frontend experts to make sound architectural and personnel decisions. This includes an ability to identify optimizations that may be better handled with a collaboration with a research team (eg. request development of a fine tuned model for a slow but simple LLM call)
Pragmatic Execution: A "good enough—move on" mentality that avoids seeking perfection at the cost of delivering meaningful customer value.
Impact focused: You are excited by building an application that once launched, will give researchers, journalists, governments, and NGOs the ability to explore the world using natural language and surface crucial insights that used to take months to find.
Experience with geospatial data or planetary-scale analytics is highly preferred.

What Makes You Stand Out

LLM Observability and Monitoring: Prior experience with tools and techniques for managing non-deterministic systems (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, or similar).
Public Leadership: You are comfortable representing the team’s work to executive leadership and external stakeholders, acting as a "shield" for your team so they can focus on building.
Product-First Mindset: A track record of balancing technical excellence with the urgency of market delivery and "graduation criteria".
Geospatial Context: Prior experience with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or planetary-scale analytics.

Benefits While Working At Planet

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution
Generous Paid Time Off in addition to holidays and company-wide days off

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Engineering

Location:
Remote (company based in Philadelphia, PA)

About the Role

We're seeking a Director of Engineering to lead a small, established engineering team through its next stage of growth. Recently acquired by Metro Global, the company has the stability and backing of institutional ownership and is at an inflection point: ready to modernize its development practices, sharpen execution, and accelerate delivery.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role, combining small-company freedom, influence, and growth with stable backing and resources. You'll lead a team of ~twenty engineers across backend, frontend, and QA while staying close enough to the code and architecture to make technical decisions. You'll partner closely with existing technical leadership to set direction and own the day-to-day execution that turns vision into shipped product.

You should be passionate about designing and iterating on development processes, leveraging AI tools, helping the team perform at their best, and solving varied problems as the company grows. Responsibilities

What We're Looking For

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Rocket Motor Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

About The Job

As the Director of Engineering, your role is to provide strategic oversight and tactical management for our engineering teams. In this critical leadership position, you will be responsible for developing new rocket motor products and enabling the scaling of high-volume rocket motor production. You will ensure rigorous engineering development processes are in place, driving the consistent delivery of superior quality products. This role guarantees the fulfillment of manufacturing's capacity commitments while advancing digital tools and methodologies to improve design, analysis, and execution. Success in this role requires an innovative and adaptable approach to solving complex design and manufacturing challenges in a highly dynamic environment.

What You’ll Do

Own the tactical execution of product development work, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality engineering products.
Cultivate a proactive, responsive team culture emphasizing ownership, quality, and appropriate engineering rigor (balancing speed with precision).
Set clear goals, objectives, and performance expectations for teams and individuals; conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Manage and prioritize team resource allocation to effectively support multiple product development programs, balancing competing priorities.
Recruit, hire, and retain top-tier engineering talent, providing coaching, mentorship, and career development opportunities.
Ensure alignment between product and technical roadmaps and overall business objectives.
Establish and champion a Design Engineering Center of Excellence, driving the creation, documentation, and adoption of engineering best practices and processes across functional areas.
Identify and advocate for new tools, technologies, and capabilities (e.g., advanced simulation software, novel test equipment, material characterization techniques) to support future product design needs.
Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure team effectiveness, responsiveness, and the impact of process improvements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for technical roadblocks, resource conflicts, and complex interdisciplinary challenges.
Be ultimately accountable for the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of all team deliverables, including design and analysis reports, test plans, material specifications, and technical recommendations.
Ensure critical knowledge is captured and institutionalized by overseeing the documentation of design, analysis, test results, and material data to shorten future design cycles.
Collaborate with the Director of Chief Engineering to communicate portfolio strategy, major product milestones, accomplishments, and significant risks to executive leadership.
Build and maintain strong strategic partnerships with senior leaders in Program/Technical Program Management, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain for smooth, end-to-end product delivery.
Proactively communicate the portfolio's execution status, resource constraints, and key successes to all stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities and deliverables.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering (or related technical field).
Proven experience (typically 8+ years) in engineering leadership and management roles, with a focus on end-to-end technical delivery.
Demonstrated experience in developing and scaling complex hardware products, specifically rocket motors or similar high-volume, high-precision systems.
Strong background in establishing and optimizing rigorous engineering development processes, quality assurance, configuration management, and V&V strategies.
Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of building, mentoring, and inspiring high-performing engineering teams.
Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and project management, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with an innovative and adaptable approach to complex problem-solving.
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with solid rocket motors.

US Salary Range

$219,000—$290,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. The Sunset Marquis is a four-diamond hotel located in West Hollywood and includes Cavatina restaurant, Bar 1200, and SPA. An iconic West Hollywood Hotel is seeking a Director of Engineering and Facilities to provide proactive and strategic leadership for the operations, maintenance, safety, appearance and continual improvement of the hotel and its supporting facilities and systems. The position oversees all physical components of the hotel. As a member of the hotel’s leadership team, the Director’s role will entail both responding operational and maintenance issues as they arise, but, more importantly, extend to anticipation of the needs of the physical plant, identification of opportunities for improvement, establishment of a disciplined preventive-maintenance culture, leadership of the planning for capital and sustainability initiatives and management of regulatory compliance. The primary objective of the position is to inspire and initiate continual advancement of the hotel engineering services to improve the guest experience, increase departmental efficiency, and enhance the long-term performance and longevity of the property.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
include the following, other duties may be assigned.

Maintain Complete Knowledge Of

All hotel features/services, hours of operation, policies, and procedures.

All hotel room types, numbers/names, and layout.

Daily house count and expected arrivals/departures.

In-house events and current/upcoming external events.

Provide visible, hands-on leadership for all Hotel Engineering and Facilities for the property’s 24-hour operations, establishing policies and procedures, service standards, response expectations, work priorities, and accountability for quality control and timely completion of tasks.

Develop and execute a comprehensive preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance program for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, boilers, pumps, domestic hot water, refrigeration, kitchen equipment including quarterly removal of grease from trap, sewage and drainage pipes remain clear, elevators, fire and life-safety systems, pools, access-control systems, lighting, roofs, building envelope, grounds, and other property assets.

Maintain an accurate computerized maintenance management system, including tracking of asset inventories, equipment histories, warranties, manuals, preventive-maintenance schedules, work orders, labor and material usage, inspections, and closeout documentation; actively analyzing the data to identify recurring failures, adverse trends, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, and asset life.

Conduct frequent, self-directed property walks and room inspections with a discerning eye for details that fall short of the hotel’s standards; identify conditions affecting safety, code compliance, energy use, guest comfort, luxury presentation, efficiency, and asset life before they are noticed by guests or develop into larger problems; assign corrective actions, establish deadlines, and verify project completion.

Anticipate and prevent issues that may adversey impact guest experience through disciplined inspection, trend analysis, planning, and timely intervention. When an issue or operational emergency occurs, respond promptly, coordinate service recovery with hotel leaders, communicate realistic timelines, determine and correct the root cause, and implement measures to prevent recurrence.

Serve as the hotel’s technical leader during power failures, floods, leaks, fire alarms, elevator entrapments, utility interruptions, equipment failures, severe weather, earthquakes, and other emergencies; participate in incident command and business-continuity planning.

Recruit, train, schedule, coach, and evaluate engineering employees; establish technical-development plans, shift coverage, call-out protocols, safety expectations, and succession planning.

Ensure employees and contractors are trained and follow lockout/tagout, hazard communication, electrical safety, ladder and fall protection, confined-space, respiratory-protection, hot-work, high pressure hydro jet system, personal protective equipment, ergonomics, and other applicable safety procedures.

Manage department payroll, labor productivity, operating expenses, repair and maintenance budgets, inventory and cost controls, purchasing, and financial forecasts;

Develop and continuously updated annual and multiyear capital improvement plans using condition assessments, lifecycle analysis, risk, guest impact, code requirements, sustainability objectives, emerging technology, while remaining mindful of ROI aspirations for capital deployment;

Lead renovation, repair, and capital projects from concept through closeout, including design coordination, permitting, bidding, contract administration, shutdown planning, quality control, commissioning, punch lists, and warranty management.

Select and oversee qualified vendors, consultants, and contractors; verify insurance, licensing, safety compliance, work quality, invoicing, site conduct, and adherence to hotel security and guest-privacy requirements.

Maintain required permits, inspection records, testing certificates, equipment logs, safety documentation, and corrective-action records; coordinate professionally with authorities having jurisdiction and third-party inspectors.

Oversee fire and life-safety readiness, including alarm and suppression systems, emergency generators, fire pumps, extinguishers, egress components, testing schedules, impairment controls, drills, and documentation in partnership with Security and hotel leadership.

Oversee energy, water, waste, and sustainability programs; establishing performance targets, monitor results to ensure objectives are being met;

Maintain water-management and indoor-environmental-quality programs addressing pools and spas, domestic water, cooling systems, moisture intrusion, mold prevention, ventilation, and other building-health concerns within assigned responsibility.

Proactively partner with other Key Hotel Department heads to identify recurring concerns, minimize disruption to operations, and develop engineering solutions that support hotel activities.

Establish critical spare-parts levels, shop organization, tool accountability, chemical storage, key control, mechanical-room standards, and secure access to restricted building areas.

Remain current on building technology, hospitality engineering practices, applicable codes, regulatory developments, and innovative solutions; build an external network of technical resources, attend relevant training, maintain professional credentials, and proactively recommend pilots, upgrades, and operating changes that can improve the property.

Competencies

Safety leadership and regulatory readiness.

Strategic capital planning and project execution.

jobs.title: Director of Software Development
jobs.description:
About Karmak

Karmak is a 100% employee-owned software company that has helped keep the commercial transportation industry moving for more than 40 years. Our flagship platform, Karmak Fusion
, powers the parts, service, accounting, and business operations of heavy-duty truck dealerships and transportation companies across North America. Simply put, our customers keep America moving-and we build the technology that helps them do it.

We develop on the Microsoft technology stack, including .NET, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure
, creating modern, scalable solutions for a mission-critical industry. As employee-owners, we think beyond our individual roles and share responsibility for our company's success. We're looking for leaders who embrace that same ownership mindset and are excited to make a lasting impact.

Position Summary

Remote (US); limited travel (1–2 trips per year)

The Director of Software Development is responsible for the management and daily execution of Karmak's development organization in support of Karmak Fusion. Leading through four development managers spanning application development, QA, and database/reporting teams (a 30+ person engineering organization), this position owns the flow of work between Support, Implementation, Product, DBA, and the development teams; serves as the development-side approval authority on customer patches; and makes go/no-go decisions across a multi-version release train.

The Director is the primary point of escalation into development for the rest of the organization and the VP of Development's operational right hand - a role requiring the technical credibility to challenge a root-cause analysis, the judgment to weigh customer risk on every patch and release decision, and the leadership to run cross-team incident response when a customer-impacting issue crosses team boundaries.

How You'll Operate

This role is built for a high-agency leader. Here is the working relationship you should expect:

You'll get context and priorities from the VP of Development - not task lists. We expect you to identify what will move the needle, commit to outcomes, and run with them. You bring the VP problems with proposed answers, not open questions.
This is not a hands-on coding role, but you haven't stopped being an engineer. You can read C# and SQL, sit in architecture and root-cause reviews and challenge them, and tell a real fix from a symptom patch. Senior engineers respect you because of it.
You own escalations end to end: you move them, you don't track them. When plans change, you re-plan in hours, not weeks, and keep the train moving.
You communicate proactively upward so leadership is never blindsided. Exceptions come with verified data, options, and a recommendation.

What You'll Own In Year One

Success in this role is measured in outcomes, not activity. In your first year, a home run looks like:

Release predictability - Releases and patches across the multi-version release train ship on schedule with fewer defect escapes, and go/no-go discipline holds at every checkpoint - without the VP in the room.
Escalations owned and closed - Escalations from Support, Implementation, and Product get a single accountable owner, are driven to root cause rather than symptom fixes, and are closed with clear communication - they stop bouncing upward.
AI-assisted development adoption - The organization measurably advances on AI-assisted engineering - code analysis, automated review, test automation, and agentic tooling - with honest evaluation of where it multiplies velocity and where it doesn't.
Manager bench strength - The four development managers grow into leaders who plan, prioritize, and make sound calls with less direction - the organization runs well when you step away from it.

Essential Job Functions

Provide technical leadership and direction to the development managers and their teams, assisting with planning, prioritization, technology assessment, professional development, and cross-team coordination
Serve as the development-side approval authority on customer patches, weighing patch-versus-upgrade paths, deployment risk windows, and multi-version complexity; ensure patch decisions protect both the customer and the maintainability of the release line
Own go/no-go decisions at each release checkpoint - integration close, QA greenlight, smoke test, packaging, and staged customer rollout - including the authority to hold or pause a release when quality or customer risk demands it
Serve as the primary point of escalation to development for Support, Implementation, and Product; route issues to the correct team or subject-matter expert, chase them to closure, and keep requestors informed with clear status and next steps
Lead incident response for customer-impacting issues that cross team boundaries; drive to root cause rather than symptom fixes, convene the right people quickly, and communicate resolution paths to stakeholders
Direct the daily product delivery rhythm in partnership with Support, DBA, Installations, and Product, and chair recurring quality reviews with the support organization, converting findings into tracked work items
Keep the VP of Development ahead of surprises: escalate exceptions with verified data, options, and a recommendation; draft customer-facing technical communications for executive review
Manage relationships with external technical consultants and vendors in support of development initiatives
Champion continuous improvement of engineering practice, including branch and merge policy, automated code review, test automation, and AI-assisted development tooling
Manage the personnel activities of the team to include hiring, training, and evaluating employees; lead merit and salary planning through the development managers
Lead the team in change management and effectively apply new process improvements
Embrace self-development, professional growth, and desire for feedback for individual growth
Maintain confidentiality
Be a champion for Karmak and the team

Essential Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Bachelor's degree (B.A./B.S.) in Computer Science or a related field and a minimum of 10 years of software development experience, including 5+ years leading developers and experience managing managers or an organization of 30+ engineers; or equivalent combination of education and experience
Required: current technical depth on the Microsoft development stack - able to read and reason about .NET code (C#/VB.NET) and Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL, database design, query performance) well enough to be credible with senior engineers, interrogate a root-cause analysis, and distinguish a real fix from a symptom patch
Strongly preferred: experience running teams that build and operate on Microsoft Azure (PaaS services, cloud architecture) and Azure DevOps for work tracking, pipelines, and release management
Direct experience owning production release and patch decisions for commercial, customer-installed or hosted software, including versioned release trains and customer-impact risk assessment; ERP or other business-critical domain experience strongly preferred
A demonstrated pattern of high-agency ownership: identifying what matters, driving it to done without waiting for direction, and being accountable for outcomes, not just process
Demonstrated pattern of calm incident leadership and cross-functional coordination across support, QA, DBA, and product organizations
Exceptional team leadership skills, including the ability to effectively coach, motivate, and empower team members and develop the judgment of front-line managers
Ability to build and sustain trusted relationships internally and externally, sound judgment in dealing with business issues, and the instinct to communicate proactively upward so leadership is never blindsided
Strong initiative, teamwork, and interpersonal skills; strong written and verbal communication skills, including drafting customer-facing technical communications
Capable of working in a growth-oriented environment, with ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent requests, projects, and responsibilities
Hands-on experience adopting AI-assisted development practices (code analysis, automated review, agentic tooling) preferred
Knowledge of the heavy-duty or commercial transportation industry a plus

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties. Additional responsibilities may be assigned by Karmak.
