jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Loyalty Product
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
Role Overview

Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Loyalty product that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP).
Reporting to Sr. Director, Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core loyalty features. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.
Zeta Loyalty helps brands move beyond static loyalty programs with intelligent experiences designed to deepen engagement. The next gen Zeta Loyalty platform is envisioned to be AI-powered and agentic.
This is a technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable Loyalty product capabilities at scale.
Loyalty Product Mission

Zeta Loyalty provides a configurable program definition, member foundation, reference data, rules engine, and offer capabilities required to launch enterprise grade loyalty programs.
Rather than simply managing points, this product creates a flexible loyalty platform that enables brands to define their program, reward customer behaviors, and evolve their loyalty strategy without requiring custom engineering.
The key mission of the product is tightly integrating with other services of the ZMP, such as identity, events, messaging and seamlessly executing the loyalty program rules based on user behavior. Additionally, there is an urgent need to integrate Loyalty with AthenaOS, Zeta’s AI-powered assistant, to bring predictive intelligence, real-time activation, conversational AI into the loyalty domain.
Scope of Ownership

Own the complete Loyalty product suite, which includes, but not limited to:
Customizable loyalty programs
Configurable reward rules
Flexible tiering structure
Reward points tracking
Tight Integration with system notification & user messaging frameworks
Omnichannel support
Unified ZMP Identity
Unified ZMP Analytics

The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for the architecture, implementation, operational excellence, observability, monitoring & reliability of the owned products.
Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned domains.
Translate product strategy into executable engineering roadmaps.
Participate in quarterly planning and deliver the workloads on a timely manner, with high quality
Drive technical design for services, APIs, schemas, background jobs.
Review designs and ensure alignment with platform architecture and engineering standards.
Identify scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability risks.
Champion reusable solutions and eliminate unnecessary duplication across different features.

Engineering Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing team of engineers and technical leads.
Coach and develop engineers through mentoring, technical guidance, and regular feedback.
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering best practices within the team.
Foster a culture of operational excellence, engineering quality, and continuous improvement.
Balance new investments with operational responsibilities and technical debt.
Work with other engineering teams to transform the Loyalty product into a seamlessly integrated ZMP offering

Cross-Team Collaboration

Partner with Product and Engineering teams, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, Security, and FinOps teams.
Coordinate delivery of initiatives that span multiple engineering teams.
Resolve technical dependencies and implementation challenges.
Drive alignment around platform standards and engineering best practices.
Communicate technical trade-offs, priorities, and delivery risks clearly. 

Reliability, Security, and Operational Excellence

Ensure the product services & components meet availability, latency, scalability, and recovery objectives.
Embed observability, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational readiness into platform design.
Improve tenant isolation, workload fairness, and platform resiliency.
Partner with Security teams to build secure-by-default platform capabilities.
Drive continuous improvements in operational efficiency, reliability, and cloud cost optimization.

Success Measures

Success will be measured through:
Delivery of Loyalty roadmap commitments
Hire engineers, build and lead a team dedicated to development of the Loyalty product as per agreed plan
Product availability, reliability, and operational health
Improved developer productivity and satisfaction
Successful migrations and retirement of legacy services
Team engagement, growth, and engineering effectiveness

Required Qualifications

Significant experience building and operating large-scale distributed platforms or multi-tenant SaaS systems.
Experience leading engineering teams responsible for application full-stack development.
Strong technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and shared platform services.
Experience designing and operating highly available production services.
Experience partnering with multiple engineering teams to deliver shared capabilities.
Strong operational knowledge of observability, incident management, and production readiness.
Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and grow technical leaders.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building marketing technology, customer-data, analytics, or large-scale SaaS platforms.
Experience with agentic applications, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, Snowflake, Iceberg, PostgreSQL, Redis, Node.js, React.js, or similar technologies.
Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Unlimited PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this role is $225,000 - $240,000, depending on location and experience.

  is a leading provider of hospitality-specific software solutions, delivering cloud-based tools for hotel accounting, financial reporting, labor management, payroll, and business intelligence. Built by hoteliers for hoteliers, M3 empowers hotel owners, operators, and management companies to streamline back-office operations, reduce costs, gain real-time insights, and drive portfolio performance across thousands of properties in North America and beyond.

We are a SaaS company specializing in accounting software for the hospitality industry, built on a modern .NET technology stack. Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the engineering organization, developing and implementing the engineering roadmap in alignment with company goals.
Oversee the design, development, and deployment of scalable, secure, and high-quality .NET-based applications and services.
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and technical excellence within the engineering team.

Champion best practices in software engineering, including agentic workflows, code reviews, automated testing, observability, and cloud-native development.
Drive innovation through the adoption of AI technologies, cloud platforms (preferably Azure), PaaS, IaaS and modern engineering approaches.
Lead a phased agentic development roadmap, from AI-assisted research and IDE copilots to prompt-based code generation, AI pair programming, and workflow-aware agents.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering - Payment Data Platform Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Job Description

If you are a software engineering leader ready to take the reins and drive impact, we've got an opportunity just for you.

As a Director of Software Engineering – Payment Data Platform Infrastructure
at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial and Investment Banking – Data Analytics Payment Team
, you own the infrastructure, reliability, and security posture underpinning the BRIE data platform and the NEO agent runtime. You set technical direction across infrastructure engineering, site reliability, and security operations, and you are accountable for these mission-critical systems running securely, stably, and at scale across a multi-region AWS and on-premises estate where the stakes and regulatory bar are high.

Job Responsibilities

Provides overall direction, oversight, and coaching for a team of engineering managers and senior technologists spanning infrastructure engineering, SRE, and SecOps for both BRIE and NEO
Owns the reliability strategy for the platform estate — SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and disaster recovery — sustaining active-active, multi-region operation across AWS and on-prem while meeting the platform's high-availability commitments
Sets the security operations agenda: threat detection and response, vulnerability and patch management, secrets and key management, and evidence for audit, risk, and regulatory reviews, maintaining CPOF compliance across all environments
Champions infrastructure-as-code, immutable deployments, and platform automation so provisioning, scaling, and remediation are repeatable, reviewable, and auditable
Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernization, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams.
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale.
Leads incident command for major events, drives blameless postmortems, and closes the loop on systemic remediation to raise overall operational stability
Anticipates the infrastructure needs of the data platform and agent runtime — compute, storage, networking, and GPU serving/training capacity — and translates them into a funded, prioritized roadmap
Makes decisions that influence resourcing, budget, tooling, and vendor selection across the infrastructure organization, and is accountable for those outcomes
Leads evaluation sessions with cloud providers, vendors, startups, and internal teams to probe architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability within existing systems and information architecture
Partners with platform, product, data, and InfoSec stakeholders, and communicates reliability, security, and cost trade-offs to senior leadership

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 8+ years applied experience, including significant time leading infrastructure, SRE, or platform organizations, with experience managing managers
Experience leading teams of technologists and managing budget, resourcing, and delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams
Hands-on background in large-scale distributed systems: system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
Deep expertise operating production systems across public cloud and on-premises data centers, including multi-region, active-active resilience and disaster recovery

The Head of Software Engineering is accountable for the structure and growth of the engineering organization, the delivery of applications and platforms that serve HITT’s project teams and jobsites nationwide, and the development of a new generation of AI-enabled engineering talent — hiring builders who already work this way and training HITT’s existing developers in new methods. Bring structure, accountability, and delivery discipline to the software engineering function, balancing execution (≈60%) with innovation (≈40%)

Engineer security, quality, and compliance into every product, in alignment with HITT’s zero trust cybersecurity strategy and NIST-aligned frameworks

Leverage external partners strategically while avoiding over-reliance on consultants, building enduring in-house engineering capability

jobs.description:
About Chalk

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

About the role

Working directly with our founders, you'll serve as the engineering site lead for our New York office. You'll start by directly managing individual contributor engineers and tech leads, and as we scale the team, you'll hire and develop engineering managers beneath you — building the leadership layer of our NYC organization from the ground up.
This is a rare opportunity to define the technical strategy, organizational structure, and engineering culture of a fast-growing AI infrastructure startup. You'll collaborate with brilliant folks, including Putnam and Advent of Code winners, former Jane Street quants, and Rust compiler contributors — all dedicated to bending the curve of what's possible in AI inference.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What you will do

Serve as the engineering site lead for New York, with ownership of all NYC engineering
Directly manage engineers building Chalk's data platform, and hire and grow engineering managers as the site scales
Partner with the founding team to set technical strategy and shape our long-term product and platform roadmap
Design the organizational structure, hiring plan, and leadership pipeline for a rapidly growing engineering site
Establish engineering processes and operating rhythms that enable high velocity without sacrificing quality
Work directly with customers and executives to understand requirements and ensure Chalk's platform solves real-world ML challenges
Define and champion Chalk's engineering culture in New York — you'll set the bar for how we attract, develop, and retain top talent

What we're looking for

10+ years of engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering management
Experience managing managers, or a clear readiness to build and lead a multi-layer organization
Previous experience at an early-stage startup
Experience building production ML systems or data infrastructure
Strong programming skills and systems thinking — you understand how things work under the hood, and you stay close to the technology
Proven ability to lead through others: hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers and engineering leaders
Executive-level communicator who can bridge technical, business, and customer contexts
Track record of delivering complex, high-stakes projects and scaling teams through rapid growth
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Experience as a site lead or founding leader of a new office or engineering hub
Experience with Rust or distributed systems
Experience with query planners or compilers
Experience implementing data infrastructure or PaaS-like software
Experience scaling engineering organizations from single-digit to multi-team in high-growth environments

jobs.description:
About The Role

zerohash is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead our Trade organization, the team responsible for the trading technology that powers execution, liquidity, and market access across our platform. As zerohash scales, we're looking for a leader with deep, hands-on trading systems expertise, a proven track record building and scaling high-performing engineering organizations, and the presence to represent trade engineering at the leadership table. We believe the best engineering leaders are technologists first, with a product and business mindset, who seek outsized impact across the company.

Responsibilities

Own the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for zerohash's trade organization, and align it with company strategy and the roadmaps of the transact, tokenize, and core teams
Build, lead, and scale a multi-team organization — hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers, principal/staff engineers, and individual contributors as the team grows
Act as the executive owner of trading systems reliability, performance, and risk, including matching engines, order/execution infrastructure, market data, and FIX connectivity
Partner directly with the CTO, SVP Engineering, product leadership, and zerohash's other VP(s) of Engineering to set org-wide technical standards, priorities, and engineering culture
Represent engineering to company leadership and key partners/clients on matters related to trading technology
Recruit, coach, and develop engineering managers and senior technical talent; build durable career paths for the team
Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Legal to ensure trading systems meet the regulatory requirements relevant to zerohash's markets
Drive build-vs-buy, technical debt, and architecture trade-off decisions at an organizational level
Stay technically credible, engage deeply enough in system design and code-level decisions to earn the trust of senior engineers and maintain competency with the codebase and system architecture

Requirements

15+ years of software design and development experience, with deep hands-on background in backend and distributed systems
8+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing managers and senior/principal/staff engineers
Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations (30+ engineers) at a high-growth fintech, trading firm, exchange, or crypto company
Experience owning multi-team technical strategy and roadmap at a VP, Director, or Head of Engineering level
Prior exposure to fast-growth startups and comfort operating with ambiguity
Exceptional executive communication skills
Strong cross-functional partnership skills with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Legal
Cloud computing experience, with AWS highly desirable
BS or MS in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience
Strong bias toward serving your team and stakeholders, with a growth mindset

Domain Knowledge

Solid understanding of market structure, order types (Limit, Market, Stop, IOC, FOK), trade lifecycle, and common risks associated with electronic trading
Familiarity with regulatory requirements relevant to trading systems (e.g., MiFID II, Reg NMS)

Deep Understanding of Trading Systems

10+ years of hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining high-performance, low-latency trading systems (e.g., central limit order books (CLOBs), matching engines, market data feeds)
Proven experience with FIX Protocol (4.2 and higher) and implementing highly reliable FIX Gateway solutions

High-Throughput / Low-Latency Development

Expertise in highly concurrent, multi-threaded, low-garbage/zero-garbage code in languages commonly used in finance such as C++, Rust, or Go
Demonstrable experience optimizing system performance to achieve single-digit microsecond latency

Core Financial Infrastructure

Strong background building and managing mission-critical backend systems such as trade booking systems, high-throughput accounting/ledger systems, and real-time credit/risk limit systems
Experience with distributed system design and messaging frameworks (e.g., Aeron, Kafka, ZeroMQ) for data distribution and persistence

Benefits

Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
Chance to earn equity
Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
WeWork All Access Membership
WFH Yearly Stipend
L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About Zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and make a difference every day.
Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About BlueShift

At BlueShift, we are rebuilding mineral processing for a world that needs more critical minerals. Our mission is to make previously uneconomic resources viable using low-cost electrochemical processing, on-site reagent generation, modular systems, and data-driven process design. We are a team of engineers and operators advancing from integrated pilots to first commercial plants with industrial partners. Joining BlueShift means helping turn electrochemical science into reliable industrial systems that can be built, operated, and scaled.

About the role

We are a fast-growing startup commercializing next-generation electrochemical technology. We are seeking a visionary, hands-on Director of Engineering to join our executive leadership team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between breakthrough laboratory science and multi-megawatt commercial deployment. You will own the entire engineering lifecycle: from multi-cell electrochemical stack scale-up to BOP design, process engineering, and ultimate field commissioning. As a key strategic partner to the CEO and Board, you will ensure our systems are uncompromisingly safe, cost-optimized, and strictly built for manufacturability.

Responsibilities:

You will oversee the evolution of our electrochemical cell technology as it scales from lab-bench discovery, through pilot-scale testing, to robust multi-cell commercial stacks.
You will instill a strong culture of safety across all engineering operations by leading PHA and HAZOP reviews for all lab, pilot and commercial systems.
You will lead the process engineering team in designing, simulating, and building the BOP fluid, thermal, and electrical control systems.
You will ensure all engineering designs pivot early toward mass production, supply chain resilience, and automated assembly to minimize custom, non-scalable components.
You will act as the primary technical interface with EPC firms to manage large-scale system build and integration, scheduling, and delivery.
You will personally supervise and build the team responsible for the on-site deployment, testing, and commissioning of our first-of-a-kind commercial pilots, with extensive partner interface.
You will continually perform and refine rigorous TEA and system cost optimization models to drive down levelized costs.
You will serve as the primary engineering voice at the C-suite level by aligning technology roadmaps with business milestones, managing budgets, and presenting technical progress to investors and board members.
You will work alongside external legal counsel to build and strengthen our IP portfolio.

Required Qualifications & Skills

10 or more years of progressive engineering leadership experience, ideally within a high-growth startup or a fast-paced hardware development environment.
B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Deep technical background in electrochemical systems like electrolyzers, fuel cells, or chlor-alkali.
Proven track record of taking a complex chemical or hardware technology out of the lab, through a pilot plant phase, and into successful commercial production.
Strong experience in process engineering and electrochemical system integration.
Familiarity with process simulation tools and techno-economic modeling practices.
You thrive in a startup environment, with rapid iterations and wearing multiple hats from high-level board decks to turning wrenches on a pilot skid.

What we offer

Competitive salary and equity ownership.
A high-impact role leading the engineering of first-of-a-kind electrochemical mineral processing systems.
Direct collaboration with the CEO, engineers, operators, customers, investors, and industrial partners.
Significant ownership over system architecture, engineering execution, team development, and the path from pilot to commercial scale.
A fast-moving, mission-driven environment with substantial autonomy and room to grow with the company.

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering / VP Engineering

One of our clients is building something genuinely different.

Rather than another warehouse robot or humanoid, they've developed a completely new class of climbing robot designed to inspect, maintain and eventually repair critical infrastructure around the world.

Their robots use a proprietary magnetic locomotion system to climb steel structures that existing robots simply can't access, enabling contact-based inspection, maintenance and manipulation on assets including:

Electrical transmission towers
Bridges
Pipelines
Industrial tanks
Shipbuilding infrastructure
Large-scale industrial facilities

With trillions of dollars being invested globally into upgrading energy infrastructure, renewable power and data centre capacity, demand already exists. Customers across North America and Europe are actively helping shape the product ahead of commercial deployment.
Following successful early funding, the business is now assembling its founding engineering leadership team as it prepares for a significant Seed round later this year.
This is where you come in.

The Opportunity

This isn't a traditional Head of Engineering position where you'll inherit a large organisation.

Today the engineering team is intentionally small, highly technical and moving incredibly fast. Your role will be to introduce the structure, engineering processes and technical leadership needed to scale without losing the agility that made the company successful in the first place.
Initially this is around 80% hands-on engineering leadership and execution, 20% strategy
, evolving into a broader organisational leadership role as the company grows.

You'll work directly alongside the founders, recruit key members of the engineering organisation and help build the foundations for what will become a much larger team over the next 12 to 24 months.

If you've always wanted to help build an engineering organisation from the ground up rather than inherit one, this is exactly that opportunity.

What You'll Be Doing
Lead and grow a multidisciplinary robotics engineering team.
Introduce engineering processes, systems and operational structure that enable rapid scaling.
Build a high-performance engineering culture centred around collaboration, ownership and technical excellence.
Work closely with Product and R&D to balance customer needs with engineering priorities.
Mentor engineering managers and senior individual contributors while remaining technically involved.
Help recruit the next generation of robotics engineers as the company scales following its Seed round.
Drive software, systems and hardware integration across a highly complex robotic platform.
Guide technical decisions across robotics software, controls, systems engineering and product development.
Help transition the company from advanced prototype development into commercial deployment.

What We're Looking For

We're far more interested in what you've built than where you've worked or studied.

You'll likely bring:
Experience leading engineering teams within robotics or autonomous systems.
A background building products in an early-stage startup environment.
Systems engineering experience with a strong appreciation for testing, validation and reliability.
Experience building engineering processes rather than simply operating within established ones.
Strong people leadership, including managing managers and growing technical organisations.
The ability to remain hands-on while leading a team.
Technical experience with C++, ROS2 and modern robotics software development.
Experience balancing engineering excellence with rapidly evolving product requirements.
A pragmatic approach to using AI to improve engineering productivity.
An interest in solving real-world physical problems rather than purely software challenges.

Bonus points if you've worked on:
Legged robotics
Outdoor autonomous systems
Critical infrastructure
Industrial robotics
Field robotics
Safety-critical robotic systems
Simulation and modelling

The Person

Success in this role is as much about mindset as technical ability.

You'll thrive if you:
Enjoy building teams from scratch.
Bring calm, experienced leadership to ambitious startup environments.
Challenge ideas constructively rather than simply saying "yes".
Are comfortable operating with ambiguity.
Believe in creating processes that accelerate engineering rather than slow it down.
Care more about building meaningful technology than chasing titles.
Lead with humility and treat people well.

Put simply: they're looking for an exceptional engineering leader with no ego
.

Why This Role?
Join at one of the earliest leadership stages.
Significant equity with genuine long-term upside.
Direct influence over company direction and engineering culture.
Opportunity to build and lead your own engineering organisation.
Clear progression towards a VP Engineering position as the company scales.
Solve problems that have never been solved before using robotics.
Help deploy robots that will transform how critical infrastructure is maintained worldwide.

If you're excited by building world-class engineering teams, solving genuinely difficult robotics challenges and helping create technology with global impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or reach out for a confidential conversation.

Full Position Salary Range: $106,635 - $165,284

If selected for the position, the hiring range is $106,635 - $135,959 (based on qualifications and experience)

BENEFITS

The Town of Matthews offers a comprehensive benefits package including bilingual incentive pay, vacation and sick leave, increased vacation accrual for qualified service with another government agency, shared sick leave, medical insurance, paid parental leave, health reimbursement account (HRA), dental plan, vision insurance, North Carolina Local Government Employees Retirement Plan, 457 and 401K Retirement Accounts, flexible medical & dependent care spending accounts, EAP, group and voluntary life insurance & AD&D, short-term disability, long-term disability, accident plans, hospital indemnity plans, and critical illness insurance, and tuition reimbursement.
POSITION SUMMARY

Performs executive-level professional engineering and administrative work directing the Town's Engineering Department and serves as the Town Engineer. Responsible for engineering operations, capital project delivery, development engineering, engineering standards, infrastructure planning, consultant management, and departmental leadership. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Assistant Town Manager and is evaluated through conferences and review of records for quality of overall construction in the Town, the relationship with the development community, and acceptance by the general community.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

(The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the class.)
Plans, organizes, and directs all engineering services in the Town and the work of the department to provide timely, thorough, and effective response to construction within the Town.
Directs plan review, site inspection, project design, and construction-industry relations functions to assure quality construction projects for the Town.
Supervises department; trains, develops, provides performance coaching and evaluation to create a skilled and motivated staff.
Serves as the Town's principal engineering advisor to the Town Manager, Board of Commissioners, and other departments.
Develops long-range engineering strategies consistent with the Town's Strategic Plan.
Advises executive leadership on infrastructure investment priorities.
Develops departmental performance measures; identifies operational efficiencies and continuous improvement opportunities.
Represents the Engineering Department as a member of the Town's executive leadership team.
Supervises the preparation of construction plans, bid packages, design criteria, analysis, specifications, plans, rights of way maps, investigations, cost estimates, and tabulation of contract bids for construction projects; authorizes contract payments; establishes schedules for work; recommends selection of consultants and contractors.
Signs and seals engineering documents.
Oversees the capital improvement process engineering design of infrastructure for the Town; coordinates design needs with other departments, other related staff, and user needs; ensures designs meet long-term quality and functionality as well as regulatory requirements; updates and applies Town engineering standards to achieve desired outcomes.
Oversees consultants and contracted engineers, including selection, negotiating scope, administering and managing contracts, assuring the preparation of reports and engineering records, evaluating performance, and reviewing invoices.
Collaborates with the North Carolina Department of Transportation on projects as necessary.
Develops long-range transportation, drainage, sidewalk, and infrastructure improvement plans.
Oversees stormwater and sediment control plan review, site inspection, and handling of citizen complaints in collaboration with Mecklenburg County; enforces stormwater regulations.
Reviews applications for development permits; ensures development plans comply with applicable ordinances, codes, and regulations.
Reviews and approves plans for proposed subdivisions and planned unit developments.
Administers the department budget, authorizes purchases, and monitors expenditures for compliance with Town of Matthews budgeting policies and procedures.
Identifies, prepares, and administers federal, state, and regional grant opportunities for infrastructure improvements.
Makes field visits to observe and collaborate with staff, meet construction industry officials, and observe construction quality and community impact.
Develops and delivers technical presentations for the Board of Commissioners; simplifies complex engineering data and project specifics into understandable reports and recommendations for public officials, non-engineering staff, and the community.
Develops special projects, strategies, designs, or other activities to support Town and departmental management; researches issues and prepares reports; advises management, construction industry, elected officials, and others on related matters.
Maintains files and records; prepares reports.
Performs related duties as required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

(The knowledge, skills, and abilities listed in this specification are representative of the class but are not an all-inclusive list.)
Comprehensive knowledge of and ability to apply engineering principles and practices as applied to land development and related to design and construction of infrastructure.
Broad knowledge of transportation, stormwater, and site civil engineering, with comprehensive knowledge of at least one of these.
Thorough knowledge of related laws, ordinances, codes, and regulations affecting utility, public works, and construction by the Town or by contractors.
Considerable knowledge of leadership and organizational development.
Considerable knowledge of effective supervisory practices related to employee communication, motivation, performance coaching, and evaluation.
Considerable knowledge of municipal personnel, budgeting, and purchasing policies and practices.
Knowledge of Capital Improvement Program development.
Ability to present technical information and communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
Ability to read and interpret laws, codes, ordinances, plans, specifications, and blueprints and to compare and interpret them with various aspects of construction in progress.
Ability to perform difficult engineering computations and to make comprehensive recommendations on engineering problems; skill in the use of civil engineering instruments.
Ability to establish effective working relationships with employees, various departments, public officials, engineers, contractors, developers, consultants, construction workers, and the general public.
Ability to prepare and conduct effective public presentations; and to read and prepare complex records and reports.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to physically perform the basic life operational support functions of climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, reaching, standing, walking, pulling, lifting, grasping, fingering, talking, and hearing.
Must be able to perform sedentary work exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to move objects.
Must possess the visual acuity to maintain records and reports, review maps and drawings, inspect work for quality of methods and materials, operate a computer terminal, and use measuring devices.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

Must be conscious of potential hazards and safety practices to avoid injury to others and themselves; May be subject to hazards including working in both inside and outside environments, in extreme hot and cold weather, and exposure to various hazards such as construction noise and hazards, proximity to moving mechanical parts, vibrations, dust, mists, fumes, oils, tight quarters, and narrow passageways. This position is subject to all State and Federal OSHA regulations, including, but not limited to the following: bloodborne pathogens, hazard communication/GHS, personal protective equipment, slips, trips, and falls, etc.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university in Civil Engineering or a closely related field.
At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible engineering experience, including a minimum of five (5) years of supervisory or management experience in municipal engineering, public infrastructure, or consulting engineering; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATE AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

Must possess or be able to obtain a valid North Carolina Driver's License within 60 days of employment with a safe driving record. (If you possess a South Carolina Driver’s License and maintain residence in South Carolina, you are not required to attain a North Carolina Driver's License.)
Current licensure as a Professional Engineer in North Carolina or the ability to secure licensure within six months of hire is mandatory.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Web Platform)
jobs.description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.
We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About Engineering At Headway

Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. The engineering team at Headway is a small but mighty team using technology to build that future (and have a fun time while doing it!).

Principles That Guide Us

Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapist to better solve the problems they're facing.
Ship small, learn fast: We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration
Everything is a product: Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end-users in mind.
Optimize for trust: We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes.

Tools We Use

Languages: TypeScript
Libraries & Frameworks: React, Remix, Next.js
Monitoring: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry
Version Control: Github
AI Tools: Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Eddy (our in-house cloud agent harness)

About This Role

As a Senior Engineering Manager for Web Platform, you will be responsible for leading and growing the engineering team through people development, strategic planning, and close partnership with Engineering Leadership, Product, and Design. You will play a leading role in defining the team's roadmap, making a clear and well-supported case for platform investment across the organization, and ensuring the team's work directly enables Headway's product and business goals. This role requires strong organizational leadership and strategic communication: the platform only delivers its full value when the rest of engineering understands what it makes possible.

Who You Are

We're looking for experienced engineering team leaders and people managers who are relationship-obsessed, drive results, and enable their teams to build for technical excellence. As a Senior Engineering Manager at Headway, you will work closely with Engineering Leadership, Product, Design, and Business teams to help shape the future of the engineering organization. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, mission-aligned engineering leader to make an immediate impact on our rapidly scaling engineering team.

Below are additional experiences we think help engineering managers succeed at Headway:

You have 5+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager
You have 10+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with depth in modern frontend and web technologies
You have experience leading platform, infrastructure, or developer experience teams and understand how to make the case for foundational work in an organization driven by product outcomes
You are a strong strategic communicator who can translate platform investments into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership
You have a track record of building alignment across multiple product teams, navigating competing priorities, and driving a shared roadmap forward
You are proactive in creating organizational visibility for your team's work through documentation, metrics, and stakeholder engagement, not just through the work itself
You are able to build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Design and Product, keeping platform and product roadmaps in sync

Our interview process

After you apply to Headway, here are some details of what to expect during the interview process.

Initial screen: You'll connect with someone in recruiting so you can learn more about the team, Headway's mission and exciting growth, and we can get a better idea of your background.
First rounds: You'll meet with an engineering leader on the team to go deeper into your team and people leadership experiences.
Final rounds: You'll meet team members across product and engineering leadership for multiple behavioral interviews and two technical interviews (System Design & AI Coding), leaving you with a fuller picture of what it's like to work at Headway.
References and the Offer: Our favorite part of the process! We'll send over all of the details, including specifics on employee equity, and congratulatory messages from excited future team members!

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.

Headway participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here.

A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

Compensation Range: $261.2K - $331.5K

Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. Our platform includes Benchmark Resorts & Hotels, a collection of distinctive independent properties; Axiom Hospitality, our European hotel management company; and PYRAMIDWORKS, which provides integrated workplace and facilities services. With corporate offices in Boston, The Woodlands, Texas, and London, Pyramid combines global scale with a hands-on approach focused on exceptional service, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships.

At Pyramid, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are respected, supported, and empowered to grow their careers. Team members have the opportunity to collaborate directly with experienced leaders, take on meaningful stretch assignments, and gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of properties, brands, and markets. Whether you are beginning your hospitality career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to learn, develop, and make an impact.

Our commitment to associates, guests, owners, and the communities we serve has helped make Pyramid and our properties among the most recognized in hospitality. From being named among the best places to work by respected publications such as USA Today, The Boston Globe, and The Houston Chronicle to earning top travel accolades from Travel + Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes Travel Guide, and U.S. News & World Report, these recognitions reflect the culture, service excellence, and commitment to people that define the Pyramid experience.

About Our Property

Welcome to The Arcadian Hotel Brookline, a distinctive property in the Pyramid Global Hospitality portfolio, located just minutes from downtown Boston. Featuring 264 guest rooms and 5,500 sq ft of meeting space, this newly renovated hotel offers a modern and comfortable work environment in one of the area's most charming and historic neighborhoods.

Agentic Experiences drive AI innovation across the stack. Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is evolving from a suite of individual tools into a unified, agentic platform for all legal knowledge work. We are building more than just a chat interface; we are building the orchestration layer that allows legal professionals to automate complex workflows, reason over vast datasets, and execute multi-step tasks across the entire legal lifecycle.

The Core Product pillar sits at the center of this evolution. As the primary entry point and engagement driver for the Harvey ecosystem, this team is responsible for architecting the platform foundations and user experiences that power the next generation of AI-native legal applications. You will ensure we build a cohesive, agentic platform that serves as the operating system for the future of legal work, while continuing to drive significant engagement and growth for Harvey.

What You'll Do

Lead the Flagship Experience: You’ll oversee some of the most important surface areas of Harvey, including homepage, core chat experience, document Q&A and more.
Architect a Platform: You’ll guide the transition of our core features into a scalable, agentic platform that the rest of our product and engineering teams can build and integrate upon.
Scale the Organization: Harvey is growing fast. Help us scale our engineering organization across the globe by hiring and retaining world-class software engineering and AI talent.
Shape the Structure: You’ll work with other leaders to shape the organization, both in terms of skill set and geographic footprint.

What You Have

Product-Minded Engineering Leader: You have a track record of shipping best-in-class products (consumer or enterprise) that drive significant user and business value.
GenAI Expertise: You’ve built and scaled innovative features using Generative AI and understand the nuances of AI product development.
Scaling Teams & Organizations: You have 5+ years of experience leading larger organizations, including other managers and senior individual contributors, ideally across startups and larger enterprises.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our ML Training & Serving team. This is a senior technical leadership role with company-wide impact. You will directly lead a team of platform engineers, including senior technical leaders, and combine strong people leadership with deep ML infrastructure judgment. In close partnership with senior ICs, you will shape the platform’s strategy and technical direction.

What You'll Do

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for ML training & serving, covering large-scale model training, model deployment workflows, GPU infrastructure, and low-latency model serving at scale.
Lead and grow a team of platform engineers while remaining deeply engaged in technical strategy and architectural trade-offs in close partnership with senior ICs.
Continuously evolve ML training & serving infrastructure to stay ahead of the frontier — anticipating where AI and ML are heading and building the infrastructure that makes those capabilities possible at Affirm before they become urgent needs. Partner with ML modeling, product, and infrastructure leadership to ensure ML training & serving infrastructure accelerates Affirm's most critical ML initiatives.
Establish engineering excellence across the organization: reliability, observability, developer experience, and operational rigor.
Recruit, develop, and retain world-class platform engineers.

Deep expertise in building and operating large-scale ML infrastructure, with substantial experience in one or more of model training systems, model serving, deployment workflows, or GPU infrastructure.
Strong understanding of ML data needs — training datasets, data quality, reproducibility, evaluation data, and how data shapes model behavior and platform design.
Fluency with modern ML: deep neural networks, transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, large-scale GPU training and serving.
Strong systems thinking — comfortable reasoning from low-level infrastructure decisions to broad architectural trade-offs.
Track record of building platforms that meaningfully accelerate the productivity and impact of ML teams.

Proven track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing engineers, including coaching senior ICs and creating opportunities for them to expand their technical leadership.

Director of Engineering Delivery (Power Generation / Gas-to-Power)
jobs.description:
What We're Building

Candid is building the AI layer for EPCs and owner operators.

We use AI to reduce the manual effort behind preconstruction engineering by automating document understanding, consistency checks, and repetitive workflow steps across major disciplines. The goal is to make preconstruction 10x faster without sacrificing engineering quality.

We recently raised $6.5M from top AI and industrial investors (including Schneider Electric and Meta’s Chief AI Scientist). Our team includes engineers from MIT, Carnegie Mellon, major LNG and power projects, and leading EPCs.

Why This Role Exists

We need someone who has lived inside Pre-FEED and FEED. Someone who knows what a design basis package actually looks like at 3 AM before a gate review, who has directed engineers through datasheet cycles, and who has felt the pain of building the same thing from scratch on every project.

You are not here to manage a backlog. You are here to direct real project delivery for Candid's clients and run the engineering team doing it, while shaping the AI tools that redefine how this work gets done. You are the bridge between deep domain knowledge and a product team building at startup speed.

This Role

This is a player-coach role at a startup, not a director seat at a 5,000-person EPC. You'll have a small, sharp discipline team reporting to you, not three layers and an army. You'll direct delivery and manage the team, and you'll also personally own quality and roll up your sleeves on the work when it counts, especially early. If the last time you touched a deliverable was a decade ago and you only direct through others, this isn't the right fit.

Day to day you'll:

Direct Pre-FEED and FEED engagements for Candid's clients across power generation, gas-to-power, LNG, midstream, and downstream projects
Lead and manage the discipline engineering team (process, electrical, mechanical, piping), set the bar, and own delivery quality end to end
Own the assembly and quality of design basis packages, heat and mass balances, single-lines, equipment lists, P&IDs and PFDs, datasheets, utility summaries, and gate-review packages
Be the authoritative engineering voice in client conversations with project development managers, VPs of Projects, and heads of engineering
Work directly with our product and AI team to turn real Pre-FEED and FEED workflows into automation targets. What takes 600 hours today should take 60 tomorrow
Be the quality gate on Candid's automated outputs: catch what's wrong before it reaches a client, and feed it back so the product gets sharper
Advise on execution strategy, PDRI scoring, and gate-review readiness for client engagements
Shape Candid's delivery methodology and standards as we scale from early clients to a repeatable practice

Who You Are

15+ years in capital project execution, with significant time in power generation, gas-to-power, LNG, midstream, or petrochemical facilities
You have directed or led Pre-FEED, FEED, or Concept Select phases end to end. Directed, not just participated
Direct experience leading power or gas-to-power projects (combined cycle, simple cycle, cogeneration, or gas-to-power for data center and BTM campuses). Multi-sector experience across LNG, midstream, and downstream on top of that is a strong plus, not a requirement to explain away
You've managed multi-discipline engineering teams across process, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation. You know how to set a quality bar and hold it
Deep fluency in FEL stage-gate processes, PDRI, AACE cost estimate classes, design basis development, and the full document ecosystem that feeds a gate review
Fluent across the codes and frameworks that govern these projects (ASME, API, IEEE, NFPA, and the relevant power and interconnection standards), at the level of someone who directs the work, not necessarily runs every calc
Strong opinions on where engineering hours get wasted, where errors propagate, and what should be automated
Comfortable operating lean, with ambiguity, and without bureaucracy. You'd rather ship and iterate than wait for the perfect process
You are not threatened by AI. You're excited by it, you see the waste in current workflows, and you want to fix it

Nice to Have

Direct experience on data center or behind-the-meter power campuses
Owner's engineer experience, or having sat on both the EPC and owner-operator sides
Background in AWP (Advanced Work Packaging) or modular execution
Familiarity with turbine OEM selection and packaging (GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Power) at a program level
Comfort reading process simulation outputs even if you don't run the tools yourself
Relationships in the Houston EPC and owner-operator ecosystem

Why Candid

You've spent a career watching the same inefficiencies repeat across every project. Here you get to actually fix them, with AI tools built around your expertise
Direct influence on product direction. Your domain knowledge is the product
Startup equity and meaningful upside on an early team
You work alongside world-class AI engineers from MIT and Carnegie Mellon who build what you spec
No bureaucracy, no 47-slide approval decks. Ship and iterate

Compensation And Perks

Base + meaningful equity
Unlimited PTO
Health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision
Daily lunch and dinner at the office
Up to $150/mo health and wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, and similar)

jobs.description:
About VSCO

For years, we've helped photographers create their work. Now we're building what comes next.

VSCO exists for photographers. Not as a side feature, not as an afterthought, but as the whole point. We build the connected system photographers rely on, and we've spent over a decade earning the trust of a global creative community that takes the craft seriously.

Photography is at an inflection point. AI is reshaping what's possible for creative work, and that's where our mission shines. VSCO is building the full photographer's workflow: from creating and editing your work, to delivering it to clients, to running your business. All of it built thoughtfully, with photographers leading the way. We believe the future of photography tools creates more space for creativity, handling the busy work so photographers can focus on the craft.

If you care about craft, community, and what technology can unlock for creative people, this is the work. We're a mission-driven and focused company where your work ships quickly, is meaningful, and reaches tens of millions of people worldwide. You'll have a real say in what we build and how we build it. We hire people who don't wait to be asked, naturally connect the dots, care about the quality of what they ship, and believe the best outcomes come from building together.

About You

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a team of server, web, and full-stack engineers building a business management platform designed for professional photographers, offering tools for client management, scheduling, invoicing, and workflow automation to help streamline and grow their businesses.

The day to day

Leading and growing engineers. Hiring, coaching, and developing the team. Structuring the team so the right people are in the right roles, placing your strongest technical contributors where they'll have the most impact, and helping everyone advance their careers.
Stay hands-on technically and lead as a player-coach. Review code, directly contribute, and maintain a deep understanding of the systems your team owns, including how they integrate with the broader VSCO platform. By staying close to the work, you'll bring informed perspectives to technical decisions, guide architectural direction, and help the team deliver high-quality solutions.
Owning outcomes end-to-end. Defining and refining the roadmap with your team and XFN partners, breaking down work, setting success metrics, and holding the team accountable for delivering high-quality results.
Removing obstacles. Embracing "all problems are my problem." When your team or XFN partners hit a blocker, you help them get unstuck, whether that means escalating, adjusting scope, or having hard conversations.
Collaborating across VSCO. Partnering with product, design, data science, and other engineering teams to cut through ambiguity, design shared primitives, and shape a shared product vision.

Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time as a hands-on IC building production systems at scale.
5+ years of engineering management or technical leadership experience (including people management without the formal EM title) on user-facing products.
Strong familiarity with at least a couple of major parts of our stack: Go, TypeScript/React/Node.js. You should be able to write, review, and reason about code across these stacks.
Product-sense that goes beyond management. You'll be collaborating with PMs and designers daily, and we need someone who can reason about scope, suggest alternatives, and help shape what we build - not just execute on a spec.
Demonstrated hands-on experience applying AI tools and workflows in software development, coupled with a track record of leading team adoption and embedding AI-enabled practices that improve productivity, engineering velocity, and operational efficiency.
Commitment to people leadership, with demonstrated outcomes in facilitating team success and fostering a culture of technical rigor.
Ownership mentality. You resolve blockers for your team and XFN partners, drive decisions, and hold yourself accountable for the team's success.

Nice to have

Experience leading large technological migration initiatives
Experience building business tools like CRM systems
Experience with distributed systems

Job Perks

Hybrid work with an office in San Francisco, CA
Regular in-person events events to connect and collaborate
Competitive salary & equity
Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and families
Flexible Time Off
Company-paid parental, medical and caregiver leave
Other perks including mental health resources and tech reimbursements

Compensation

The base salary for this position will vary based on several factors, such as relevant experience, location and your approved internal leveling assessed during the interview process. The base salary range for this role is $240,000 - $255,000. Salary is one component of our total compensation package. This position also qualifies for equity (i.e. stock options) and is eligible for discretionary bonuses based on performance.

The benefits available for this position include flexible time off, a 401K retirement plan, insurance (medical, dental, vision, life/AD&D, short and long term disability), and 11 paid holidays. We also provide paid sick time as required by state and local law. Additional benefits and perks contained in our standard employee benefits package are also offered for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Flink Control Plane
jobs.description:
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About The Role

The Flink Platform team is at the forefront of building a robust, serverless control plane for Confluent’s fully managed Flink offering. As the Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead a high-impact team of approximately 10 engineers—including two Staff-level individual contributors—responsible for the "brain" of our streaming service.

You will own the customer-facing Flink REST API and Gateway, the Kubernetes operators that orchestrate Flink job lifecycles (submission, scaling, recovery), and the declarative API server that backs them – the stack every Flink customer interaction flows through. Your team is responsible for multi-tenant isolation, end-to-end reliability, and the integration points between Confluent's global control plane and the regional Flink data plane.

This is a critical leadership role where you will balance deep technical strategy–driving architectural excellence and reliability–with a strong focus on people leadership, specifically growing a talented group of senior engineers into the next generation of Staff-level leaders.

What You Will Do

Vision & Execution: Own the overall roadmap and execution for the Flink Control Plane. Define the strategy for job orchestration (submission, scaling, recovery) and serverless resource management.
Architectural Leadership: Lead the ongoing migration of the control plane onto Confluent's latest platform foundations and drive major component refactors in service of reliability, security, and scale. You will "see around corners" – making the right bets on architecture today so the platform stays resilient as Flink usage grows by orders of magnitude.
Engineering Excellence: Work with engineering teams and product management on critical aspects of product definition, architectural design, and delivery. Influence the overall domain health and operational hygiene for the platform.
Scale & Performance: Drive the control plane's evolution to support 10x growth in compute pools, statements, and tenants per region. Lead initiatives that eliminate hotspots in the metadata and orchestration layers so customer-facing operations remain fast and predictable under load.
People Development: Manage and coach a diverse team. Your primary mission is to mentor junior and mid-level developers, providing them with the architectural context and leadership skills to reach Staff levels.
Collaboration: Work closely with engineering leadership and key stakeholders across Confluent Cloud to drive cross-team efforts to solve complex distributed system challenges at scale – strong cross-org partnership is core to the role.
Operational Integrity: Lead the team in maintaining high code quality, comprehensive test coverage, and a robust on-call rotation, ensuring the control plane meets enterprise-grade reliability standards.

What You Will Bring

Experience: 10+ years in software development with at least 5+ years in engineering management, specifically leading teams focused on cloud-native infrastructure or managed services.
Technical Depth: Deep knowledge of distributed systems orchestration (Kubernetes operators, controller patterns, declarative API servers) and multi-tenant resource isolation. Experience scaling control planes for managed cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure, Elastic, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) is highly preferred. Direct Flink experience is not required.
Leadership Track Record: A proven track record of hiring while ensuring a high bar, keeping engineers motivated through complex technical transitions, and managing performance effectively.
Focus on Reliability: A mindset geared toward "Operational Excellence." You understand how to build and maintain resilient, enduring technical foundations that serve as a central component for other teams to build upon.
Communication: Exceptional ability to influence peers and upper management using data-driven, collaborative techniques and clear written/verbal communication.

Ready to build what's next? Let’s get in motion.

jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

What You Will Be Doing

The capacitor bank is the beating heart of a Helion machine: it stores the energy for every fusion pulse, delivers it in under a millisecond, and takes it back. You will own the organization that architects, designs, qualifies, and produces hardware for Orion, our first fusion power plant.

You Will

Own the architecture of Orion's capacitor bank and its interdependencies with the machine core: requirements, decomposition, and the interfaces that let the bank, core, and controls behave as one machine
Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of electrical and mechanical engineers designing and qualifying pulsed power circuit modules for each section of the machine with ownership spanning pulsed power electrical design, mechanical and thermal solutions, and the high precision low voltage control interfaces that command them
Drive manufacturable design: partner day-to-day with manufacturing engineering to move modules from prototype test to production at rate, against a capacitor line building megajoules of pulsed power energy capacity per week
Own cost, schedule, and reliability for the module portfolio: make the architecture and design trades, set the qualification bar for hardware that must survive million-pulse campaigns and be accountable for hitting the objectives on a schedule you influenced
Work day-to-day with Research, Science, and Controls to keep module designs ahead of what the physics and operations teams learn from running machines
Build the team: hire, develop, and set the design-review and engineering standards that let the organization move from prototype to production without losing rigor
In your first year, you will baseline the Orion bank architecture, stand up the qualification program for the first production modules, and have production-intent hardware under test.

Required Skills

Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
10+ years developing complex electromechanical hardware, including 4+ years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams (Electrical, Mechanical, Firmware, Thermal)
A track record of taking hardware from prototype through qualification into production, and of the design-for-manufacture judgment that makes that transition fast
Technical depth in at least one of: power electronics or pulsed energy systems, high-reliability electromechanical design, or high-volume hardware production with fluency across the others
Demonstrated ownership of cost, schedule, and reliability at program scale, including making and defending hard trades
Cross-functional leadership strength: this role succeeds through tactical and strategic partnership with research, science, controls, and manufacturing
Experience scaling engineering teams and processes through a prototype-to-production transition

Immigration is complex, with endless edge cases and global scale. However, this is not a caretaker role. The world is changing around us and the team is in the midst of transitioning to both an AI-native customer product and an AI-native development process. You will need to drive change with us, and partner with our existing engineering, product, design, legal and operations teams to build a world-class AI-native platform for legal services, and continue to evolve our development infrastructure towards being a truly AI-native “software factory”.

Continue our transition towards a “software factory” engineering model, overhauling dev processes, systems, tools, and culture.

Grow engineers into architectural thinking by giving them opportunities to step up, and pushing their thinking constructively.
